We're looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to own how StackOne is built, shipped, and run, as we scale across our own cloud and into our customers' clouds. You'll own the infrastructure behind the platform, our deployment pipeline and developer tooling, and how we package StackOne to run inside customers' own AWS, GCP, or Azure accounts.
It's a hands-on role with broad scope. You write code and tooling, you own the IaC other engineers depend on, and you set the standard for how every new repository gets deployed and secured. You'll report directly to the CTO and work closely with our Security Engineer and tech leads.
RESPONSIBILITIES
- Own our infrastructure at scale: the AWS estate today (ECS Fargate, Aurora, ElastiCache, MSK, OpenSearch, Lambda, KMS) and the AWS CDK to Terraform migration. Keep it reliable, observable, and cost-aware.
- Build out the deployment pipeline as we consolidate toward a monorepo: the CI/CD that ships every service, plus an automated end-to-end testing harness with incremental (affected-only) testing that stays fast as we grow.
- Ship into customers' own clouds (self-hosted / BYOC): the Terraform modules, container images, runbooks, and documentation for internal teams and customers.
- Own the release and upgrade path for self-hosted customers: versioned, signed releases, a supported-version policy, and a call-home for usage and version reporting.
- Set the standard for new repositories: partner with the Security Engineer and tech leads so new projects (product, internal tools, and vibe-coded prototypes) ship secure and deployable from day one. Templates and golden paths, not gatekeeping.
- Raise reliability: SLOs, observability, and incident response. Make the system easy to operate when something breaks at 3am.
- Treat infrastructure as a product: paved roads and self-serve tooling so product engineers ship without waiting on you.
- Use AI in the workflow: lean on LLMs and agents for IaC generation, test scaffolding, and runbook drafting, with guardrails you trust.
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
- 4+ years in platform, infrastructure, SRE, or DevOps, with hands-on AWS at scale: ECS/Fargate, RDS/Aurora, Lambda, networking, IAM, KMS.
- Deep IaC ability: Terraform and hands-on AWS CDK or CloudFormation. Our estate is CDK today and migrating to Terraform, so you will work in both. You are comfortable owning modules other teams build on.
- Strong CI/CD and monorepo build experience: caching and incremental/affected-only test execution. You've made a slow pipeline fast.
- Strong coding in TypeScript, Python, or Go. You build tooling, not just YAML and configs.
- Containers and Kubernetes in production: Docker, and Kubernetes you have run yourself. Cluster setup, upgrades, resource limits, and the reasons a pod won't start.
- Security-minded: you bake secure defaults into pipelines and repo templates, and partner with security rather than routing around it.
- A clear writer: docs and runbooks that internal engineers and external customers can follow.
- End-to-end ownership: you scope, ship, and measure, and automate instead of running manual checklists.
NICE TO HAVE
- Shipping software into customers' own cloud or on-prem (BYOC / self-hosted), or a platform like Nuon, Replicated, or Omnistrate.
- Multi-cloud (GCP or Azure) IaC, and exposure to Temporal, Kafka/MSK, ClickHouse, or OpenSearch.
OUR STACK
- Cloud & infra: AWS (ECS Fargate, Aurora Postgres, ElastiCache, MSK, OpenSearch, Lambda, S3, KMS, CloudFront, WAF), GCP, Cloudflare (Workers, WAF)
- IaC: Terraform and AWS CDK (migrating off CDK)
- Data & messaging: Postgres, Redis, Kafka, OpenSearch, ClickHouse
- CI/CD: GitHub Actions
- Observability & analytics: Datadog, Sentry, Metabase
- Languages: TypeScript (Node.js), Python
BENEFITS
- Join one of Europe's fastest-growing startups.
- Work alongside an experienced team, with backgrounds from Google, Microsoft, Oracle, Coinbase, JP Morgan, and more.
- Meaningful share options (EMI) — share in the company's success as we grow.
- Flexible hours and hybrid working — some flexibility in start and finish times, with 2 days minimum in our London office (come in more if you prefer!)
- 25 days holiday + 1 additional day per year of tenure.
- Private health insurance — including dental & optical.
- £15/day lunch budget when working from our London office, up to £180/month.
- £1,000 for your home office setup + £500/year top-up.
- Health, fitness and gift card discounts.
- Cycle2Work and Electric Cars scheme.
- Annual team offsites to sunny spots (last ones were in Croatia and Portugal ☀️)

We're Redis. We built the product that runs the fast apps our world runs on. (If you checked the weather, used your credit card, or looked at your flight status online today, you’re welcome.) We’re creating a faster world with simpler experiences. You in?
Why would you love this job?
In this position, you will play a key role in our SDR team by prospecting into predefined named accounts as well as following up on some inbound leads to create a quality pipeline of Sales Qualified Opportunities.
You will be working in close partnership with our sales teams, SDRs globally and our marketing team. This position requires strong business acumen with the ability to quickly assess and align customer interest to products and use cases. Our ideal candidate must possess the aptitude to easily engage and establish rapport with prospects, colleagues cross functionally and most of all be hungry, creative and driven to generate a quality pipeline of SQLs. This is a position of growth and learning in the areas of sales and marketing; being coachable is a must!
You will join the Field Outbound SDR team, working alongside Account Executives and reporting directly to the region SDR Manager. This is a rare opportunity to help define a growing sales team in a well-funded SaaS startup with great customer traction.
What you’ll do:
- Research into all predefined named accounts.
- Develop, nurture & close leads through the sales process.
- Strategize the approaches, track and maintain databases including Salesforce and Outreach.
- Build a strong relationship internally with our cross functional teams - Sales, Marketing, Enablement and Alliances.
- Establish Champions and Advocates over the phone and through web-conference.
- Identifying and nurturing leads to generate quality SQLs.
- Execute established best practices using tools such as Outreach, Salesforce,ZoomInfo, Drift and 6sense.
- Support all our Marketing initiatives and campaigns to help generate leads.
- Conduct Outbound engagements through combo prospecting (email+phone+social+video) to our ICP.
- Manage and deliver on SDR activities respective to weekly KPIs.
- Hand off qualified opportunities to Account Executives and engage in necessary follow-ups that may be required.
What will you need to have?
- Fluent in English, and Native French.
- A tech enthusiast with a passion to solve organisational problems with Saas offerings of the organisation.
- Enjoy the scrappiness of a startup (with the stability of an established company!).
- Have demonstrated curiosity, resourcefulness, motivation, and initiative.
- The love to work with people who are highly diverse.
- The ability to write a compelling message and tell great stories.
- Previous Social Selling experience is key.

- Flexible vacation time to promote a healthy work-life balance
- Health insurance, paid paternity leave, and pension plan
- Flexible working options
- Yearly health and wellness budget for a healthy mind and body
- Frequent team celebrations and recreation events
- Home internet & phone stipend
- Learning and development opportunities
- Ability to influence a high-performance company on its way to IPO

jobs.ashbyhq.com/velocity/413136e0-89e6-.description_excerpt:
About us:
Velocity is revolutionising the global financial landscape by unifying fiat and digital assets through regulated stablecoin technology. We are tackling some of the most significant inefficiencies in global payments - from the limitations of SWIFT to the cost and delays of cross-border transactions.
Founded by Eric Queathem, with decades of experience scaling and leading payments businesses, Velocity combines deep expertise in regulated financial systems with a fast-growing team of around 25 people across London and Warsaw.
Our platform enables businesses to manage payments, treasury functions, and liquidity in real time, operating 24/7/365. We remove friction in global payouts, cross-border settlements, and treasury operations - seamlessly integrating stablecoin-powered speed with the reliability of traditional finance.
Backed by robust partnerships, including strategic collaborations with Fireblocks and other leading technology providers, we are building trusted infrastructure for scalable global growth.
In May 2025, we announced a $10m pre-seed round led by Activant Capital, with participation from Fuel Ventures, Triton Capital, Fabric Ventures, Commerce Ventures, Digital Space Ventures, and Preface Ventures - alongside strategic shareholders from Stripe, Worldpay, Visa, Circle, PayPal, and Google.
Key responsibilities
- Lead institutional and corporate KYC and EDD reviews, including complex ownership structures, UBO analysis, and risk assessments.
- Own ongoing due diligence, periodic reviews, and trigger-based refresh processes.
- Oversee and perform monitoring of crypto and fiat transactions to identify, investigate, and escalate suspicious activity.
- Manage alert handling, investigations, and escalation workflows in line with Velocity’s risk appetite and regulatory obligations.
- Support the development and optimisation of transaction monitoring rules, thresholds, and investigative processes in partnership with Compliance.
- Draft, maintain, and own financial crime operational procedures and SOPs.
- Support Compliance with regulatory change implementation, audits, and internal reviews.
What we are looking for:
- 5+ years’ experience in financial crime, AML/KYC, transaction monitoring, or related operational roles.
- Strong experience across both crypto and fiat monitoring, including hands-on investigative work.
- Experience with industry leading tools such as Chainalysis, SumSub and Notabene.
- Proven ability to draft, own, and operationalise procedures and SOPs.
- Experience partnering closely with Compliance teams in a regulated environment.
- Strong understanding of UK and international AML / financial crime regulatory expectations.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document clear, practical processes.
- Organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a fast-growing environment.
Why Join?
- Work on a groundbreaking, forward-thinking solution: Be part of a team leveraging cutting-edge technologies to transform the global financial landscape.
- Mission-driven environment with purpose: At Velocity, we prioritize security, and user empowerment, ensuring our solutions are built with integrity and designed to make a difference.
- Learn from industry heavyweights: The founding team consists of seasoned operators with a proven track record in the industry, providing invaluable mentorship and guidance as we grow.
- Backed by top-tier venture capital: Velocity is supported by premier investors, providing the resources and backing necessary to scale rapidly and execute on our ambitious vision.
- Shape the future of global finance: Join an innovative team working on a revolutionary solution that is changing the long-term trajectory of financial operations.
- Be part of a company with long-term vision: With a strong regulatory-first approach and a focus on sustainable, scalable growth, Velocity is poised for long-term success.
Compensation & Benefits:
- Shared ownership Everyone owns a share of the company - no exceptions.
- Offices We’re a dispersed team but one that likes spending time together. We have an office in London, and we aim to work together there the majority of the time. We also believe in working with the best talent wherever it is in the world, so we also have great people who work remotely but join us f2f as much as possible.
- Equipment It is important to have the best tools for the job. We will provide you with a high end Macbook and will update them regularly. We use all the best modern tools - and if you find an even more efficient way of doing something, we’ll adopt it.
- Health and Wellbeing: Paid sick leave for physical and mental health. Depending on your location, private health cover, and extras like dental coverage.
- Pension: Enrollment in our pension scheme. Velocity contributes the equivalent of 3% of your base salary.
- Holiday: Everyone gets 25 days of holiday, plus bank holidays and your birthday off – or opt out of bank holidays and take 33 days whenever you like.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/velocity/e6b043ec-74fc-.description_excerpt:
ABOUT US
Velocity is revolutionising the global financial landscape by unifying fiat and digital assets through regulated stablecoin technology. We are tackling some of the most significant inefficiencies in global payments, from the limitations of SWIFT to the cost and delays of cross-border transactions.
Founded by Eric Queathem, with decades of experience scaling and leading payments businesses, Velocity combines deep expertise in regulated financial systems with a fast-growing team across London, Warsaw, New York and Melbourne.
Our platform enables businesses to manage payments, treasury functions, and liquidity in real time, operating 24/7/365. We remove friction in global payouts, cross-border settlements, and treasury operations, seamlessly integrating stablecoin-powered speed with the reliability of traditional finance.
Backed by robust partnerships, including strategic collaborations with Fireblocks and other leading technology providers, we are building trusted infrastructure for scalable global growth.
We recently announced a $38m Series A led by Dragonfly and FirstMark, with participation from QED, Capital One Ventures, Ripple and Coinbase Ventures.
THE ROLE
This is a senior, quota-carrying role leading Velocity's sales efforts into the largest and most complex fintech and payments companies across EMEA, working alongside a growing commercial team in London.
You will sell regulated stablecoin payment infrastructure into financial institutions, issuers, acquirers, large PSPs, global marketplaces, and scaled fintechs. Deals are multi-threaded, multi-quarter, and involve treasury, payments, product, risk, and compliance stakeholders on the other side of the table.
Beyond your own number, you will raise the ceiling on how we sell: taking on the accounts that need the most seniority in the room, sharpening pricing and positioning for complex enterprise deals, and working with Velocity's leadership team to shape commercial strategy and prioritisation across the region.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
- Own a revenue quota against a portfolio of strategic and enterprise accounts, and be accountable for pipeline generation, progression, and closed business.
- Source and build your own pipeline through outbound, network, events, and inbound follow-up, with the seniority to open doors at CFO, Treasurer, and Head of Payments level.
- Own the full sales cycle end to end: prospecting, pitching, discovery, solution shaping, commercial and legal negotiation, close, and go-live, typically spanning several quarters and multiple decision-makers.
- Structure and negotiate commercially significant agreements, including pricing, liquidity, and settlement terms, in partnership with Finance and Legal.
- Drive adoption of Velocity across the EMEA payments ecosystem, and build a repeatable, disciplined sales motion with clear qualification, pipeline management, and forecasting.
- Act as a force multiplier for the wider commercial team, setting the standard on deal strategy and supporting more junior sellers on complex opportunities.
- Work closely with Product to translate enterprise requirements into product direction, and carry the weight to influence roadmap prioritisation.
- Represent Velocity at senior level at industry conferences and events across the region.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
- 6-10+ years' experience in enterprise sales, business development, or partnerships, the majority of it in a quota-carrying closing role.
- Deep payments, fintech, or financial infrastructure experience, with a sophisticated understanding of how money moves cross-border and where cost, float, and friction sit.
- A demonstrable track record of consistently hitting or exceeding quota on complex enterprise deals, and the numbers to back it up.
- Experience closing large, multi-stakeholder deals with financial institutions, PSPs, acquirers, marketplaces, or scaled fintechs, including navigating procurement, risk, and compliance review.
- A strong, established network across the EMEA payments or fintech ecosystem that you can activate from day one.
- Experience selling technical or API-based products to business and institutional buyers, with the credibility to hold a conversation with both a treasurer and an engineer.
- Exposure to stablecoins or digital assets is an advantage, but deep payments experience matters more than prior crypto experience.
NICE TO HAVE
Deep experience in one or more of the verticals we sell into:
- Issuing: issuer-processors, BIN sponsors, and card programme managers, and the funding and settlement mechanics that sit behind a card programme.
- Acquiring: merchant acquirers, payment facilitators, and ISOs, and where scheme settlement timing, prefunding, and merchant payout cycles tie up working capital.
- Cross-border and remittance: money transfer operators and remittance providers, correspondent banking relationships, and the cost of holding pre-funded balances across corridors.
- Banks and EMIs: treasury, liquidity, and nostro management inside a regulated balance sheet.
WHY JOIN?
1. Work on a groundbreaking, forward-thinking solution: Be part of a team leveraging cutting-edge technologies to transform the global financial landscape.
2. Mission-driven environment with purpose: At Velocity, we prioritize security and user empowerment, ensuring our solutions are built with integrity and designed to make a difference.
3. Learn from industry leaders: The founding team consists of seasoned operators with a proven track record in the industry, providing invaluable mentorship and guidance as we grow.
4. Backed by top-tier venture capital: Velocity is supported by premier investors, providing the resources and backing necessary to scale rapidly and execute on our ambitious vision.
5. Shape the future of global finance: Join an innovative team working on a revolutionary solution that is changing the long-term trajectory of financial operations.
6. Be part of a company with long-term vision: With a strong regulatory-first approach and a focus on sustainable, scalable growth, Velocity is poised for long-term success.
BENEFITS
- Shared ownership: Everyone owns a share of the company. One of our values is to act like an owner, and we back that up with real ownership in the business.
- Equipment: It is important to have the best tools for the job. We will provide you with a MacBook and will update them regularly. We use all the best modern tools, and if you find an even more efficient way of doing something, we'll adopt it.
- Health and wellbeing: Paid sick leave, plus medical cover.
- Pension Contribution
- Time off: 25 days' holiday plus UK bank holidays.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/vertice/50694bde-c020-4.description_excerpt:
Technology is one of the biggest items in an enterprise CFO’s budget, second only to headcount. Traditional procurement is one of the most frustrating, friction-filled bottlenecks in the modern business.
Vertice is the world’s first Intelligent Procurement Platform eliminating this chaos. By combining agentic workflows, deep AI insights, and a global network of expert negotiators, we empower enterprises to buy smarter and scale at pace.
The market response has been unprecedented:
- $75bn+ in spend processed across our platform.
- 20% savings consistently delivered to our customers.
- 70% reduction in standard enterprise procurement cycles.
- 13X revenue growth achieved over the last two years alone.
Founded by serial technology entrepreneurs Roy and Eldar Tuvey, who have successfully scaled and exited two category-defining platforms and created $600M+ in enterprise value, we are backed by over $100M in Series C funding from tier 1 global investors including Bessemer Venture Partners, 83North, Lakestar. We have also been recognized as the #2 fastest-growing company on the Sunday Times' Tech 100 and the fastest-growing startup in the UK and Ireland by the FT’s Sifted (#4 in Europe).
With headquarters in London and hubs in New York, Brno, Sydney, and Johannesburg, we are fundamentally reshaping the global B2B economy.
THE ROLE
In a nutshell, this role would suit someone who holds an unforgiving bar for excellence who feels personal accountability for the execution of the sales motion.
You'll drive GTM strategy and enablement for a global sales organisation with a strong team across our US and EMEA offices. Leonard Maassen https://www.linkedin.com/in/leonard-maassen/ on AI use cases across GTM, Caldwell Harden https://www.linkedin.com/in/caldwellharden/ who focuses on our North American expansion, Chris Davis https://www.linkedin.com/in/crmdavis/ on GTM systems and Constantin Clement https://www.linkedin.com/in/constantinclement/ on wider GTM projects.
This is a role about the motion itself: how Vertice pitches, positions, negotiates and closes, and what the team needs to do all of that better. The reporting engine behind the sales org is already in a good place, so the leverage sits in the craft rather than in RevOps. The work is global and you'll spend most of your time in the London HQ.
YOU'LL FOCUS ON THREE THINGS IN YOUR FIRST TWELVE MONTHS:
#01. Raise the ceiling & the floor
Understand what it takes to win, then embed the standard throughout the sales motion, across the team. There is no prescribed way to do this.
#02. Selling a broad product portfolio
Vertice is selling a portfolio of products. The best reps already excel at selling the full portfolio, because they earn more from it. Your job is to accelerate that momentum, and to do it again for whatever comes next.
#03. Programmes for scale
There is huge headroom across newer channels, which need GTM programmes designed, shipped and measured, alongside sharpening the ICP and pushing AI use cases into a fast-growing sales org.
You'll report to Constantin Clement https://www.linkedin.com/in/constantinclement/, who owns GTM Strategy & Ops, Business Development, Solutions, Deals Strategy and Special Projects with Roy. Both he and Roy recognise that more attention to GTM Strategy & Ops will yield far more juice from the squeeze.
For the right person, this is a rare chance to shape how a genuinely excellent sales organisation operates, at the point where it is scaling channels, geographies and products at once, with the CEO close enough to the work to back what you build.
ABOUT YOU
We're looking for an analytical generalist with operator instincts: someone who wins the confidence of senior sales leaders and pushes work all the way into execution.
In general, we find it takes a certain type of person to thrive at Vertice: someone with a spike in their craft who is also genuinely low-ego, communicates in plain English, doesn't settle for the status quo, and gets a kick out of company building with smart people.
IN PRACTICE, IT'S LIKELY YOU'LL HAVE MOST OF THE FOLLOWING:
#01. Hold an unforgiving bar for excellence
You are a perfectionist about the craft, and you can tell good from great in the detail rather than in the aggregate. We think the best people feel the weight of performance on their shoulders, like the sales leaders they partner with.
"THE KEY HERE IS A SUPER HIGH BAR FOR EXCELLENCE. CAN THEY LISTEN TO A CALL AND HAVE THE INSTINCTS AND THE BAR TO SAY THIS WASN'T GREAT, AND THIS IS HOW IT SHOULD BE DIFFERENT." - CONSTANTIN CLEMENT, HIRING MANAGER
#02. Have commercial horsepower and gravitas
You frame decisions around revenue impact rather than activity, you are quick and confident with numbers, and you command the respect of AEs and senior sales leaders well enough to challenge them and be believed.
#03. Have built the enablement craft
You have built assets that win deals, embedded excellence in how a team operates, and measured the impact in hard numbers (it's not important if you've had an Enablement title - if anything it's likely you don't). You're happy to screenshare the work.
#04. Think from GTM strategy to execution
You have architected and shipped GTM programmes end to end with measurable revenue impact. For example, you built and defended an ICP from first principles and know the nuance of a good target list in practice.
#05. Are a stage-appropriate leader
You have done high-ownership work in a comparable high-agency, high performance environment. Ideally you have managed at least one person, though formal line management is preferred rather than required.
WHAT NOW?
If you're keen to keep exploring this opportunity with Vertice, let's speak.
Complete the application form and we'll be in touch if we think it's a good fit on paper.
Final things to note
Vertice is an equal opportunities employer, although you must be legally able to work in the specified region of the job. Any personal data you provide will be processed in accordance with Vertice's privacy policy and applicable data protection law.

Why AssemblyAI

AssemblyAI builds the best-in-class Voice AI models powering the next generation of voice applications. We have a lab, and we also power our own models in our own proprietary inference environment. Our models serve 500M+ inference calls monthly, and process nearly 2 million hours of audio daily. The Voice AI space is at an inflection point; we’re looking for the best talent we can find to join a rapidly scaling team that's defining the future of the industry.

We are one of the most capital-efficient AI companies on the planet - and are rapidly approaching $1M ARR per employee. We sit among the top 5 most revenue-dense teams within the fastest-growing AI companies today. We have thousands of customers building with us including the top startups and world-renowned enterprises, and are serving at tremendous scale: we process nearly 2 million hours of audio daily and handle more than 15 million API calls every day. This is a rare growth-stage opportunity where the business is proven, the revenue is durable, and the growth trajectory is steep and getting steeper. We have a super flat culture and expect our employees to be deeply intimate with the details at all levels.

If you've ever felt buried under layers of bureaucracy, starved of real ownership, or frustrated watching your work disappear into a slow-moving org, AssemblyAI is built differently. The company operates as a true meritocracy, with no heavy planning or approval processes and no gatekeeping on the tools or information you need. For anyone who genuinely cares about voice AI, not as a trend to chase, but as a technology to build, this is the place where the most interesting problems at the most interesting scale are being solved by a team small enough that you'll actually know everyone's name.

About the role:

We’re looking for an AI Native Startups Account Executive to own a book of accounts and drive revenue across AssemblyAI’s Voice AI infrastructure offerings. This person will generate pipeline in target accounts, develop strong champions, lead model evaluations, and win over engineering and product leaders at the fastest-growing AI-native companies building with voice. The ideal candidate has a strong background in infrastructure or API sales, thrives on building pipeline from scratch, and is energized by working with technical buyers on products that win on performance and developer experience.

This is a cross-functional role that requires close partnership with Applied AI, Research, Engineering, Marketing, and Deployment to shape go-to-market strategy and deliver an exceptional customer experience from first touch through deployment and beyond.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own a book of AI-native startup accounts, leading potential customers across the full sales cycle from prospecting through initial production rollout
  • Generate pipeline through proactive, creative outbound - including personalized outreach, conferences, exclusive events, and finding warm introductions
  • Craft outbound communications that deliver real value to prospects - custom benchmarks, competitive insights, use-case-specific demos that earn replies
  • Develop authentic champions within target accounts who advocate for AssemblyAI internally and help shepherd deals to close
  • Engage multiple leadership stakeholders in parallel - CTO, CPO, VP Engineering, VP Product, VP of AI, and other technical decision-makers - to build consensus and de-risk deals
  • Position AssemblyAI’s value and pricing against alternatives with clear, quantitative and qualitative differentiation
  • Drive urgency through business value at every touchpoint, keeping deals moving forward with intent
  • Quarterback complex, multi-threaded deals - bringing insights, perspective, and momentum to every customer interaction
  • Partner closely with Customer and Technology Teams to represent the voice of the AI-native customer and shape go-to-market strategy

What You’ll Need:

  • 2+ years of infrastructure or API sales experience closing deals with engineering and product audiences
  • A track record of building pipeline from scratch - experience breaking into cold accounts and creating opportunities where none existed
  • Technical fluency - comfortable discussing API architectures, model accuracy tradeoffs, and deployment options with engineers and technical decision-makers
  • Demonstrated ability to identify and develop champions who advocate internally on your behalf
  • A high sense of urgency and ownership; you move deals forward and don’t let them go stale
  • Comfort selling in a frictionless, product-led motion where customers stay because the product wins
  • Deep understanding of procurement, legal, and security review processes, with the ability to drive velocity through complex commercial cycles
  • A willingness to travel to drive impact - expect to be on the road 50%+ of each month for customer visits, industry events, and team offsites
  • Must be based in San Francisco or New York City, with an expectation of 3 days a week in-office attendance to start but flexible schedule

Pay Transparency:

AssemblyAI strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity across our team. Our salary ranges are set to be competitive for our size, stage, and industry, and reflect just one component of the full compensation, benefits, and rewards we offer.

Salary determinations consider a variety of factors, including relevant experience, technical depth, skills demonstrated during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below represents a general expectation for the posted position. However, we are open to considering candidates who may fall above or below the outlined experience level—in those cases, we will communicate any adjustments to the expected salary range.

The range provided applies to candidates located in the London, England. For candidates outside of this area, compensation ranges may differ; any adjustments will be communicated throughout the interview process.

Salary range: £140,000 - £180,000 OTE

  • Personally lead and close the region's most strategic deals, acting as executive sponsor for key accounts and engaging CTOs, CPOs, founders, and heads of AI directly

  • Drive an outbound-first culture where pipeline is created, not waited for, and where outreach earns replies through real technical insight
  • Navigate the region's commercial and regulatory landscape (GDPR, the EU AI Act, data residency, DPAs, and enterprise security reviews) with Legal and Security, so compliance becomes an advantage, not a blocker
  • Make AssemblyAI the name European builders think of for voice AI: represent us at conferences, meetups, and community events, and partner with Marketing on regional demand
  • Bring the European voice of the customer to Product, Research, and the leadership team - which languages, accents, and deployment requirements are winning or losing deals, and what we need to ship next

What You'll Need:

  • 10+ years in technical B2B sales or GTM, with 5+ years leading teams with Europe responsibility
  • A track record of building a region or segment from an early footprint, ideally for a US-headquartered, venture-backed company: you've hired the first team, opened the first major accounts, and scaled revenue meaningfully, not inherited a mature org
  • Experience selling APIs, infrastructure, or developer platforms to engineering and product buyers, ideally in a usage-based or consumption model

We're hiring a Software Engineer to help turn cutting-edge AI research into products our customers rely on every day. You'll sit on a fast-paced engineering team between our research org and our Applied teams, taking new model capabilities from proof of concept to robust, well-documented APIs serving production traffic at scale.

What You’ll Do:

  • Partner with researchers to productionize new techniques. For example, turning a notebook or POC into something with the latency, reliability, and ergonomics customers expect.

  • Contribute across the stack as needed: backend services, inference infrastructure, SDKs, internal tooling.

Location: UK (Remote)
ABOUT XYZ REALITY
──────────────────────────────
XYZ Reality are the creators of the world's first and only engineering-grade Augmented Reality solution, purpose built for the construction industry. Not only have we created this holographic technology, that sits within The Atom, a smart, site-safe headset/hardhat, but we implement it on projects, utilising the power of AR to ensure that all schemes are completed in line with delivery timescales and budgets.
XYZ has grown to over 100 staff across the UK, US & Europe and is working with Mission Critical organisations & construction companies to successfully deliver major projects.
THE ROLE
──────────────────────────────
As an Account Executive, you'll drive new revenue in data centre construction, owning your accounts from first conversation through to expansion.
You'll act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, making the business case for XYZ Reality's engineering-grade AR in terms of ROI, risk reduction and delivery certainty, and managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles through to close.
You'll carry annual and quarterly targets as a core member of our growing revenue team.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
──────────────────────────────
• Own and grow a portfolio of data centre accounts, from winning new business to expanding existing customers, with clear account plans aligned to revenue targets.
• Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles end to end - prospecting, qualification, solution alignment, commercial negotiation and close.
• Build relationships from site teams through to the C-suite, positioning XYZ Reality as a strategic partner rather than a technology vendor.
• Turn customer delivery and cost challenges into compelling business cases that demonstrate ROI, risk reduction and operational impact.
• Work closely with Marketing, Customer Success and Project Delivery so that what we sell is what gets delivered on site, with a smooth handover after close.
• Build your own pipeline within your accounts, keep accurate forecasts and records in Salesforce, and support RFPs and formal bids, where required.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
──────────────────────────────
1. Proven experience owning complex, enterprise sales cycles with annual quotas.
2. Track record of closing six-figure-plus deals with multiple stakeholders and long decision cycles.
3. Strong experience in value-based and solution selling, including account planning.
4. Willing and able to travel domestically and internationally for meetings, demos and site visits.
KEY EXPERIENCE & SKILLS
──────────────────────────────
1. Experience selling into data centre construction or other mission-critical environments.
2. Background in construction technology, SaaS or cloud-based solutions.
3. Comfortable engaging senior executives while also working on site with delivery teams.
4. Excellent communication across technical and non-technical audiences.
5. CRM discipline, ideally Salesforce, and comfort working within structured sales processes.
6. Proactive, coachable and energised by building long-term customer relationships.
BENEFITS
──────────────────────────────
💰 Market leading OTE
🩺 Private healthcare
🏝️ 25 days annual leave + public holidays
🎄 Extra Christmas shutdown days
🥳 Summer & Christmas staff parties
🚀 Make a real-world impact of revolutionising the construction industry

job-boards.greenhouse.io/babyzone/jobs/8.description_excerpt:
Early Years Social & Emotional Learning Practitioner

A rewarding, part-time educator role, ideal for early years or primary practitioners who are passionate about supporting families to build confidence in managing big feelings and everyday moments together.

About Babyzone

At Babyzone, we believe that every child deserves the strongest possible start in life, regardless of their background or circumstances. Our community-driven hubs provide warm, inclusive spaces where families feel welcomed, supported and confident.

Nest is one of Babyzone's practical, research-informed sessions, designed to help parents and children (aged 0-5) build social and emotional skills through play, connection and shared routines. Delivered within our hubs, the programme helps families feel more confident handling tantrums, staying calm under stress, and building connection with their child.

Why This Role is Perfect for You

Are you an experienced early years or primary educator who enjoys working directly with families? Are you confident leading small groups and passionate about learning through play and relationship?

This role is particularly suited to practitioners seeking flexible, part-time work alongside other roles or commitments. It offers a meaningful opportunity to deliver high quality, curriculum-based sessions while being part of a supportive, values-driven organisation.

The Opportunity

As a Nest Practitioner, you will deliver Babyzone's Nest curriculum at Babyzone Blackburn each week. You will play a vital role in creating a warm, engaging and safe environment where parents, carers and children learn together, with the carer-child relationship at the centre of every session.

You will:

  • Deliver the Nest curriculum with fidelity, ensuring sessions follow the intended structure, learning goals and ethos
  • Lead fixed ritual elements such as the Hello Song, Feelings Map check-in and Goodbye Song, which give children a predictable and regulating structure across the programme
  • Make small, appropriate adjustments to delivery in response to the needs of local families while preserving core content
  • Prepare thoroughly for each session, including completing required online pre delivery modules on the Babyzone learning platform
  • Create a warm, inclusive and supportive atmosphere where all families feel

encouraged to participate, without ever requiring participation

  • Model calm, regulated adult presence, understanding that children borrow calm from the adults around them
  • Manage group dynamics to maintain a calm, positive and engaging session environment
  • Prioritise safeguarding, safety and wellbeing at all times, in line with Babyzone expectations
  • Work collaboratively with the Hub Manager and wider Babyzone team to support smooth hub delivery and continuous improvement
  • Support the set-up and breakdown of the Babyzone space and be available during hub hours on delivery days
  • Maintain accurate attendance and session records, delivering sessions to a
  • maximum of 12 families per session.

What You’ll Need We’re looking for someone who:

  • Has professional teaching experience with nursery, pre-primary or primary-aged children
  • Has a strong understanding of early childhood development and social and
  • emotional learning
  • Is confident building trust and rapport with families from diverse backgrounds
  • Communicates clearly and confidently with both adults and children
  • Is reliable, organised and comfortable delivering structured, curriculum-based sessions
  • Has a strong awareness of safeguarding responsibilities and a commitment to safe practice

Personal Attributes

You will be someone who:

  • Is deeply aligned with Babyzone's mission, values and way of working
  • Brings warmth, kindness and respect to their work with families
  • Is enthusiastic about children's emotional development and passionate aboutsupporting families' confidence
  • Is reflective, open to feedback and committed to developing their practice
  • Is dependable and excited to contribute to a positive Babyzone community setting

Role Details

  • Location: Blackburn Youth Zone, Jubilee Street, Blackburn, BB1 1EP
  • Hours: Wednesdays 9:30-2:30 (term time only)
  • Contract: Part-time, self-employed (professional indemnity and public liability insurance required)
  • Pay: £175 per delivery day
  • Start Date: 2nd of November 2026
  • Reports to: Hub Manager / Programme Lead

What We Offer

  • Full training on the Nest curriculum and Babyzone ethos
  • A supportive team environment with ongoing coaching and guidance
  • Flexible, part-time work that fits around other commitments
  • The opportunity to make a meaningful impact on families' early emotional development

job-boards.greenhouse.io/babyzone/jobs/7.description_excerpt:
Babyzone Glasgow Family Engagement Lead

About Babyzone

At Babyzone, we believe that every child deserves a fair start in life, regardless of their background or circumstances. Our mission is to empower families and their children, from conception to age five, by providing access to high-quality early years learning opportunities that nurture the parent-child bond.

The need for support in early childhood development has never been more critical. Babyzone is a charity funded by foundations, philanthropists and trusts, including global venture builder Blenheim Chalcot.

We serve families who struggle to access support elsewhere due to financial, geographic or cultural barriers by offering free, evidence-based classes and resources in premium, fully accessible community hubs.

With eight Babyzone Hubs already open across the UK, a ninth about to open in Swansea, we are thrilled to announce the launch of our tenth Babyzone in Glasgow.

Reporting to the Head of Babyzone, the Family Engagement Lead is responsible for supporting the smooth running of Babyzone delivery days and creating a welcoming, positive experience for families attending the Hub. The role includes set-up and operations, front-of-house and family engagement responsibilities, close-down duties and additional support as required.

The Family Engagement Lead will need strong organisational and interpersonal skills, confidence engaging with families and stakeholders, sound problem-solving abilities and the flexibility to respond to changing needs throughout the day.

Key Responsibilities

Set-up and Operations

  • Ensure optimal preparation of areas in Easterhouse Sports Centre intended for sessions, including moving furniture, adjusting layouts and making other necessary changes.
  • Support class leaders with the set-up and pack-down of their equipment.
  • Support the set-up of exploratory play zones, projector feeds and other elements required to create a welcoming and functional environment.
  • Ensure families have easy access to essential amenities such as pram parking and baby-changing facilities.

Family Engagement and Front of House

  • Provide a warm, supportive and inclusive welcome to all families attending Babyzone.
  • Explain how Babyzone operates and share relevant information with families.
  • Capture family attendance numbers and basic postcode data as families arrive.
  • Act as a visible and approachable point of contact for families throughout the day.
  • Support positive engagement with families and help ensure they have a welcoming experience.
  • Problem-solve any issues raised by families or class leaders during the day.
  • Welcome external stakeholders visiting Babyzone and support tours alongside the Head of Babyzone.

Close Down

  • Assist class leaders in packing away equipment used for exploratory play and classes.
  • Return areas within Easterhouse Sports Centre to their original set-up.
  • Ensure all rooms are cleared of Babyzone equipment and materials.
  • Report attendee numbers and any relevant observations or issues to the Head of Babyzone.

Additional Duties

  • Supervise and guide additional volunteers, apprentices or support staff as required.
  • Respond to and action reasonable requests from the Head of Babyzone.
  • Build positive relationships with families attending Babyzone.
  • Collect quotes, feedback and case studies from parents in line with the cadence agreed by the Head of Babyzone.

Safeguarding and Compliance

  • Complete all required safeguarding training in a timely manner, as directed by the Safeguarding Lead and Head of Babyzone. This must be completed before the first day in post.
  • Adhere to safeguarding policies and help maintain a culture of safety for children, families and staff.
  • Report any safeguarding concerns or incidents to the Head of Babyzone or Safeguarding Lead as soon as possible.
  • Adhere to all Babyzone policies and procedures.

Skills and Technical Competencies

Organisation
Ability to coordinate multiple tasks effectively and contribute to the smooth running of Babyzone delivery days.

Interpersonal and Family Engagement Skills
Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage positively and sensitively with families, class leaders, colleagues and external stakeholders.

Problem-solving
Ability to respond effectively to issues as they arise and help ensure a positive experience for families and other attendees.

Flexibility
Willingness to adapt to changing needs and undertake additional duties as required.

Values Alignment
A passion for Babyzone’s mission and a commitment to making a positive impact within the local community.

Role Details

  • Salary: £13.45 per hour (Real Living Wage)
  • Contract: Part-time, permanent, term-time only
  • Hours: Fridays, term-time only (8:15am–3:00pm)
  • Location: Babyzone Hub Glasgow at Easterhouse Sports Centre (G34 9HQ)
  • Start Date: May 2026

Benefits

  • 33 days’ annual leave including bank holidays, pro-rated
  • Flexible working pattern to suit your lifestyle
  • Matched pension contributions, if eligible
  • A supportive and inclusive working culture
  • The opportunity to be part of a national network making a real difference

job-boards.greenhouse.io/babyzone/jobs/8.description_excerpt:
Family Engagement Lead - Babyzone Preston

  • 8:30am to 3:00pm on Wednesdays in term time
  • £13.45 per hour
  • Based at Inspire Vault Youth Zone, Tithebarn Street, Preston, PR1 1DN
  • Reporting to the Head of Babyzone Preston

About Babyzone:

Babyzone is a charity which aims to support parents with children in the early years, aged 0 to 5 years.  We are focused on removing barriers that many parents face in accessing high quality early years provision.

Babyzones are made up of soft play and evidence-based early years classes, one day a week in a clean, safe and welcoming environment. We design our approach around the needs of families who may not otherwise be able to access this support but are open to all. Parents and carers do not sign up in advance; there is no charge and we do not ask for any personal details. We believe that by removing barriers we are creating a fully accessible, inclusive place for parents and carers to bring their children to talk, read, sing and play together.  Babyzone Preston is a brand new Babyzone and we hope to be welcoming 180+ families each week as we do in our other Babyzone sites.

The role:

The Babyzone Family Engagement Lead is the face of Babyzone for our families and is responsible for ensuring that the set up and operations of the Babyzone run smoothly throughout the day.

Key activities:

  • Setting up and packing away Babyzone each Wednesday. This will include preparing the space by moving furniture, adjusting the layout to meet the needs of the families and ensuring that the space is clear of any hazards.
  • Supporting the external class leads with equipment that is required to deliver the Babyzone each week.
  • Supporting with the set up and packing away of the exploratory areas/soft play areas and overseeing these areas during the day (making sure there is no food or shoes on the mats, keeping the space tidy, safe and free of hazards).
  • Setting up and maintaining additional elements such as a book corner and ensuring easy access to buggy parking and the baby-changing facilities.
  • Personally, welcoming each family to Babyzone, engaging with families and their children throughout the day, facilitating relationships, building community and signposting to local services.
  • Capturing family numbers by entering basic postcode data into a digital form as families arrive at Babyzone
  • Acting as a point of contact and problem solver for any issues during the day that are raised by families or class leaders to ensure the smooth running of the Babyzone.
  • Welcoming external stakeholders to Babyzone
  • Championing the Babyzone ethos and mission
  • Meeting regularly with the Head of Babyzone Preston to share good practice

Your skills and experience:

  • You must love engaging with all families and young children
  • Understand and care about Babyzone’s mission
  • Be motivated and committed to the Babyzone principles and show sensitivity to the needs of the families who visit Babyzone
  • Be energetic and proactive, remaining calm under pressure
  • Value and support everyone who comes into contact with Babyzone with an awareness of, and commitment to equal opportunities, equality and diversity
  • Have an awareness of the importance of safeguarding children and understand that this is the responsibility of everyone
  • Be comfortable with the physical demands of moving furniture around and be up for the challenge of a quick set up and close down process
  • Work effectively as part of a team
  • Have excellent verbal communication skills

Babyzone will offer:

  • Safeguarding training and DBS check
  • Training and development opportunities

Babyzone is committed to safer recruitment practice as an important part of safeguarding and protecting children and vulnerable adults.  If successful in your application for this role, you will have a DBS check approved prior to your first day in the job.

job-boards.greenhouse.io/cais/jobs/86121.description_excerpt:
CAIS is the pioneer in democratizing access to and education about alternative investments for independent financial advisors, empowering them to engage and transact with leading asset managers on a massive scale through a wide variety of alternative investment products and technology solutions. CAIS provides financial advisors with a broad selection of alternative investment strategies, including hedge funds, private equity, private credit, real estate, digital assets, and structured notes. CAIS also delivers industry-leading technology, operational efficiency, and world-class client service throughout the pre-trade, trade, and post-trade experience. CAIS serves over 2,500 wealth management firms that support more than 65,000 financial advisors who oversee approximately $8.5 trillion in end-client assets.

Application security sits at the center of how CAIS earns and keeps the trust of the advisors and asset managers who rely on our platform. As our lead for application security, you will own how we protect the applications and services we build and embedding security into the heart of how we design, write, and ship software.

You will define and drive our approach to secure development: setting threat modeling strategy, owning security architecture and secure code reviews, and designing the controls that live inside our SDLC. Just as importantly, you will use automation and AI to scale that work, turning security from a manual checkpoint into something engineers experience as fast, clear, and genuinely useful.

We are looking for a hands-on technical leader who is as comfortable reading production code as setting strategy. You are someone who enjoys partnering with engineers and product owners; you are eager to experiment with new technologies to raise our security bar across the stack, and you are easy to do business with. You see a growing security practice not as a constraint to enforce but as a capability to build, one that helps us ship reliable products, grow as engineers, and have some fun along the way.

Responsibilities

Secure Software Development & Architecture

  • Own security elements of the software development lifecycle, designing and implementing automated controls within CI/CD, including SAST, DAST, dependency and container security scanning.
  • Conduct security architecture and design reviews across product and platform areas, surfacing risk early and providing clear, actionable remediation paths.
  • Drive CAIS's threat modeling strategy, establishing it as a repeatable practice across teams rather than a one-off exercise.

Vulnerability Management & Engineering Partnership

  • Triage, validate, and prioritize findings, coordinating remediation through to resolution with clear ownership and follow-through.
  • Liaise with key vendors on penetration testing, vulnerability scanning, and threat modeling, translating external findings into prioritized action.
  • Partner with engineers and product owners to embed security pragmatically into design, development, and release, supporting teams without becoming a blocker.
  • Provide secure coding guidance and clear documentation that helps teams understand risk and apply secure development practices independently.
  • Level up CAIS's security capability across the tech stack, experimenting with new tooling, automation, and AI-assisted workflows as the practice grows.

Required Experience

  • Experience in application or product security teams. A software engineering background is
  • Ability to read and reason about production code and hold your own with senior engineers, with working knowledge of Java/Kotlin and JavaScript/TypeScript (React).
  • Solid AWS security experience, including securing cloud-native, containerized environments (e.g. EKS).
  • Hands-on experience with security tooling across the SDLC, such as SAST, DAST, and dependency or container scanning (specific products are not important).
  • Demonstrated experience driving threat modeling and leading security architecture and design reviews.
  • Proven ability to lead engineering and security teams in adopting AI tools and automated workflows when it comes to security as part of the SDLC .
  • A confident, collaborative communicator who partners effectively with engineers and product owners and explains risk clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • A builder's mindset, you are energized by growing an application security practice from an early stage, eager to experiment and collaborative along the way.

CAIS is consistently recognized as a Best Place to Work, and our culture is at the heart of our success. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where employees can be their most authentic self and feel inspired and supported to bring their voice forward to drive community, growth, and innovation. We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Learn more about our culture, benefits, and people at https://www.caisgroup.com/our-company/careers

We use technology, including AI tools, to support parts of our recruitment process such as application screening, interview scheduling, and candidate communications. These tools are used to improve efficiency and consistency, but they do not replace human judgement. All hiring decisions are made by people, and we are committed to fair and unbiased assessment of every candidate.

About CAIS
CAIS is the pioneer in democratizing access to and education about alternative investments for independent financial advisors, empowering them to engage and transact with leading asset managers on a massive scale through a wide variety of alternative investment products and technology solutions. CAIS serves over 2,500 wealth management firms that support more than 65,000 financial advisors who oversee approximately $8.5 trillion in end-client assets. 

About the role
We’re looking for a Senior Backend Product Engineer to join our Capital Markets technology team in London. This is a hybrid, hands-on role: you’ll design, build and run systems across Pre-Trade, Trade and Post-Trade, covering Structured Investments, Equity IPOs, Hedging & Monetization, ETFs, and more. This is a hybrid role, with at least 2-3 days spent out of our Old Street office - N1 7LB. 

We put a lot of emphasis on the “product” in product engineer. You’ll work alongside product managers and directly with the business to turn open-ended problems into working software, and the results show up in how a fast-growing company performs. AI is a big part of how we work: the team uses it throughout the development lifecycle and has already shipped several agentic features. You’ll help build the next ones. 

We work in small, autonomous teams using the Kanban principles of optimizing flow and limiting WIP. The team owns its work together, from shaping the problem through to running it in production. We collaborate closely with colleagues and stakeholders in New York. Engineers own their work from shaping the problem through to running it in production. While we have access to QA expertise, we consider quality to be everyone’s responsibility, so engineers own testing too. We care about strong engineering fundamentals, especially as AI changes how we build. 

You’ll mostly write Kotlin, working with Spring, Postgres, Elasticsearch and Kafka, and deploying to Kubernetes on AWS through GitHub and ArgoCD. 

Why join us 

  • Real ownership: you’ll shape problems with the business, not just pick up tickets 
  • Visible impact: your work shows up directly in how a fast-growing business performs 
  • Interesting domain: complex, real-world problems across the full trade lifecycle 
  • Engineering quality: strong fundamentals and high standards 
  • Modern codebase: we’ve moved off legacy, and our systems have been built in the last few years 

Skills & Experience 

  • Experience working as a software developer with Java or Kotlin server-side applications 
  • Track record of turning business problems into working software, with a clear, measurable impact 
  • Experience building and running mission-critical services in production, from CI/CD through to monitoring, alerting and incident response 
  • Strong testing habits across unit, integration and end-to-end tests, with good judgment about what to test at each level

jobs.ashbyhq.com/tandem-health/3dcbdefe-.description_excerpt:
BUILD SOMETHING MONUMENTAL FOR HEALTHCARE!
At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.
We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!
ABOUT THE ROLE
We’re looking for an Account Executive to help drive Tandem’s growth across the UK private healthcare market.
This is a commercial, full-cycle sales role for an ambitious Account Executive who enjoys building relationships, winning new business, and taking ownership of opportunities. You’ll manage the sales process from prospecting and discovery through to negotiation, close, and handover to our Delivery and Medical Operations teams.
You’ll work with healthcare professionals and decision-makers to understand their needs and demonstrate how Tandem can create value for their organisation.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Own and deliver against a personal sales target across UK private healthcare.
- Build pipeline through outbound prospecting, inbound leads, referrals, and events.
- Manage opportunities through the full sales cycle, from first contact to close.
- Build relationships with healthcare professionals and decision-makers across private healthcare.
- Run discovery calls, product demos, and commercial conversations.
- Work closely with Delivery and Medical Operations to ensure a smooth customer handover.
- Collaborate with Marketing, Product, and Leadership to improve our sales approach and market positioning.
- Represent Tandem at relevant healthcare events and conferences.
- Maintain strong CRM, pipeline, and forecasting discipline.
WHAT YOU BRING
- Demonstrable experience in B2B sales and new business, ideally in SaaS, digital health, or technology.
- Track record of achieving sales targets and progressing opportunities through a sales funnel.
- Experience with outbound prospecting and managing sales opportunities through to close.
- Strong communication, presentation, and consultative selling skills.
- Interest in and ideally some understanding of the UK private healthcare market.
- Commercially minded, driven, curious, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong ownership and willingness to learn and develop as a salesperson.
- Genuine enthusiasm for technology and AI.
BONUS POINTS
- Experience selling SaaS, digital health, or AI.
- Experience selling into UK private healthcare, including providers, practices, consultants, or insurers.
- Experience with clinical or healthcare workflows.
- Experience in a startup or scale-up environment.
HOW TO APPLY
We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.
Our interview process consists of stages:
1. Screening interview with Talent Acquisition
2. First interview with Country Director UK&I
3. Sales Demo with Commercial Lead UK&I
4. Working Day - Join us in the London office for a day to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.
BENEFITS
- Competitive salary & company stock options
- 30 days/year of paid vacation
- £800 wellness budget per year
- Generous Parental leave top-up for new parents
- Private Medical Insurance to stay healthy
- Mental health support through our partner Mindler
- Pension program
- Social and team-building activities (off-sites, after works, winter/summer parties)
- An opportunity to make a real positive impact in the world of healthcare
- Work with some of the best minds in AI, healthcare, and engineering.
We review our benefits packages on a regular basis and might modify our benefits from time to time.
CULTURE AT TANDEM
At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.
Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.

About CreativeX

CreativeX is B2B SaaS technology platform that helps global marketing teams make smarter creative decisions and elevate creative expression through the clarity of data. Our technology powers creative decision-making at some of the biggest brands in the world, including Google, Unilever, Pepsi, Bayer, Mondelez, Heineken, and more.

We use computer vision and other machine learning techniques to extract creative data from our client's digital advertising copy and transform those previously dark signals into a standardised data model at industrial scale. This creates a new, unique and powerful first party data set that represents the last and most impactful untapped reservoir of advertising performance.

That's because multiple studies have shown that the "Creative" itself is responsible for half of sales lift online, higher than reach, targeting, brand, & recency combined. But creative impact has always been the least analysed and least understood component of a complex set of marketing variables.

This is the problem CreativeX is focussed on solving. We're an end-to-end solution to ingest, process, and analyse content at scale. We help brands isolate creative elements so they can be analysed against downstream ad impact metrics, from clickthrough rates to brand lift.

Our objective is to help marketing organisations power every creative decision with data.

Product Design Team

As a Product Designer, you'll help shape the next generation of the CreativeX platform, taking problems from discovery through to shipped experiences across defined areas of the product. You'll be the design lead in a product trio alongside a Product Manager and an Engineering Lead, owning whether users want what we build and whether they can figure out how to use it, while sharing discovery, outcomes and trade-offs with your partners. Our roadmap is framed as problems to solve, not screens to make, so we expect you to bring a point of view.   • Join customer conversations and use what you hear to shape your design decisions

  • Shape how design works at CreativeX as the team grows, including supporting newer designers

Who you are

  • Strong interaction and visual design craft, confident in Figma, prototyping and design systems, and familiar with Slack and Linear

Role: System Integration Engineer (Maternity Cover)

Department: Engineering - Hardware

Location: London

Reports into: Head of Hardware Platforms

Contract: Fixed Term - 12 months

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a System Integration Engineer to join our hardware team on a 12 month fixed term contract, covering a period of maternity leave.

Our hardware team designs, integrates and industrialises the media servers and processing hardware behind live events, broadcast, theatre and immersive experiences. System Integration Engineers sit at the point where mechanical design, electronics, firmware and operating system software meet, and are responsible for making sure the whole product works as one reliable system rather than a collection of good parts.

This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You will pick up live new product introduction work already in flight, so you will spend your first weeks building context quickly and then run your own areas of the integration and test effort. 

Whilst your primary role will be to build pre-configured Windows OS Images for our different models of server, you will also work closely with mechanical and electronics engineering, firmware and software teams, procurement, and our contract manufacturing and component suppliers.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Integration and bring up

  • Integrate hardware, firmware and operating system elements into working systems and take new builds through bring up.
  • Own the resolution of integration issues end to end, from first symptom through root cause to a verified fix.
  • Contribute to BIOS and operating system level configuration and validation on new platforms.

Test and validation

  • Write, run and maintain hardware test plans covering functional, environmental, thermal and stress testing.
  • Build and improve test rigs, fixtures and automated test scripts to make validation repeatable.
  • Record results clearly and translate test data into engineering decisions and evidence for design sign off.

Working across teams

  • Act as a technical point of contact for internal teams who depend on hardware readiness, including software, product and customer support.
  • Translate technical detail into clear, accessible updates for non specialist audiences, including customer facing notes on hardware and firmware changes.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING

Essential

  • Experience in a hardware, systems or test engineering role, integrating hardware and software into complete products.
  • Practical fault finding ability across electrical, mechanical and software boundaries, with a structured approach to root cause analysis.
  • Comfort with lab equipment and hands on work
  • Working knowledge of PC architecture and server hardware, including BIOS, firmware and operating system installation and configuration.
  • Ability to write clear technical documentation and test procedures that other people can follow.
  • Scripting ability for test automation and data handling, for example Python, Bash or Powershell.
  • Organised and self directed, able to pick up in flight work quickly and keep several workstreams moving.
  • Collaborative and clear communicator, comfortable working with suppliers and with colleagues outside engineering.

Desirable

  • Experience with video and display technologies, including DisplayPort, HDMI, SDI or IP video.
  • Exposure to new product introduction and the transition from prototype to mass-production.
  • Experience working with contract manufacturers and managing supplier quality issues.
  • Familiarity with GPU based servers, high performance computing hardware or real time media processing.
  • Background in live events, broadcast, theatre, film or another creative technology sector.
  • Experience with PLM or ERP systems and formal engineering change control.
  • Familiarity with issue tracking and documentation tools such as Jira and Confluence.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Because this is a fixed term cover role, the first weeks are deliberately weighted towards handover and context building. You will take ownership of your own learning, and in return, you will be given guidance from our Senior Systems Integration engineer. We expect you to have many questions, especially at first! 

First month

  • Completed handover, with a clear picture of active workstreams, open issues and key contacts across engineering, procurement and suppliers.
  • Independently running routine test and integration tasks.
  • You will have built your first Production-ready Windows image.

First three months

  • Owning your own areas of integration and validation, including test planning and issue resolution.
  • Recognised by internal teams and suppliers as the point of contact for those areas.

Across the contract

  • Delivered your assigned integration and validation milestones to schedule and to quality.
  • Left documentation, test assets and issue records in a state that supports a clean handover back at the end of the contract.

Established in 2005 by court reporting professionals, eScribers has grown to become the leader in reporting and transcription services for courts and government agencies across the US and UK & Ireland.
Our company is private equity backed and growing rapidly worldwide, leading the court reporting market in technology innovations and client services. With customers across the US, UK & Ireland, we currently hold offices in Phoenix, Virginia, Maryland, London, Dublin and Israel.

At eScribers we value professionalism, innovative thinking, and collaboration and this is what guides us in all aspects of our day-to-day operations.

Come be a part of our growth by joining our outstanding team of professionals!

 

UK Digital Legal/Court Reporter (Logger/Recording Technician) | Remote (London Based Only - must be able to get to Central London easily and attend in person hearings at least 2-3 days per week, in principle) – Freelance

A digital legal/court reporter attends hearings, in person, to record and take of log of the proceedings. 

eScribers is continually seeking to engage with digital reporters (loggers) in the London area to join our highly skilled and dedicated UK team of professionals.  The eScribers (Limited) UK Group comprises two highly successful reporting and transcription companies, eScribers Limited and Marten Walsh Cherer Limited.  Successful candidates will contract with eScribers Limited and have the option of engaging with either of these entities, both of whom operate independently within the Group, to undertake work. eScribers provides an opportunity to be part of a growing community of encouraging like-minded people who are dedicated to providing high-quality reporting services.  eScribers is ISO9001 certified, which means we are dedicated to providing top-quality services to all our clients.

eScribers currently provides services to Courts, Tribunals, Inquests, Regulatory, and other hearings and meetings.  A Digital Reporter/Logger’s duties will include:

  • Transporting and setting up of digital recording equipment both remotely and on location.
  • Managing the recording and logging of events in a professional and efficient manner, adhering to agreed timescales, and seeking appropriate support when necessary.
  • Communicating effectively and appropriately with colleagues, clients and venue staff in order to best achieve eScribers’ contractual obligations to the highest standards.
  • Building relationships with clients and host venues to ensure the smooth running of the event, and to facilitate the transfer of information to enable a quality transcript to be produced.
  • Possessing an understanding of Court proceedings and basic legal terminology.
  • Providing a high level of customer service and support to all Stakeholders.
  • Identifying and troubleshooting common issues.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy.
  • eScribers offers competitive daily rates.

General Requirements:

  • Reside in the UK
  • Be legally entitled to work in the UK
  • Have a current UK bank account to receive payment
  • Be reliable, with good time management and plenty of flexibility (as proceedings can overrun)
  • Be a confident communicator (written & verbal)
  • Be smart and well presented
  • Be able to remain calm under pressure. Intermediate technical IT/AV troubleshooting skills
  • Good keyboard skills
  • A confident Microsoft Windows, Word user
  • Knowledge and application of English grammar, spelling, punctuation and syntax skills
  • Have good attention to detail and focus
  • Be able to work independently and as part of a team
  • Discretion and the ability to maintain the highest level of confidentiality
  • Problem identification and resolution skills
  • Previous experience as a Digital Reporter/Logger (with some exceptions)
  • Be based in the London area with easy access to Central London (particularly Canary Wharf, Kennington and Farringdon).  The availability to travel within other locations, including Belfast, Birmingham, Bristol, Cardiff and Manchester, including overnight stays, will be a bonus

Other advantages:

  • Understanding of legal terminology
  • Courtroom experience
  • Previous experience as a Digital Reporter/Logger - while this is not essential, varying factors (eg, location, previous experience) may determine suitability.  
  • Be able to work in person (on location) and remotely (eg, in a quiet room in your home)

Basis of Engagement:

Successful candidates will be offered a freelancer contract and will be compensated on agreed rates.  As an independent contractor, you will submit/approve invoices for the work you complete and will be paid via direct deposit.  The nature of freelancing is that the volume of work can fluctuate and there is no guarantee of the level of work that may be offered.  However, priority for work will always be given to those who maintain excellent quality standards and availability to attend in person.

Onboarding:

Successful candidates will be required to undertake the onboarding process that involves, initial aptitude test, telephone/MS Teams interview, submission of documentation, completion of required paperwork (freelancer contract), computer setup, a BPSS (including Criminal Records Check) check (at the candidate’s expense) and familiarisation with the eScribers equipment and software.  Further information will be provided at the appropriate point.

  • Domain & Industry Expertise: Deep domain expertise in complex Supply Chain operations for Energy, Manufacturing or Power Utilities verticals. Understanding of Production operations and industry x.0 initiatives is also required.

Role Qualifications

  • Notable experience in consumer-facing product marketing and subscription-based products
