Role Overview - Primary Objective

To help deliver next generation instruments involving a combination of lasers, electro-optics systems, 3D positioners, high speed CMOS detectors and microfluidics.

How you'll achieve it

Working in the engineering function alongside multidisciplinary engineers, the system engineer is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining Refeyn’s cutting edge technology platforms and will lead and participate in high-level instrument design choices, definition of module boundaries and the integration of new and improved modules/features into the broader technology platform. The system engineer will work closely with research, engineering, software, product, and operations teams, to translate product requirements into technical specifications and actionable design verification plans. The system engineer will be responsible for scoping future product/system requirements, scoping their architecture and how they will fit/interact with our current systems, and planning for this integration/upgrade. They will take ownership for the delivery of all technical and customer facing specification for new products and systems.

Key responsibilities for this role include:  

  • Provide technical and scientific insight to develop/deliver new innovations in the implementation mass photometry for next generation instruments and submodules, including optical/electro-optical design and data analysis approaches, from proof of concept to production handover.
  • Concepting, designing, building and troubleshooting prototype optical microscopy instruments that measure single molecule properties based on the detection of light scattering.
  • Analysing complex data sets taken on custom built hardware to evaluate instrument performance and
  • Working closely with applications specialists, systems engineers and software developers to deliver new designs or features.
  • Understand and define complex technical specifications and requirements and interpret these to realise new designs/features quickly.
  • Actively participating in the growth of Refeyn’s IP portfolio and identifying patentable IP.
  • Keep up to date on the cutting-edge advances in the fields of light microscopy, light scattering and single molecule bioanalytics, with a view to offer novel approaches and improvements to our technology roadmap.

We are ideally looking for someone with the following skills and experience:

  • BSc Engineering (all fields) or equivalent experience
  • Self-starting and excited by the prospect of working alongside/contributing to a multi-disciplinary team focussed on developing novel high-tech instrumentation.
  • Relevant experience in an optics/electro-optics background, for example: a PhD in Microscopy/laser optics/Nano-optics and a degree in a related field
  • Design/alignment/troubleshooting of optical equipment; Building new optics systems in microscopy or similar technologies.
  • Data analysis in C/C++/Python/Matlab or similar package – ability to perform complex analysis on novel data.

We know there is no such thing as the perfect candidate and that there is great value in transferrable skills, so please don’t feel you have to tick all of the above boxes to apply!

Why work for Refeyn?

Compensation and core benefits

  • We anticipate a base salary of £40,000 to £50,000 for this role, depending on candidate experience 
  • 25 days annual leave per year in addition to bank holidays
  • Up to 7% employer matched pension contribution
  • Private health insurance from day one plus Medicash, critical illness cover, income protection and life insurance
  • Give as You Earn and Cycle to Work salary sacrifice schemes.
  • Annual Company and Individual bonus scheme 
  • Paid volunteer day each year

Family Friendly Benefits

Refeyn offers YellowNest Nursery Scheme to all employees once probation is passed, and new parents can benefit from up to 17 weeks fully paid maternity, adoption and shared parental leave, 4 weeks fully paid paternity leave, plus an annual allowance for emergency childcare.

Supporting your Development

All employees receive access to Linkedin Learning which offers thousands of courses to support their personal and professional development. We also run frequent training sessions on both hard and soft skills.

Creating an Engaging Culture

Refeyn supports hybrid working where the role allows and offers flexible start and finish times. We also have a subsidised weekly lunch for onsite employees and a vibrant social calendar which includes holiday parties and midsummer festivals plus an annual team budget for managers to plan team-building activities.

Values-Led 

Refeyn is committed to celebrating each other’s differences and creating a dynamic, driven and diverse culture where everyone can flourish. We are proud to have been awarded Committed Status by the Inclusive Employers Standard in 2024 and are working hard to create a safe and empowering environment for all.

We firmly believe that there is great strength in building teams with different voices, experiences, perspectives, and backgrounds so that we can continue to share the team workload and enable our customers to succeed, and we welcome applicants from all sections of society to join us on our mission to advance discovery through innovation. 

Expected Interview Plan

  • Initial Teams call with the hiring manager (30 minutes)
  • Onsite panel interview with presentation and site tour (90 minutes)
  • Final call with Chief Product and Marketing Officer (30 minutes)

 

Refeyn is proud to use anonymised hiring practices. Identifying information such as a candidate's name, email address, date of birth and photo will not be visible to the hiring manager when they review CVs.

As leaders in personalised healthcare, we empower women on their weight loss journeys through science-backed, GLP-1 focused programmes designed for sustainable, long-term success. Purpose of Role:

The Growth Marketing Manager will own and scale SheMed’s paid social activity, with a primary focus on Meta, alongside other channels such as TikTok, Reddit and X. You’ll be responsible for driving efficient customer acquisition through smart campaign strategy, relentless creative testing, and data-led optimisation. This is a hands-on role for someone who loves performance marketing, moves quickly, and is excited to grow alongside one of the fastest-moving brands in women’s health.

What You'll Work On:

Paid Social Strategy & Performance

  • Own the day-to-day management and optimisation of paid campaigns across Meta and other
    smaller channels.
  • Support testing and growth.
  • Manage large budgets against key performance targets, with a strong focus on CAC, CPA and ROAS.
  • Identify opportunities to scale spend while maintaining acquisition efficiency.
  • Monitor performance daily and move quickly when campaigns or audiences are underperforming.

Creative Testing & Optimisation

  • Build and manage a continuous creative testing roadmap across messaging, formats, audiences and concepts.
  • Work closely with Brand and Creative to develop a consistent pipeline of new performance creative.
  • Turn campaign data into clear creative insights and actionable briefs.
  • Identify winning concepts and iterate quickly to find further opportunities for scale.

Data & Growth

  • Analyse performance across the full acquisition funnel.
  • Use data to understand consumer behaviour and identify opportunities to improve conversion.
  • Produce clear reporting on performance, learnings and next steps.
  • Stay ahead of platform changes, competitor activity and emerging paid social opportunities. 

Cross-Functional Execution

  • Work closely with Growth, Brand, CRM, Product and Data to ensure paid activity supports wider company goals.
  • Coordinate campaigns around key launches, promotions and brand moments.
  • Bring new ideas to the table and proactively identify opportunities rather than waiting for direction.

What We're Looking For:

  • 2–4+ years of hands-on paid social experience, ideally within a high-growth D2C, consumer, health or wellness brand.
  • Strong, hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager, including campaign setup, optimisation, scaling and reporting.
  • Experience running and optimising campaigns on TikTok Ads Manager.
  • A strong understanding of performance metrics including CAC, CPA, ROAS, CTR, CVR and LTV.
  • Experience managing meaningful paid media budgets and making confident budget allocation decisions.
  • Strong understanding of creative testing and what makes paid social creative convert.
  • Commercial and analytical mindset with the ability to turn data into clear actions.
  • Highly organised and able to manage multiple campaigns, tests and priorities at once.
  • Comfortable working at speed in an environment where priorities can change quickly.
  • Proactive, ambitious and eager to take ownership rather than wait to be told what to do.
  • Strong communicator who can work effectively across creative, data, product and marketing teams.
  • Excited by SheMed's mission and motivated by the opportunity to grow with the company.

  • Monthly socials

Purpose of Role:
SheMed is looking for a Head of Retention to own our end-to-end retention strategy, from the numbers that define success to the team and processes that deliver it. You’ll set the strategic direction for how we keep members engaged and in-programme for longer, and you’ll build the operating model and team needed to execute it.

This is a build-and-run role. You’ll spend the first chapter defining the strategy and standing up the team and testing infrastructure, and every chapter after that using data and experimentation to compound retention gains. You’ll work daily across Product, Tech, CRM, Support and Strategy, and you’ll be the person leadership turns to for “what’s our retention number going to be, and what are we doing about it.”

What You'll Work On:
Own the retention strategy

  • Define SheMed’s end-to-end retention strategy, from onboarding through renewal, and translate leadership goals into a clear roadmap with owners and outcomes.
  • Set the retention agenda rather than just coordinate other people’s initiatives, make the call on where to invest, what to sunset, and what to prioritise when trade-offs come up.
  • Own the retention P&L logic: understand how retention moves LTV, CAC payback, and overall unit economics, and make the case for investment accordingly.

Build and lead the team

  • Design and build out a dedicated retention function , define the roles you need (e.g. lifecycle, retention analyst, experimentation), hire, and manage the team as it grows.
  • Set ways of working for the function: how work gets prioritised, how experiments get greenlit, how wins get shared back to the business.

Test, learn, and experiment

  • Build a structured experimentation programme (A/B and multivariate testing) covering lifecycle messaging, in-app journeys, onboarding, win-back, and pricing/packaging levers that affect retention.
  • Establish a test-and-learn cadence: hypothesis backlog, prioritisation framework, statistical rigour, and a clear loop from insight to shipped change.
  • Be scrappy where speed matters and rigorous where the stakes are high, know which mode a given initiative calls for.

Drive cross-functional execution

  • Be the connective tissue across Marketing, Product, Tech, Clinical, CRM and Support so retention tactics are aligned, not duplicated, and executed with clear accountability.
  • Partner with Product and Clinical to introduce features that support retention directly,  habit-forming mechanics, health tracking, milestone recognition, member-exclusive content.
  • Support the design of segmented, personalised email, SMS, and in-app journeys tied to customer education, milestones, and health goals.

Measure and report

  • Partner with the data team to define success metrics for every retention initiative; own churn rate, LTV, cohort retention curves, and forecasting.
  • Work with the data team to build retention dashboards and reporting that show what’s working, what isn’t, and why and then importantly use them to drive decisions, not just describe history.
  • Report on progress against KPIs monthly, quarterly and annually to leadership.

Build the voice-of-member feedback loop

  • Launch in-product surveys, calls, and forums to understand why members stay and why they leave.
  • Turn qualitative insight (Product, CX, Marketing) into an actionable, prioritised backlog of retention initiatives.

What We Are Looking For:

  • Have ~6 years of experience in a retention, growth, lifecycle, or customer engagement role — ideally in a healthtech, DTC, or subscription-based startup.
  • Strong organisational skills and ability to keep multiple teams aligned and focused on goals.
  • Data-driven mindset with a proven track record of hitting retention targets.
  • Have a strong grasp of lifecycle marketing tools (Braze, Salesforce) 
  • Are energised by fast-paced, high-growth environments where things are always changing.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills with experience working cross-functionally.
  • Creative problem-solver with a passion for building community and driving customer loyalty.

  • Health care Cash Plan including physio, digital clinical appointments and wellbeing for you, your partner and children

We are seeking a highly analytical, commercially minded Senior Data Analyst, Marketing to become a key partner to the marketing team at SheMed.

This role will be embedded within marketing, helping the team make smarter, faster, data-led decisions across acquisition, retention, customer journeys, and campaign performance. You will drive the measurement of key growth channels, including Meta, Google, and influencer partnerships, and provide clear insight into what is working, what is not, and where we should focus next.

You will play a critical role in connecting marketing behaviour with wider business performance, including subscription metrics, customer acquisition cost, lifetime value, and retention.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with excellent commercial judgement and communication skills. You should be comfortable working with complex datasets, but equally confident translating your analysis into clear, non-technical narratives for senior leadership.

Please note: This is an office-based role, Monday to Friday, 9am – 6pm. We are based in Euston, London.

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON:

  • Own marketing performance measurement across channels including Meta, Google, paid social, affiliates, and influencer partnerships.
  • Develop attribution frameworks to evaluate acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue performance.
  • Partner with marketing teams to optimise campaigns, audience targeting, creative performance, and budget allocation.
  • Analyse the end-to-end customer journey to identify drop-off points, behavioural trends, and growth opportunities.
  • Deliver insights to improve conversion, onboarding, CRM, lifecycle communications, retention, and customer value.
  • Own reporting and analysis for key subscription KPIs including CAC, LTV, payback period, churn, retention, conversion rate, subscription growth, and channel ROI.
  • Apply advanced analytics using SQL, Python, or R for cohort analysis, forecasting, predictive modelling, and Marketing Mix Modelling.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and self-serve reporting in Tableau to support data-driven decision-making.
  • Translate complex analysis into clear, actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders.
  • Use SQL and dbt to develop trusted, scalable data models and analytics infrastructure.
  • Collaborate with data, marketing, product, medical, finance, and leadership teams to align insights with business priorities.
  • Support analysis of customer engagement and health outcomes in partnership with clinical and product teams.
  • Proactively identify opportunities, challenge assumptions with evidence, and help teams move from data to decisions.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

  • 3–5+ years of experience in marketing analytics, growth analytics, commercial analytics, or a similar data-focused role.
  • Experience working in a high-growth, fast-paced environment, ideally within D2C healthcare, subscription, consumer health, wellness, ecommerce, or a startup environment.

At Signifyd, we help merchants confidently grow their businesses by building trusted relationships with their customers. Our advanced technology, combined with a team genuinely invested in our clients’ success, creates frictionless shopping experiences, approving more good orders, protecting revenue, and keeping customers happy.

Trusted by thousands of leading merchants across more than 100 countries, we securely process billions of transactions each year. Our people are the heart of everything we do, driving our mission forward with commitment, empathy, and creativity. Join us on our mission to empower confident, fraud-free commerce by helping online retailers provide superior customer experiences and eliminate fraud. Learn about our company values here!

Signifyd is one of the world’s leading tech start-ups! They develop best-in-class AI fraud prevention software; which helps make the world a better place. As an intern, you'll be given a masterclass into the software development lifecycle. You'll get to work with amazing colleagues on complex challenges. Within your first week as an intern, you'll be deploying code changes that affect millions of online orders. It's an exceptional place to work, with an awesome culture & work-life balance.

As an Engineering Intern, you’ll make things happen!

Our Intern Software Engineers will have the opportunity to gain industry-leading insight, guidance and support to learn our technology stack and grow very quickly into fully productive members of our team; no bench sitting!  

If you want help, you'll get it - from all quarters - but we’ll encourage you to figure out what needs to be done, identify who is in the best position to make it happen; and if that’s you, roll up your sleeves and get stuck in! 

Our Signifyd stack: Java, Cassandra, ElasticSearch, BigQuery, MySQL, Play! framework, gRPC, Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, GCP, AI (Claude, Cursor) 

What support can you expect:

We’ll provide you with a solid investment in your individual growth and development including an individual development plan, mentoring from industry professionals, and a spot on a small peer-led team to provide great opportunities to learn.

What you’ll get to do:

  • From the outset you’ll contribute to our features and products and participate fully in your team’s responsibilities
  • Participate in daily stand-ups from the get-go
  • Be part of a team who are responsible for the full lifecycle of their products: design, development, unit testing, integration testing, deployment, monitoring and iterative improvement
  • Be part of a team who are responsible for the full technology stack related to their product or feature; from the user level APIs right down to the databases, streams, and queues, that back the functionality

To know if we’re a great fit for you, you’ll:

  • Be working towards a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering 
  • Have an interest or desire to work with Java, Python, SQL or any of our development stack, or you’ll have worked with some of our stack before on your own time or for your own projects
  • Be willing to ask for help if you need it
  • Be comfortable making a mistake, but be willing to learn from it
  • Be open to learning from others and always curious to know more

What will you get in return:

  • A competitive base salary
  • Free snacks and drinks in the office
  • Have a great setup and working environment to help you do your job
  • Take part in (or drive) our social/community events

  • Please list University modules and results on your CV
  • Start Date: July 2027

You’ll have inbound interest, RFP opportunities, partner introductions and creative outreach to work with, alongside Commercial Associates and a team that gets behind its sellers. Your job is to turn that opportunity into lasting customer relationships and revenue.

About us

Compliance, built like product.

Financial services has changed enormously. Much of the technology behind compliance hasn’t. Teams still spend hours on manual checks, disconnected systems slow down launches, and entering a new market can mean rebuilding the same processes all over again.

We’re changing that. spektr gives regulated businesses one platform for onboarding, monitoring and investigations, with configurable workflows and AI agents that do the legwork. Product, Operations and Compliance can move together, with the control they need to grow.

Company Description: Systemiq is a system-change company committed to achieving the Sustainable Development Goals and the Paris Agreement by transforming markets and business models across five key systems: nature and food, materials and circularity, energy, urban areas, and sustainable finance.

As a certified B Corp, we combine strategic advisory with high-impact, on-the-ground work, partnering with business, finance, policymakers and civil society to deliver system change. With offices across Africa, Asia, Europe and the Americas, we are dedicated exclusively to sustainability-focused work.

 

Director, Power Systems & Grid Transformation

Location: Amsterdam ( preferred), or London
Reports to: Eveline Speelman, Global Energy Platform Lead
Role type: Full-time

Role Overview

Systemiq is seeking a Director with deep expertise in power system transformation, with a particular focus on grids, system planning, flexibility, market design, utility transformation, and the integration of renewables at scale.

This role will help clients address some of the most critical bottlenecks in the energy transition: grid constraints, connection queues, system adequacy, flexibility markets, transmission and distribution investment, regulatory reform, and the changing role of utilities and system operators.

This is not a generalist energy transition role. We are looking for a senior strategy leader who understands how power systems actually work technically, commercially, and institutionally, and who can help clients unlock the grid, market, and system integration challenges now slowing the transition.

This is a senior leadership role combining:

  • Deep power systems expertise
  • Top-tier strategy problem solving
  • Origination and senior client leadership
  • Delivery of complex, multi-stakeholder programmes
  • Team leadership and platform-building

You will work closely with Eveline Speelman and global partners to build Systemiq’s work on power system transformation, with a particular focus on grids, flexibility, market design, utilities, and system-level decarbonisation.

Key Responsibilities

Power Systems & Grid Transformation

  • Lead work on power system transformation, including grid constraints, transmission and distribution investment, system planning, flexibility, renewables integration, and utility transformation.
  • Advise clients on the strategic, regulatory, commercial, and institutional choices needed to accelerate power system decarbonisation.
  • Translate technical power system challenges into clear strategic recommendations for senior decision-makers.
  • Identify the practical barriers slowing power system transformation and shape interventions to overcome them.

Strategic Advisory

  • Lead high-impact strategy engagements with corporates, governments, investors, utilities, system operators, and other energy system actors.
  • Structure and solve complex, ambiguous problems and translate them into actionable recommendations.
  • Advise senior stakeholders, including C-suite leaders and policymakers, on transition pathways, investment priorities, and market-shaping decisions.

Systems Change & Platform Leadership

  • Shape and drive system-level interventions beyond individual projects, including coalitions, market-shaping initiatives, and public-private collaboration.
  • Identify structural bottlenecks across policy, infrastructure, regulation, market design, and capital allocation.
  • Work across sectors and stakeholders to unlock system-wide impact beyond project-level outcomes.
  • Contribute to Systemiq’s broader Energy platform strategy and thought leadership.

Origination & Growth

  • Identify, shape, and win new work across power systems, grids, utilities, flexibility, and energy transition topics.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior clients, partners, and external stakeholders.
  • Contribute to scaling Systemiq’s Energy platform globally.

Team Leadership

  • Lead and mentor high-performing teams.
  • Coach and develop team members, building capability in power systems, analytical problem solving, and systems-level thinking.
  • Contribute to a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and mission-driven culture.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for a high-calibre, strategy-led leader with deep power systems expertise and the ability to operate at the intersection of strategy, policy, regulation, infrastructure, and real-economy delivery.

Essential Experience

  • Deep experience in power systems, ideally including transmission and distribution grids, system operation, power market design, flexibility, renewables integration, storage, demand response, or utility strategy
  • Around 10 to 15+ years’ experience in strategy consulting or energy advisory
  • Experience working with or advising utilities, TSOs, DSOs, regulators, energy ministries, market operators, developers, infrastructure investors, or major energy users.
  • Strong understanding of how grid constraints, interconnection, flexibility, storage, demand response, market reform, and regulation affect decarbonisation pathways.
  • Ability to translate technical power system issues into strategic choices for senior decision-makers.
  • Proven track record leading strategy engagements, complex programmes, and senior client relationships.
  • Demonstrated ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders, including C-suite leaders, policymakers, regulators, and investors.
  • Experience combining advisory work with real-world implementation is strongly valued.

Core Capabilities

  • Exceptional problem structuring and analytical rigour.
  • Strong commercial judgement and experience in origination and growth.
  • Ability to move between high-level strategy and practical implementation.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
  • Systems thinker focused on practical, scalable, real-world outcomes.
  • Ability to lead complex work across multiple stakeholders, sectors, and geographies.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience in international energy systems, infrastructure investment, large-scale transition programmes, or power market reform.

For contractors, Systemiq offers the chance to work on complex strategy and transformation challenges with teams that combine consulting, sector expertise and a strong focus on real-world impact. Assignments vary in topic and duration but typically involve working closely with Systemiq colleagues and clients on high-priority questions where strong problem solving, analysis and communication matter from day one.

We currently have several live contractor opportunities and expect further needs to arise over the coming months. We are therefore looking both for consultants who may be able to join projects in the near term and for strong candidates who could be relevant for future assignments.

Our priority is people with previous strategy consulting, management consulting or closely comparable advisory experience who can join a project team, get up to speed quickly and deliver high-quality work with limited ramp-up.

Previous sustainability experience is welcome but not essential. Strong consulting generalists are very much encouraged to apply, particularly those with relevant experience in one or more of our focus areas.

The role

As a contractor at Systemiq, you will join a project team for a defined period and contribute to strategy, analysis and delivery. Depending on the project, you may work with businesses, governments, financial institutions, foundations and civil society organisations on complex sustainability and systems change challenges.

Depending on your experience and the assignment, you may:

  • Structure complex problems: Develop clear approaches to ambiguous strategic questions and identify the analysis needed to answer them.
  • Conduct analysis and research: Undertake quantitative and qualitative analysis, research and synthesis to build a strong evidence base.
  • Develop clear insights: Turn complex information into concise conclusions, recommendations and client-ready outputs.
  • Own workstreams: Take responsibility for defined areas of work and deliver to agreed timelines.
  • Engage stakeholders: Support or lead client and stakeholder meetings, interviews and workshops.
  • Support project delivery: Work closely with Systemiq colleagues while operating independently and adapting quickly as project needs evolve.
  • Lead others: At more senior levels, manage workstreams, guide junior team members and build effective relationships with senior clients and stakeholders.

Who we are looking for

Our priority is candidates with experience in strategy consulting, management consulting or a closely comparable advisory environment, typically at Associate, Senior Associate or Manager level.

You are likely to bring:

  • Strong problem-solving skills and experience structuring ambiguous strategic questions.
  • Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills.
  • The ability to turn complex information into clear insights and recommendations.
  • Experience producing concise, high-quality outputs for senior or client audiences.
  • Experience working in consulting-style project teams and delivering to tight timelines.
  • Confidence working with clients and senior stakeholders.
  • The ability to learn quickly and work effectively across unfamiliar topics.
  • A collaborative, pragmatic and adaptable working style.

For Manager-level opportunities, we will also look for experience leading substantial workstreams, managing team members and engaging confidently with senior clients.

Relevant sector or sustainability expertise is of course an advantage, but it does not replace the core consulting and advisory experience we need for most assignments. From time to time, we may also require specialist expertise for particular projects, but this contractor network is primarily focused on strategy and advisory roles.

Location, availability and contracting approach

London is our preferred location. We also welcome candidates who can work with our teams in Amsterdam or Nairobi. Remote arrangements may be considered for particularly strong matches, depending on the requirements of the project.

Contract length, start date and time commitment vary by assignment. Some requirements arise at relatively short notice, so we particularly welcome candidates who are already independent or expect to become available soon.

If your earliest availability is more than approximately eight weeks away, you are welcome to apply, but we may only review or contact you closer to the point at which you become available.

When applying, please tell us your earliest available start date, location, expected availability & day rate, and any relevant sector or subject matter expertise.

Current and future opportunities

We are recruiting for several immediate needs while also identifying strong consultants for projects that may arise over the coming months.

Because contractor needs can develop quickly, we may not contact every strong applicant straight away. We will get in touch when there is a potential match between your consulting experience, expertise, location, availability and a specific project need.

If you enjoy solving complex problems, working with strong teams and applying your consulting skills to sustainability and systems change challenges, we would be pleased to hear from you.

SingleStore is growing our Sales Development team, and we’re looking for hungry, motivated sales development professionals. The SDR team at SingleStore uses outbound prospecting tactics to generate opportunities for our sales team(s). Business development representatives are assigned to account-based territories for commercial, enterprise, and strategic target accounts. This team is a keen group with high business acumen and a hunter's mentality, comfortable generating their own leads.  

Role and Responsibilities: 

  • Generate a qualified sales pipeline for SingleStore targeted accounts ($100M - 1BN in annual revenue)
  • Actively prospect using phone, email, and social media; 50:50 split between outbound and inbound 
  • Partner with up to 4 Account Executives on account plans and prospecting strategies
  • Identify key account stakeholders to generate opportunities for SingleStore
  • Maintain open communication and alignment with Account Executives and management
  • Quickly gain a strong understanding of the SingleStore value proposition and the database industry landscape (prior data experience is a plus)
  • Consistently achieve/exceed the monthly quota of qualified opportunities and meaningful interactions with new prospects

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 1+ years of SDR (Inbound), or BDR experience in the software industry preferred
  • Strong business acumen, with the ability to become an expert on database management systems (DBMS) within your first 90 days
  • Proven track record of running high-volume outbound cadences via phone, email, and social media
  • Proven track record of achieving measurable lead and pipeline goals; references preferred
  • Formal sales training is a plus 
  • Required to be available Tuesdays and Wednesdays for pipeline generation days with the team and overall training
  • Fluent in French and German

What you’ll bring:

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment 
  • An exceptional written and spoken communicator
  • Hungry for a career in sales or other areas of enterprise software
  • Comfortable reaching out cold to executive-level and technical prospects
  • Experience with sales tools like Salesforce, Outreach.io, Zoominfo, and LinkedIn  
  • Highly organized & autonomous
  • Entrepreneurial and self-motivated
  • An ability to partner with and support co-workers and customers across time zones

SingleStore delivers the cloud-native database with the speed and scale to power the world’s data-intensive applications. With a distributed SQL database that introduces simplicity to your data architecture by unifying transactions and analytics, SingleStore empowers digital leaders to deliver exceptional, real-time data experiences to their customers. SingleStore is venture-backed and headquartered in San Francisco with offices in Sunnyvale, Raleigh, Seattle, Boston, London, Lisbon, Bangalore, Dublin and Kyiv. 

Consistent with our commitment to diversity & inclusion, we value individuals with the ability to work on diverse teams and with a diverse range of people.

 

SingleStore is looking for an accomplished sales professional to join our Sales Team. AI is moving from experimentation into production, and this role is an opportunity to break into AI while doing meaningful enterprise selling.

You will own a broad territory, build a majority self-sourced pipeline, create demand in an emerging category, and close greenfield enterprise opportunities.

This is a true hunting role. You will engage customers before they have a defined project, develop customer-specific points of view, create urgency around business and technical problems, work with technical experts to land first production workloads, and build a measurable new-logo business with broad ownership. The ideal candidate is a measurable enterprise hunter who is competitive, curious, technically credible, resilient, and able to sell business outcomes. Direct AI sales experience is valuable, but proven selling ability and technical curiosity matter more than a narrow “AI seller” title.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Build and execute a territory strategy for net-new customer acquisition.
  • Prospect fearlessly across a broad account universe using proactive, persistent outbound, account-based, partner, and market-education motions; stay resilient and effective through rejection and ambiguity.
  • Form account hypotheses, map the buying center, and earn first meetings with relevant points of view tailored to the customer.
  • Engage executive, business, technical, security, and procurement stakeholders.
  • Lead great business-first discovery, connect AI and data challenges to fundable goals, and build quantified ROI, TCO, or operational-impact cases.
  • Build and develop champions, multi-thread the buying group, earn executive and economic-buyer access, and maintain stakeholder alignment; own the stakeholder plan, mutual action plan, close plan, value case, stage gates, forecast, and commercial outcome.
  • Lead complex sales cycles through technical validation, security, legal, procurement, negotiation, and close.
  • Partner with Solutions and Forward Deployment Engineers and cross-functional teams to validate technical fit and establish the first production workload.
  • Navigate competitive displacement and maintain disciplined activity management, CRM hygiene, reporting, qualification, forecasting, and opportunity management; showcase clear metrics such as pipeline created, meetings, conversion, quota attainment, and new-logo performance.
  • Be AI fluent: use AI and research tools productively and responsibly while applying judgment, validating outputs, and separating facts from hypotheses.
  • Travel within the assigned territory as required. 

Required Skills and Experience

  • 5+ years of quota-carrying B2B enterprise software sales experience, ideally selling to large or technically sophisticated organizations; experience in data, cloud, analytics, AI, or adjacent technical domains is a plus.
  • Repeated, quantified quota success with clear ownership of new-logo wins and self-sourced pipeline.

job-boards.greenhouse.io/icapitalnetwork.description_excerpt:
About the Role

 iCapital is seeking a Client Delivery Advocate Analyst to join the Data Solutions team. This individual must be comfortable working in a dynamic, performance-driven, fast-paced environment, and is committed to delivering a high-quality, accurate product on a time-sensitive basis. Daily activities will be diverse, from setting up and maintaining software applications, to assisting clients with issues, special projects, sales calls, and helping with all the non-related tasks associated with building an innovative company. The role is a mix of finance and technology.

Responsibilities

  • Financial Reporting and Data Aggregation tools.
  • Analyze and explain portfolio performance results.
  • Conduct account level reconciliation, including research and resolution of all breaks, cancels, and corrects.
  • Analyze private equity and hedge fund statements for input into system.
  • Consolidate data from multiple sources and custodians.
  • Provide accurate and timely statements and data entry.
  • Generate reports as needed.
  • Work with clients and partners to resolve data issues.
  • Develop and strengthen client relationships via client on-boarding, client account setup, training, day-to-day support and issue management.
  • Maintain software maintenance, system setup and configuration which includes new client setup, new financial account and asset set-up and classification. This assists in data feed management, creating custom reports based on client-specific needs, liaise with the vendor partners for enhancements, and system data issues.
  • Work with the team to prioritize individual and communal work to ensure all projects are completed on time and to detailed specifications.
  • Establish operational effectiveness through the development, adoption of policies, procedures, and controls.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree with a concentration in finance, computer science, statistics, mathematics, data science, or a similar field
  • Excellent customer relations skills
  • Foster and maintain effective relationships
  • Proactively assess and act upon client and company needs
  • Well-organized and self-motivated with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines
  • Highly attentive to detail and accuracy while maintaining an organized approach to duties and responsibilities
  • Comfortable with technology, software tools and applications and able to learn new software quickly; Strong MS Excel and PowerPoint skills, basic knowledge of database concepts, and any type of programming and a working knowledge of Photoshop, HTML design, or similar tools
  • Knowledge of liquid investments such as Equities, Bonds, ETFs, Mutual Funds, SMA/UMA, alternative investments, performance reporting calculations and methodologies, portfolio management and rebalancing, as well as how RIA investment advisors ’work
  • Critical thinker that possesses strong-problem-solving skills and can summarize information clearly and concisely, both written and verbally
  • Devotion to collaboration and ability to thrive in a team environment while working independently

 

We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office 4 days a week with the flexibility to work remotely 1 day - Friday. 

For additional information on iCapital, please visit https://www.icapital.com/about-us  Twitter: @icapitalnetwork | LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/icapital-network-inc | Awards Disclaimer: https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about-us/recognition/

iCapital is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

About the Role

iCapital is seeking a Vice President, Regulatory & Compliance to join its International Regulatory & Compliance Team, based in London. This role will support a broad range of regulatory, compliance, corporate governance, and risk management activities across the firm's UK and EMEA operations.

The successful candidate will work closely with senior members of the International Regulatory & Compliance Team to help maintain and enhance the firm's compliance framework, support regulatory obligations, and partner with the business teams to ensure that our UK & EMEA offices are operating within the letter and the spirit of the regulations.

This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain exposure to multiple regulatory regimes, private markets distribution, corporate governance, and international compliance matters within a fast-growing global organization.

Responsibilities

  • Support the development and enhancement of the UK and EMEA Compliance Framework, including overseeing compliance policies, procedures, and regulatory inventories.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and advise business stakeholders on applicable UK, European, and Middle East regulatory requirements, including cross border distribution.
  • Provide compliance guidance and reviews of financial promotions, distribution activities, conflicts of interest, AML/CFT, staff compliance, and other regulatory matters.
  • Develop and undertake risk-based assessments, compliance monitoring and testing, and support the deployment and remediation of identified issues.
  • Oversee and deliver compliance training and maintain appropriate training records.
  • Support regulatory reporting and governance obligations, including FCA filings and attending board meetings.
  • Maintain corporate governance records, regulatory registers and filings, board documentation, and support responses to regulatory enquiries, audits, and examinations.
  • Assist with financial crime and employee compliance programmes, including third party onboarding, AML/CFT, sanctions, personal account dealing, gifts and entertainment, outside business interests, annual attestations, investigations, incidents, breaches, and regulatory recordkeeping.
  • Improve compliance processes and controls, including through the responsible use of AI and other technology.
  • Work closely with senior management, colleagues, regulators and external stakeholders to identify and mitigate regulatory and compliance risks for the firm and its clients.

 

Qualifications

  • 6-10 years of experience in compliance, regulatory affairs, risk management, audit, legal, operations, or compliance consulting within financial services.
  • Strong understanding of FCA regulatory requirements applicable to licensed firms, including SMCR, Conduct of Business Rules, financial promotions, AML/CFT, and governance obligations.
  • Experience supporting regulatory reporting, financial promotion reviews, compliance monitoring, risk assessment and compliance advisory activities.
  • Familiarity with UK and European regulatory requirements applicable to regulated financial services firms, including cross-border distribution considerations.
  • Collaborative, proactive and adaptable team player, able to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Understanding of financial crime requirements, including AML, sanctions, and KYC obligations.
  • Experience developing or supporting compliance training and monitoring programmes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, analytical, and organizational skills.
  • Knowledge of private markets, investment funds, wealth management, or fund distribution would be advantageous.
  • Advanced Microsoft Office skills; experience with compliance technology platforms and workflow management systems is advantageous.

The role reports to the International Regulatory & Compliance leadership team and works closely with colleagues across Legal, Risk, Client Solutions, Product, Operations, Finance and Corporate Governance functions. The role will require the candidate to hold FCA approval to carry out the SMF17 Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO) Senior Management Function.

 

We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office Monday-Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on Friday.

For additional information on iCapital, please visit https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about-us  Twitter: @icapitalnetwork | LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/icapital-network-inc Awards Disclaimer: https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about-us/recognition/

About the Role

iCapital is looking to hire a Vice President to lead go-to-market for iCapital Passthrough, iCapital’s business for non-advised investors, across the United Kingdom and Europe. This is the first dedicated commercial hire for Passthrough in the region, and the remit is deliberately broader than its US equivalents: one person owning the full-cycle sales motion and the partner channel that feeds it.

The business serves general partners who onboard investors directly, outside of wealth management channels. The individual in this role will own that market in Europe end to end, sourcing and closing new fund manager customers while building out existing and creating new fund administrator, law firm, and technology partnerships that generate referrals into the platform.

iCapital is the leading international player in private markets technology and distribution, with an established presence and deep relationships across the UK and Europe. This role is the chance to build a new business line with that platform, brand, and network already in market rather than from a standing start.

The position reports jointly to the Managing Director, GP Onboarding Solution and to the Managing Director, International Asset Manager Solutions. The successful candidate will carry an individual revenue number while working closely with iCapital's existing international coverage teams.

Responsibilities

  • Own full-cycle new client revenue for Passthrough across the UK and Europe, from first touch through signature, for both self-sourced and partner-sourced opportunities.
  • Consistently meet or exceed an annual revenue quota of approximately $900,000 to $1,000,000 in year one, scaling as the market matures.
  • Own the top of the funnel and prospect directly into general partners across the region. There is no dedicated sales development support in Europe, so pipeline generation is part of this job rather than a stage handed over to you.
  • Build and activate the European partner channel across fund administrators, fund formation counsel, and technology and API partners, from sourcing and pitching through structuring, launch, and ongoing management, including converting existing inbound interest from current partners.
  • Act as Europe's Passthrough product expert, supporting iCapital's international asset manager coverage teams where their relationships intersect with the platform, while independently running your own book of business.
  • Become an expert on the European private funds landscape and articulate the value proposition credibly to COOs, CFOs, General Counsel, and Investor Relations leaders at fund managers.
  • Test and document what the European market will bear on pricing and packaging, structuring deals within agreed commercial guardrails.
  • Keep meticulous records of all activity in the CRM to ensure predictable and accurate forecasting.
  • Provide structured monthly feedback to the product team on European requirements, including GDPR, AIFMD, and local KYC and AML considerations.
  • Represent Passthrough at European industry events and conferences, drawing on central iCapital marketing support.
  • Travel regularly across the UK and Europe for client meetings, partner meetings, and industry events.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years in full-cycle B2B sales, business development, or partnerships, with a demonstrated record of personally generating, running, and signing new business. This is not a relationship management or account coverage role, though you will be able to take advantage of iCapital’s deep relationships.
  • A track record of carrying and meeting an individual revenue quota.
  • Established relationships with general partners, fund administrators, and/or fund formation counsel in the UK and Europe.
  • Fluency in private markets, with the credibility to hold a substantive conversation with a fund COO, General Counsel, or Investor Relations lead about how capital is raised and investors are onboarded.
  • Comfort operating with ambiguity. This role has not existed before, and the playbook will be built instead of inherited.
  • Experience selling to or through channel partners is a strong plus.
  • Experience at an early-stage or high-growth company is a strong plus.
  • Experience on the allocator side, whether at an LP, fund of funds, investment consultancy, or placement agent, is valued for the industry fluency it brings, though it does not substitute for closing experience.
  • German or French language ability is useful but not required.

We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office Monday-Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on Friday.

For additional information on iCapital, please visit https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about-us  Twitter: @icapitalnetwork | LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/icapital-network-inc Awards Disclaimer: https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about-us/recognition/

job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io/terberg-dts/.description_excerpt:
Reports to: Operations Manager - Gloucester Operations

Protecting Critical Response Vehicles Across the UK

Build. Repair. Diagnose. Respond.

Are you an experienced Heavy Vehicle Technician looking for a role where your work directly supports critical emergency response operations? At Terberg DTS, you'll work on a specialist fleet of Fire Vehicles, Ground Support Equipment (GSE), and associated manufacturer products, ensuring they remain operational and ready when needed most.

As a Mobile Engineer Heavy Vehicle Technician – Fire Division, you'll work independently across customer sites, carrying out servicing, inspections, diagnostics, repairs, and accident damage assessments while delivering exceptional customer service and maintaining the highest safety standards.

No two days are the same, and every job plays a vital role in keeping essential equipment operational.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Servicing, maintaining and repairing Fire Vehicles, GSE equipment and other specialist vehicles at customer locations.
  • Diagnosing mechanical, hydraulic and electrical faults using modern diagnostic equipment and technical manuals.
  • Carrying out vehicle inspections and identifying worn, damaged or defective components.
  • Undertaking accident damage assessments and producing detailed reports for repair recommendations.
  • Completing repairs safely, efficiently and in accordance with manufacturer specifications and company Safe Systems of Work.
  • Working independently while maintaining exceptional safety, quality and customer service standards.
  • Completing service documentation, worksheets and reports accurately and on time.
  • Managing vehicle stock inventory and ensuring parts are accounted for correctly.
  • Obtaining customer sign-off and purchase orders upon completion of work where required.
  • Maintaining company equipment, tools, diagnostic equipment, laptops and vehicles in a safe, secure and presentable condition.
  • Supporting apprentices through mentoring and on-the-job training.
  • Building strong working relationships with customers and colleagues across the business.
  • Participating in a planned out-of-hours call-out rota to provide customer support when required.
  • Travelling and occasionally working away from home when business needs require.

What You'll Bring

  • City & Guilds Level 3 Vehicle Maintenance & Repair qualification (or equivalent).
  • Significant experience diagnosing and repairing heavy vehicles and specialist equipment.
  • Strong auto-electrical fault-finding experience using electronic diagnostic systems.
  • Experience working on HGVs, emergency service vehicles, specialist vehicles, plant equipment or similar.
  • Knowledge of modern vehicle diagnostic systems and repair techniques.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship.
  • Ability to work independently and manage workloads effectively.
  • Strong communication and customer service skills.
  • A flexible approach with the ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
  • Full UK Driving Licence.HGV Licence (desirable).

Why Join Terberg DTS?

About Taskrabbit:

Taskrabbit is a marketplace platform that conveniently connects people with Taskers to handle everyday home to-do’s, such as furniture assembly, handyman work, moving help, and much more.

At Taskrabbit, we want to transform lives one task at a time. As a company we celebrate innovation, inclusion and hard work. Our culture is collaborative, pragmatic, and fast-paced. We’re looking for talented, entrepreneurially minded and data-driven people who also have a passion for helping people do what they love. Together with IKEA, we’re creating more opportunities for people to earn a consistent, meaningful income on their own terms by building lasting relationships with clients in communities around the world.

Taskrabbit is a hybrid company with employees distributed across the US and EU and a Built In — Best Places to Work (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025) continually ranked across multiple national and regional categories. Join us at Taskrabbit, where your work will be meaningful, your ideas valued, and your potential unleashed!

Location: London (hybrid working in office 2 days in central London)

About the Role:

As a General Manager, you will be responsible for leading the UK country team to grow the market, manage the country P&L, and hit targets for net revenue and contribution margin. You will work closely with cross functional teams in setting a market strategy, alongside efficient tactical and operational plans to meet commercial goals, and produce strong propositions for both customers and taskers.

What You’ll Work On:

  • P&L responsibility for the UK business
  • Shape the UK strategy to deliver core commercial goals including revenue and contribution margin
  • Accountable for both sides of the marketplace: generating demand as well as ensuring strong supply health and task fulfilment
  • Responsible for value propositions on both sides of the marketplace
  • Directly manage the UK team that covers marketing, partnerships and tasker operations
  • Champion the UK business internally and as a general manager collaborate across functions to identify and bring to life opportunities that drive UK market growth.
  • Own local go-to-market strategy, including the development of city-specific GTM strategies and localisation of Taskrabbit’s offering as relevant
  • Drive local marketing ideas, initiatives, and channels to increase brand awareness, in partnership with the global marketing team
  • Identify and pursue potential external partners to help grow the UK business, in collaboration with the global partnerships team

Requirements

  • 8-10+ years of experience in driving commercial growth of a business. Any experience in marketing, business development, and/or P&L management is a plus
  • Demonstrated experience managing cross-functional teams, capable of overseeing multiple people across different functions and levels of seniority
  • Comfortable working heavily with data, and operating at a fast pace in an entrepreneurial environment. Experience working in a startup is a plus, especially a marketplace platform
  • Excellent communication and relationship building skills, and comfortable presenting to large groups regularly
  • An exceptional ability to balance creative thinking with strong business judgment and analytical skills 
  • Problem-solving abilities in both data-rich and data-poor environments; ability to both delve into the details and engage meaningfully on higher-level strategy
  • A natural inclination to take initiative and ownership, with the ability to independently navigate ambiguous situations and balance multiple priorities
  • Role includes some travel within the UK and occasional travel to the US.

Ideal (Nice to have skills)

  • An understanding of the dynamics underlying a two-sided marketplace
  • Experience working for a global brand

Compensation & Benefits: 

At Taskrabbit, our approach to compensation is designed to be competitive, transparent, and equitable. Total compensation consists of base pay + bonus + benefits + perks. The base pay range for this position is £89,000-£115,000. This range is representative of base pay only, and does not include any other total cash compensation amounts, such as company bonus or benefits. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed above and will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, qualifications, geography, and level.

You’ll love working here because:

  • Taskrabbit is a Hybrid Company. We value flexibility and choice but also stay committed to regular in-person connection.
  • The People. You will be surrounded by some of the most talented, supportive, smart, and kind leaders and teams -- people you can be proud to work with!
  • The Diverse Culture. We believe that we make better decisions when our workforce reflects the diversity of the communities in which we operate. Women make up half of our leadership team and our diversity representation is above that of the tech industry average.
  • The Perks. Taskrabbit offers our employees with employer-paid health insurance and a 401k match with immediate vesting for our US based employees. We offer all of our global employees generous and flexible time off with 2 company-wide closure weeks, Taskrabbit product stipends, wellness + productivity + education stipends, IKEA discounts, reproductive health support, and more. Benefits vary by country of employment. 

Taskrabbit’s commitment to Diversity and Inclusion:

An Active Commitment to Equity within our Company and Platform. We are an inclusive community where all who share our mission and values belong. Our diverse team represents the communities we serve, breaking down systemic barriers, and transforming lives- one action at a time.

Taskrabbit is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military/veteran status, or disability status. Taskrabbit is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with physical and mental disabilities. About the role:

In this role, you will balance global localization project management across all markets, including high-touch, complex requests outside our automated pipeline, with full ownership of your language.   • A passion for language, communication, and storytelling.
  • A minimum of 5 years hands-on localization experience, with a strong background in translation, linguistics, transcreation, content creation, QA, and cultural adaptation.

THE ROLE.

As a Designer in menswear, you'll create and develop world-class product that embodies the Gymshark DNA. Working closely with Design Leadership and cross-functional partners, you'll take ownership of product designs from concept through to execution, delivering commercially successful products that resonate with our global community.

This is an exciting opportunity for a creative, trend-aware designer who is passionate about sportswear, performance apparel and product innovation.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING.

  • Designing and developing Menswear products across multiple categories.
  • Researching fashion, sportswear and consumer trends to identify new opportunities.
  • Creating and maintaining design concepts throughout the product development…

OVERVIEW:

This role exists to build and maintain the iOS app that a large share of Gymshark customers shop through, at a standard that holds under peak load. You will turn refined product work into features that are shipped, tested and observable, and improves the quality of the code you touch.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

CRAFT  

  • Writes production Swift confidently. Most new work is SwiftUI; the app still contains UIKit that is being migrated, so both are relevant. 
  • Works effectively in a modular codebase. Understands why a type belongs in one module rather than another, and adds features without crossing module boundaries. 
  • Applies Clean Architecture and MVVM as standard, can explain the separation of concerns, and identifies where a pull request breaks it. 
  • Writes unit tests as part of the work rather than afterwards, and is comfortable building test doubles. Some of the team work test-first, and we want to increase that. 
  • Understands Swift concurrency sufficiently to avoid data races, and raises it when a problem exceeds their experience. 
  • Diagnoses production issues from crash reporting and analytics, and identifies the root cause independently. 
  • Treats performance, accessibility and app size as part of completing a piece of work. 
  • Understands the path their code takes after merge: CI, review, distribution and App Store submission, and the common failure points at each stage. 
  • Uses a branching strategy consistently and writes pull requests that are straightforward to review. 
  • Raises design specifications that conflict with the Human Interface Guidelines rather than implementing them unchanged. 
  • Considers security and dependency risk routinely, and can assess whether a third-party SDK should be added

DELIVERY

  • Contributes actively to Agile ceremonies, and raises when one is no longer useful.

job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io/threecolts/j.description_excerpt:
About Threecolts

Threecolts is a software suite built for consumer brands, helping them recover revenue, operate more efficiently and grow across major retailers and marketplaces.
Our largest business, Margin Pro, helps brands recover money owed to them by retailers and marketplaces such as Amazon, Walmart and Target by managing disputes on their behalf. Alongside this, we’re building and scaling newer products, including AI Operator and Retail 365, while continuing to grow our portfolio of subscription products across our customer base.

Who We Are 

We’re a global team of 340 people across 33 teams, having grown through 24 acquisitions. We operate with a flat structure, giving people real ownership and the ability to move quickly. AI is embedded in how we work across the business, helping us increase speed, improve quality and operate at scale.

🔥 Key Responsibilities

  • Translate evolving commercial strategies, commercial workflows, and executive directives into scalable, rock-solid Salesforce architecture and automated flows.
  • Own end-to-end CRM architecture, designing, building, and maintaining custom objects, complex flows, and third-party integrations across the full customer lifecycle (acquisition, partner attribution, contracting, expansion, and renewals).
  • Partner closely with DataOps to ingest, model, and maintain data pipelines flowing into Salesforce from our core platform (Threecolts Hub) and financial systems (Sage, Stripe), ensuring object schemas and field mappings stay synchronized so commercial teams see reliable, real-time product usage and billing data.
  • Lead technical scoping, build, testing, and deployment for cross-functional initiatives across Sales, Account Management, Finance, and Operations.
  • Enforce operational hygiene, data validation rules, and system governance to ensure business logic remains reliable as the commercial model evolves.
  • Maintain system documentation, technical change logs, and deployment workflows so platform enhancements are predictable and transparent across engineering and operations.
  • Continuously audit our commercial tech stack, identifying cost-reduction opportunities and executing seamless vendor migrations without disrupting rep workflows.
  • Actively contribute to internal planning, team process design, and systems architecture roadmaps, identifying cross-functional bottlenecks and proposing scalable operational solutions that accelerate team execution and capability.

😊 About You

  • 6–8+ years of hands-on Salesforce development/advanced administration experience (expertise well beyond basic setup/maintenance).
  • You've led complex cross-functional builds end to end, from scoping through build.
  • You have a demonstrated track record designing scalable data models and modern workflow automations in complex enterprise CRM environments.
  • You have a proven track record of sitting with operational and business leaders, taking ambiguous business models or rapid process changes, and independently translating them into elegant technical designs without needing hand-holding.
  • You understand relational database structures and event-based tracking. You treat the CRM as a critical upstream node in the company’s data pipeline and actively coordinate schema changes with DataOps before deployment.
  • You are technically minded - Working with technology, systems, tools is something that gives you energy. You stay up to date naturally on latest developments in tech across Salesforce, AI and related technologies.
  • You have previously worked in a high growth environment (startup and/or scaleup) in a build phase and are comfortable with ambiguity.

💼 What we’re looking for

  • Proven mastery of relational database design, custom object schemas, complex validation rules, field-level security, and Governor limit management.
  • Proven experience leveraging native enterprise-tier capabilities (high governor limits, developer sandboxes, Einstein features/ECI, advanced pipeline inspection) to consolidate tech stack bloat and avoid unnecessary external SaaS purchases.
  • Deep hands-on experience or rapid technical aptitude with Sweep for visual business logic modeling, automated routing, dependency tracking, and staging-to-production deployment, prioritizing centralized orchestration over fragmented native Flow sprawl.
  • Demonstrated experience working as an upstream recipient of data pipelines. Fluent in relational concepts to cleanly ingest and map product and financial data (Stripe, Sage) via webhooks, REST APIs, or middleware without breaking validation rules.
  • Proven track record of executing rip-and-replace, vendor consolidation, and cost-reduction projects across the revenue stack (e.g., migrating conversation intelligence from Gong to Fireflies, consolidating e-signature tools, swapping enrichment providers). Skilled at data archival, license optimization, and end-user cutover management.
  • Hands-on experience integrating Salesforce with Slack for automated commercial deal alerts, approval workflows, and rep notification channels; comfortable connecting data feeds across enrichment, marketing automation, and internal operational bots.
  • Advanced proficiency with SF Inspector, Data Loader, Workbench, and spreadsheet modeling (Google Sheets/Excel) for mass data remediation, deduplication, and historical audits.

⛳️ Compensation, Perks & Benefits

  • Salary: £ 110,000 yearly
  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
  • Company pension scheme with employer contribution
  • Regular compensation reviews and bonus opportunities
  • Opportunity to join company-wide off sites

We are PMG

PMG, a global independent platform company engineered for impact, integrates business strategy, media, creative, and data within a single operating model powered by our proprietary operating system, Alli. With more than 1,000 employees, PMG partners with brands including Apple, Nike, Dropbox, Experian, Sephora, and Whole Foods. Our work has earned top industry honors, including Cannes Lions and Adweek’s Media Plan of the Year, and PMG has won 40+ workplace culture awards, including being the only company to rank among Ad Age’s Best Places to Work for 11 consecutive years.

Who You’ll Be Working With

At PMG, our Influencer & Branded Content team is at the intersection of culture, storytelling, and strategy, helping brands connect with audiences in authentic, meaningful ways. We craft high-impact influencer campaigns that go beyond traditional advertising, driving engagement, building brand affinity, and delivering measurable results across social, digital, and experiential platforms.

You’ll collaborate with creators, talent agencies, media strategists, content teams, and brand partners to develop and execute influencer marketing programs that seamlessly align storytelling with business objectives. A key focus will be scaling PMG’s influencer and creator marketing discipline—establishing frameworks, curating talent relationships, and setting standards for authenticity and effectiveness in alignment with brand goals. Your role will be instrumental in shaping how brands foster meaningful connections with their audiences.

You will also play a key role in exploring new content formats, leveraging emerging platforms, and staying ahead of industry trends to ensure creator strategies are not only relevant but also innovative and impactful. At PMG, we don’t just follow trends—we create them.

If you’re passionate about shaping culture through creator-driven storytelling, using data to drive real impact, and redefining what’s possible in influencer marketing, this is the place to make your mark.

What You Will Do

  • Lead the identification and selection of influencers that align with our clients' target audiences and campaign objectives.
  • Collaborate with the Lead to develop and execute comprehensive influencer campaigns, ensuring seamless coordination between influencers, internal teams, and clients.
  • Oversee the creation and delivery of branded content, including overseeing the adherence to brand guidelines and coordinating with influencers and internal teams to achieve desired outcomes.
  • Support the Senior Overseer in analyzing campaign performance, extracting key insights, and providing strategic recommendations for future campaigns.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends, emerging platforms, and best practices in influencer marketing, and share relevant insights with the team.
  • Support mentoring and guiding Associate-level team members, providing support and sharing knowledge to help them grow in their roles.
  • The primary focus of this role is the Influencer & Branded Content channel, ensuring excellence in strategy, execution, and performance. However, responsibilities may extend across other media channels as needed to support broader campaign objectives and business priorities

What You Will Bring

  • Experience in Influencer & Branded Content, with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Expertise in content creation and influencer marketing strategy, driving impactful partnerships and innovative campaigns.
  • Experience in contract review and proposal development, ensuring smooth negotiations and long-term influencer collaborations.
  • Advanced detail orientation, overseeing accurate execution, reporting, and strategic alignment in influencer initiatives.
  • Strong proficiency in project implementation, managing high-level influencer campaigns from concept to completion.
  • Skilled in presentation and communication, delivering insights, strategic recommendations, and campaign performance analysis.
  • Deep understanding of advertising standards, client service, and relationship management, fostering high-quality influencer-brand partnerships.
  • Proficiency in influencer management dashboards and social media platforms, leveraging analytics to optimize campaign performance.
  • Experience in networking and influencer marketing, building meaningful industry relationships to enhance campaign reach and effectiveness.
  • A commitment to curiosity and adaptability as a Continual Learner, staying at the forefront of media innovation while prioritizing client success with a Customer-Focused mindset that seeks opportunities to deliver meaningful value.
  • A dedication to People-Focused leadership, fostering collaboration, innovation, and professional growth by leading by example and nurturing strong relationships that empower others to excel.

What We Offer

Performance-Based Rewards: Your impact should be part of your reward. This role is eligible for PMG’s annual bonus program—a standout part of our total compensation offering and an opportunity to share in our success. Bonus awards are informed by individual impact and performance, as well as team and company results, and are subject to applicable program terms.

Professional Development: Keep growing through learning and development programs, mentorship opportunities, and support for career advancement.

Generous Time Off: Take the time you need to recharge, connect with loved ones, and enjoy life outside work.

Parental Leave: Receive paid parental leave during life’s important family moments.
