job-boards.greenhouse.io/xtxmarketstechn.description_excerpt:
The Firm

XTX Markets is a leading algorithmic trading firm which uses state-of-the-art machine learning technology to produce price forecasts for 53,000 financial instruments across equities, fixed income, currencies, commodities and crypto. It uses those forecasts to trade on exchanges and alternative trading venues, and to offer differentiated liquidity directly to clients worldwide. The firm trades over $250bn a day across 35 countries and has over 300 employees based in London, Singapore, New York, Paris, Bristol, Mumbai, Yerevan and Kajaani.

 

We leverage the talent of the people who work here, modern computational techniques and state-of-the-art research infrastructure to analyse large data sets across markets quickly and efficiently, to maximize the effectiveness of our proprietary trading algorithms. We are actively seeking new methods and ideas. The models that drive our trading strategies have evolved considerably over the last 10 years, from econometric methods that gave our company its name, to trees, to neural networks, to modern deep learning architectures.

 

XTX Markets has an unrivalled level of computational resources in the trading industry, with a growing research cluster currently containing over 25,000 GPUs with 1 exabyte of usable storage. Teams across the firm include world-class researchers, developers and technologists with backgrounds in pure math, programming, physics, computer science and machine learning. The firm is also constructing a large-scale data centre in Finland to future-proof its significant computational capabilities.

 

At XTX Markets technology is our business and we are a diverse organization which attracts outstanding talent from across all industry backgrounds. We are focused on teamwork, and our people collaborate on all aspects of the business, working openly and with respect for each other, our clients and the market. Our culture is non-hierarchical and one where everyone is valued. We strive for excellence in everything we do.

 

The Role 

As a Realtime Analytics and Controls Developer, you will be responsible for the mission control panel for one of the largest trading systems in the world ($250bn-300bn/day). Your work will have a company-wide impact, with users including Trading Desk, Trading Developers, Quants, CEO, Distribution and Risk.

 

The goal is to provide clarity about what our trading system (hundreds of thousands of strategies) is doing at any given moment and how it is performing. We supply both high-level and incredibly detailed views, as both are crucial for efficient decision making and spotting issues. In addition to visibility, we are also responsible for trading control mechanisms – e.g., tweaking limits, starting trading strategies or emergency stopping. These actions are necessary for continued trading, and sometimes need to be taken within minutes, with millions of pounds at stake.

 

Realtime Analytics and Controls is a small specialist team which works directly with multiple front office groups. You will be expected to also contribute to the shared software platform that supports this group.

 

This is one of our most people-oriented engineering roles. You should expect to collaborate regularly with your colleagues who are the primary customers of your software, to understand how your design decisions affect their day-to-day work.

 

Responsibilities

  • Communicate regularly with internal users about their needs and ideas.
  • Understand workflows of all teams involved in trading.
  • Design, implement and maintain software, including:
    • An Ingestion mechanism for large volumes of data from trading systems.
    • Internal frameworks for data processing and presentation.
    • In-memory query engines.
  • Present the data in a clear, useful, and accurate way, in collaboration with frontend developers.
  • Maintain calculation of trading metrics.
  • Build software that can reliably run 24/7.
  • Participating in the on-call rota.

 

Essential Attributes

  • Pragmatic with strong ability to communicate with technical stakeholders: understanding users’ needs, soliciting features / requirements from them and prioritising effectively according to business needs.
  • Algorithmically literate and able to write efficient code.
  • Familiar with distributed systems – able to reason about consistency, delays etc.
  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience coding in a professional environment with Java or C++.
  • Willing to learn Kotlin.
  • Skilled in writing automated tests.
  • Passionate about reducing complexity.
  • Deeply caring about correctness and reliability.
  • Proactive about taking responsibility.

 

Desirable Attributes

  • Familiar with high throughput JVM techniques.
  • Experience with binary protocols.
  • Proficient in working with databases.
  • Experienced in working with high stakes systems.


Benefits

  • Onsite gym, sauna, and fitness classes at no charge. (Wellbeing Space).
  • Extensive medical benefits including an on-site doctor and therapist at no charge.
  • Breakfast and lunch provided daily.
  • Various supports for caregivers, including emergency dependent care.
  • Beautiful Kings Cross office: https://vimeo.com/257888726
  • 25 days paid holiday per year + statutory holiday and paid sick days.
  • Generous Pension contributions.

The firm is also constructing a large-scale data centre in Finland to future-proof its significant computational capabilities.

We are focused on teamwork and our people collaborate on all aspects of the business, working openly and with respect for each other, our clients and the market. Our culture is non-hierarchical and one where everyone is valued. We strive for excellence in everything we do. 


The Role

Shared Engineering is a mixed-discipline platform team of around a dozen engineers (network engineers, Linux engineers, and software developers). The team owns the foundations that the firm's engineering runs on such as alerting, job scheduling, host inventory/monitoring, and the internal developer tooling for our monorepo. This includes shared libraries, build systems and CI/CD infrastructure.

Our aim is to give the firm's engineers leverage: fewer manual steps, delivery that is fast and predictable, and teams who can self-serve rather than raising a ticket and waiting. We have many initiatives in flight at once, so judgement about which thing to work on matters nearly as much as building it well.

This is a software-developer role on the team focused on developer experience and platform software: building the tools, services, and libraries that make everyone else's engineering faster and more reliable. A growing part of that remit is how the firm's engineers adopt AI and coding-assistant tooling. Recent work includes our self-service network configuration tools, sandboxing and gateway services for coding assistants, and pulling host inventory data into a single source of truth.


Responsibilities

  • Working primarily in Go, build and own platform services and internal tooling end-to-end, from design through to production. 
  • Improve developer experience by reducing friction in the build/CI/CD path, strengthen shared libraries. 
  • Help shape how the wider firm adopts AI/coding-assistant tooling safely and effectively, integrating it into workflows and building guardrails and tooling around it. 
  • Collaborate with the network and Linux engineers to understand what the infrastructure needs in order to scale and be managed, then expose it cleanly in software. 
  • Mentor and share knowledge, improving teammates' skills and making sure others can maintain and build on the systems you develop. 
  • Review and raise standards by thoughtful code review, sensible judgement on where to block versus where to let things flow, and a pragmatic sense of the right work to be doing right now. 
  • Take part in on-call once up-to-speed, troubleshooting problems that span several technical domains across current and legacy infrastructure. 
     

Essential attributes

  • 3+ years' of experience, with strong software-engineering fundamentals and production experience owning services end-to-end. Go is what you'd write day to day, but we care more about the fundamentals than the language: strong backgrounds in other statically typed languages are welcome. 
  • Comfortable on Linux, with an understanding of the OS your software runs on (processes, networking basics, packaging, systemd), even if you're not a systems engineer. 
  • Solid grasp of build systems, CI/CD, and release pipelines. You've worked in a monorepo or a serious build/release setup and made it better. 
  • A track record of delivering: shipping, closing out, and not letting scope or polish stall a deliverable. 
  • Good written and verbal communication, and the collaborative instinct to treat non-developer engineers as first-class colleagues. 
     

Desirable attributes

Things we'd like to see. You won't have all of them, and that's fine. 

  • Interest or hands-on experience in developer experience and AI/coding-assistant tooling. Building or integrating LLMs into a real engineering workflow is a plus, but curiosity about how these tools change work practices counts too. 
  • Experience with infrastructure/platform software: inventory/asset systems, monitoring, alerting, scheduling, container orchestration or similar backend platform work. 
  • APIs, data pipelines and schema management: designing clean service APIs and moving data between systems reliably. 
  • Infrastructure-as-code and cloud fluency. We use Terraform and AWS as required, but experience with Azure or GCP is just as relevant. 
  • The role is not managing hardware, networks or datacenters. However, you will collaborate closely with teams that do, so experience in these areas is valuable.

The Role

The technology and market data procurement department is responsible for achieving value for the firm in the execution of a budget in the hundreds of millions of pounds annually.

This role supports the research, evaluation, sourcing, procurement, and commercial management of technology products and services across the entire firm.

A key aspect of the role is staying up to date with emerging technologies, market trends and vendor capabilities, providing technology guidance and strategic recommendations to engineering, infrastructure and business development teams to support the firm’s technology decisions.

The portfolio includes IT hardware, enterprise software, cloud services, market data, network and connectivity services, datacentre and colocation services, professional services and emerging technologies. You will get broad exposure to a wide range of cutting-edge technology deployments.

You will work closely with engineering, infrastructure, and business stakeholders to understand their requirements, evaluate technical and commercial options, negotiate with suppliers, and support implementation. We are seeking someone who combines sound commercial judgement with the technical aptitude to research unfamiliar technologies, assess vendor proposals and manage initiatives from initial requirements through contract, delivery and lifecycle management.


Responsibilities

  • Research, evaluate, negotiate and procure technology products and services across hardware, software, cloud, market data, network and connectivity, datacentre and colocation, professional services and emerging technologies.
  • Lead structured sourcing processes, including requirements definition, RFIs, RFPs, vendor due diligence, proposal evaluation, commercial negotiation, contract review, purchase approvals and implementation handover.
  • Work with engineering, infrastructure, information security, legal, finance and business teams to define requirements and assess technical options, vendor roadmaps, licensing and commercial models, support arrangements, implementation risks and total cost of ownership.

  • Approximately 3 to 6 years of experience in technology procurement, strategic sourcing, vendor management, solutions architecture, technical project delivery, infrastructure sourcing or a related role.

Data and integrations

Automation

  • Build inbound lead scoring, routing, and response workflows.
  • Build outbound list building, enrichment, sequencing, and conversion tracking workflows.
  • Translate opportunities identified by sellers, marketers, and CS team members into production-ready solutions.
  • Take ambiguous problems from reps, AEs, or marketers and turn them into working systems.

AI and experimentation

  • Run structured experiments across channels and workflows, measure against pipeline and conversion metrics, and retire what doesn't work.

Team enablement

  • Teach workflow design and Clay proficiency as the team's work shifts from manual prospecting to building and maintaining systems.
  • Support people across GTM who are building their own agents and automations, helping make their work governed and production-ready.

Governance, quality, and compliance

  • Design safeguards up front for deliverability, data quality, and compliance with regulations such as GDPR and CAN-SPAM.
  • Scope, document, and test everything before release.
  • Apply guardrails on cost, performance, and sustainability so no system runs unmonitored.

  • Deep expertise in Clay or a comparable enrichment or workflow platform.
  • Strong Salesforce experience, including data governance.
  • Working proficiency in SQL, Python, or JavaScript sufficient to build and fix workflows independently of engineering.
  • Experience with a BI tool such as Tableau or Looker.
  • Proven experience applying LLMs and agentic tooling to real revenue workflows.
  • Understanding of sales qualification frameworks (e.g., BANT, MEDDIC) and multi-touch attribution.
  • Strong understanding of deliverability, data quality, and compliance requirements (GDPR, CAN-SPAM).
  • Experience managing or mentoring a team.
  • Ability to translate ambiguous business problems into working systems.

Preferred

  • Prior BDR or SDR experience.

Role Overview

This is a unique opportunity to become the finance lead for a fast-growing startup being built within a major gaming studio.

PuzzlePlay is scaling rapidly, expanding into new markets and growing its user base and portfolio. As the dedicated finance lead, you'll have significant ownership and visibility across the entire business — from core accounting and treasury through to FP&A, international expansion, product launches and strategic projects.

You'll work directly with the PuzzlePlay leadership and product teams, while partnering with Group Finance, Tax and Legal. You'll have the autonomy and pace of a startup, backed by the expertise and infrastructure of a larger gaming group.

Most importantly, you'll be building the finance function as the business grows and tailoring it to the needs of both you and the key stakeholders.

What You'll Do

Own the Finance Function: 

  • Lead month-end close, reporting, reconciliations and intercompany accounting
  • Manage treasury, FX exposure and payment provider relationships

  • Build and maintain finance controls around fraud, abuse and user payouts

Support Growth:

  • Lead budgeting, forecasting and KPI reporting
  • Build financial models around PuzzlePlay's unique economics and user dynamics

Lead Strategic Projects:

Role Overview

Join Tripledot Studios as a Senior Machine Learning Engineer working on dynamic pricing and recommender systems use cases in our games. The work involves tabular machine learning, including neural networks and approaches such as gradient-boosted decision trees. You'll focus on understanding the data, developing features and improving the models, rather than primarily owning production deployment.

You'll work toward defined near-term ML targetds, collaborating with the monetization team and game product teams to plan A/B tests. Over the longer term, you'll work with those teams to translate product and monetization requirements into ML objectives.

You'll start by learning the project and its business goals. Within the first three months, we'd expect you to contribute to the training pipeline and investigate features and model issues. By around six months, the aim is for you to take a more proactive role in setting the model's direction.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and improve training pipelines for dynamic pricing and recommender system models, from feature and label design through training, tuning and offline evaluation of tabular models such as neural networks and gradient-boosted trees.
  • Monitor model performance once models are live across games and products. Investigate data and concept drift, including shifts tied to new titles, client versions or user behaviour, and make models easier to extend to another product.
  • Diagnose missed model outcomes across the training pipeline, business logic and underlying data, then work through the improvements needed to restore model quality.
  • Work with monetization and product colleagues to connect model decisions to revenue and player outcomes, and help plan the A/B tests that inform what ships.
  • As you get up to speed, identify gaps in the team's understanding of the models and propose improvements to their direction.

Required Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Hands-on training and evaluation of tabular models, using neural networks or gradient-boosted trees. Experience with PyTorch, PyTorch Lightning, TensorFlow, XGBoost, CatBoost or scikit-learn could all be relevant; no single framework is required.
  • Experience designing features and labels, choosing metrics for the decision a model makes and judging when offline results warrant an A/B test.
  • Proficiency in SQL and the ability to write efficient queries to extract, manipulate and aggregate data from relational databases.
  • An investigative approach to incomplete data and longer-term requirements that need clarification.
  • The ability to explain model results to monetization and product partners in terms of revenue and player outcomes.
  • Experience in ad tech, recommender systems or online marketplaces would be useful, as would experience with production APIs or deploying ML models. Experience with the Ray framework would also be a plus. None of these is required for the role.
  • Uses AI-assisted development tools, including code assistants and LLM-based copilots, to accelerate implementation, debugging and iteration of machine learning systems while maintaining production-quality standards.
  • Critically reviews and validates AI-generated code, model implementations and infrastructure configurations for reliability, correctness and maintainability, and explores AI-powered approaches to improve developer productivity or ML platform capability.

We want to make advertising better for everyone involved, so our research spans advertisers, publishers, and consumers. Come bring your unique perspective to our team and help us build a research practice that will impact our customers, partners, and end users!

What you'll do:

  • Lead research across multiple product areas, partnering closely with product owners, engineering and design leads as well as our business counterparts.
  • Scope and complete strategic projects from early concepts through post-release measurement and iteration, integrating both qualitative and quantitative approaches along the way.
  • Lead and mentor a growing team of researchers, providing guidance and coaching to your colleagues on the UX and Product teams.
  • Be creative and resourceful in your approach to gathering insights, utilizing your relationships with clients and business partners, and knowing when to scale with vendors and secondary research.
  • Build relationships and collaborate with our business team on projects as well as conducting research with clients to understand their needs, problems and how to improve their end-to-end journey.
  • Influence and inform our product process - defining and evangelizing metrics and generating innovative ideas to expand our understanding of our users and our business.
  • Communicate and share insights from your research to the larger organization and identifying creative ways for the research team to share findings with a broader audience.
  • Drive aspects of building out our research infrastructure and operations (e.g., developing research programs, evaluating research tools, etc)

Who you are:

  • 12+ years of experience as a user researcher at a technology company
  • Possess the leadership skills to drive research programs to strategic impact using a breadth and depth of mixed method research approaches
  • You get to the “so what” and can synthesize data from multiple sources (primary, secondary) to surface insights that are valuable and feasible for the business
  • You have expertise in championing research and data-informed decisions across an organization and work with team members to identify areas of high impact for research.
  • You are comfortable working independently on complex or ambiguous problems and get creative when you have resource constraints.
  • You are a natural storyteller and know how to deliver your research findings to communicate in a way that engages stakeholders and diverse audiences, including executives.
  • You are passionate about research and stay up to date with the latest user research trends, best practices, technologies, and tools.
  • Research experience in B2B and advertising tech is a big plus.

  • Design across a wide range of experience types, including dashboards, workflow tools, data visualization, and — where relevant — AI-assisted features embedded in the product
  • Rapidly prototype concepts to test feasibility, gather feedback, and align stakeholders around a shared design vision before heavy investment
  • Drive user research and usability testing to validate design decisions and inform iteration
  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to ensure design vision and technical feasibility evolve together

Elevate Craft & Set the Bar for Visual and Interaction Design

  • Set the craft standard for visual and interaction design across the UX organization, raising the bar on clarity, polish, and consistency
  • Champion strong design fundamentals — typography, layout, color, motion, and information design — applied to complex, data-dense interfaces
  • Ensure experiences are accessible, inclusive, and usable across a wide range of customer sophistication and contexts

Partner Cross-Functionally

🎨 Who Are We?
Convelio is a licensed freight forwarding startup evolving at the intersection of Tech, Logistics and the Art World. The startup specialises in the global shipping & storage of high-end goods: paintings, sculptures, basically any valuable or bulky merchandise, alongside market leading SaaS technology to solve the problems that Registrars and Art Operations professionals face today.
Our mission is to become a tech-driven company in a traditional industry, and therefore make the shipping & storage of bulky and valuable items as easy as possible by providing an online and seamless experience.
We currently serve a wide range of customers from art galleries, antique dealers, auction houses, online platforms to interior designers.
🎩 Your Role:
You will play a key role in the handling and packaging, and transportation of artworks, antiques, and interior design objects, ensuring their integrity and safety at every step— from collection to installation.
Through your attention to detail and expertise, you will directly contribute to the quality of our service and customer satisfaction.
✏️ What you'll do:
Ensure safe handling of artworks: Carefully handle artworks, antiques, and design furniture, applying best practices to protect their integrity.
Perform detailed condition reports before and after each handling: Document the condition of each object precisely before and after handling, ensuring rigorous traceability and optimal preservation.
Packaging and protection of items: Perform careful packaging, selecting appropriate materials and methods (crating, padding, foam, etc.) to minimise risk of damage during transportation.
Loading and unloading operations: Perform the loading and unloading of trucks, ensuring secure fixation of crates and packages in the vehicles, manually or using lifting equipment as necessary.
Ensure tracking and storage of items: Use our inventory management system effectively to monitor and record the movements, locations, and statuses of artworks.
Collaborate with logistics and customer service teams: Provide prompt support to the warehouse team, operational staff, and customer service, contributing to a smooth admin management.
🧑‍🎨 Your profile:
Ideally a previous experience as an art packer or with high-end furniture moving, with the ability to assess and minimise risks associated with handling fragile and valuable items. Juniors profile are also welcome to apply.
Proficiency in using warehouse handling equipment (dollies, pallet trucks, carts, etc.) and ability to safely handle heavy items.
Solid understanding of warehouse logistics and storage systems to ensure accurate tracking of items’ movements and locations.
Precision by paying attention to detail.
Team-oriented with strong collaboration skills.
🌍 What we offer:
An opportunity to be part of a constantly developing and innovative company that is transforming the art logistics industry.
Managing customs operations for art shipments with independence and make a direct impact in a challenging and fulfilling role.
New challenges to overcome each day, making every shift engaging and dynamic.
A closer view on, valuable, and culturally significant art pieces, playing a key role in their journey to destinations worldwide.
A supportive and dynamic work environment, where your ideas and initiatives are valued.
Continuous learning and development opportunities to enhance your professional growth in the art logistics domain.

- Step 1 - First call with our recruiter
- Step 2 - On-Site interview

jobs.lever.co/convelio/ed58d628-b6a7-44a.description_excerpt:
🎨 Who Are We?
Convelio is a licensed freight forwarding startup at the forefront of the intersection between Tech, Logistics, and the Art World. We specialize in the global shipping of high-end goods, including paintings, sculptures, and other valuable or bulky merchandise.
By leveraging our proprietary algorithm, we offer real-time shipping quotes and provide an end-to-end logistics service tailored to the unique needs of the art market. Our mission is to combine technology and tradition, making the shipping of bulky and valuable items as seamless and accessible as possible.
Our diverse customer base includes art galleries, antique dealers, auction houses, online platforms, and interior designers. With over 150 colleagues spread across Paris, London, and New York, Convelio embraces a startup and international culture. We take pride in solving complex logistics challenges for our clients, enabling both sellers and buyers in the art market. Backed by cutting-edge technology and prominent VC support, we have the global network and resources (including €30 million Series B funding in March 2022) to seize exciting market opportunities.
Visit our Career Page to learn more about joining our team! 💙
🎩 Your Role:
As a Senior Freight Coordinator at Convelio, you’ll be responsible for managing the logistics of our most complex shipments, working with a variety of freight methods. You’ll be able to use your experience in the industry and attention to detail to book and coordinate our shipments from the moment the crate is completed in our warehouse through to the final delivery to the client.
You will be part of our Freight team of 6-8 Freight coordinators based near the airport at Heathrow, reporting to the Freight Team Manager. We are looking for team-members who are strong in problem-solving and processes to help build out our innovative shipping offer in the art world!
✏️ What you'll do:
- Coordinate export (90%) and import (10%) shipments from the UK, in good time and within budget, and working across different freight methods (airfreight, roadfreight, and courier)
- Prepare all documentation required for the shipments to go smoothly through customs (including AWBs, T1s, POAs, CBP, Security Declarations, Art Declarations, Lacey Acts)
- Manage the export customs declarations for your shipments (from free circulation, bond and temporary admission) in eCustoms via CDS, taking care to use the correct tariff codes and CPCs

- Manage any overseas agents we work with to complete the shipment, such as white glove partners
- Monitor our orders with reports on our internal systems, providing updates to the system
- Troubleshoot and remove roadblocks, solve complex freight situations
- Suggest and implement process improvements within the Freight & Customs team
- Work closely and collaboratively with our Customer Care and Warehouse teams
🧑‍🎨 Your profile:
- You have 5+ years of experience handling courier (DHL/Fedex or similar) shipments and air cargo shipments (booking with the airline)
- You are fluent in English and have excellent written and verbal communication skills
- You are comfortable working in a shifting environment and know how to prioritise your tasks autonomously. You are able to work very efficiently.
- You have great attention to detail and can complete documentation accurately
- Experience in art shipping and/or within the startup ecosystem is a plus
- You are an excellent learner with a desire to adapt to new concepts and technologies
🌍 What we offer:
- Flexibility and embracing technology: We work in a dynamic and evolving environment, where new processes are constantly developed. Convelio remains an agile start-up despite our growth, and quickly adapts to the market and clients’ needs

- A dynamic and kind team spirit, where you will have all space and support to fulfil your potential and where your ideas are highly valued

Success selling to CFOs and CROs

Architect & Build Solutions: Move beyond high-level strategy to hands-on execution.

Cross-Functional Feedback: Act as the "voice of the implementation" to Product and Engineering, providing detailed feedback on backend data handling, modeling flexibility, and calculation engine performance based on real-world client scenarios.

Finance Background (CPA Preferred): You speak the language of finance fluently. A background as a CPA, or significant experience in FP&A/Corporate Finance, is strongly preferred.

Implementation Heavy: You are not afraid to get your hands dirty with data. You have a track record of actually building models, not just presenting slides. You enjoy the puzzle of translating a messy spreadsheet into a clean, multidimensional model.

EPM Expertise: Deep modeling experience in at least one major EPM product is required (e.g., Adaptive Insights, Anaplan, TM1/Planning Analytics, Planful, Vena, Jedox, Abacum, Runway, etc.). You understand the mechanics of multidimensional planning.
Business Acumen: You can command a room of C-level executives. You possess the empathy to understand their stress points and the technical authority to prescribe the cure.
Agile & Technical: You are comfortable in a fast-paced startup environment where you may need to troubleshoot a data integration one hour and present a strategic roadmap to a CFO the next.
Qualifications
BA/BS degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or related field.
CPA or CA designation is highly preferred.
3+ years of experience in EPM implementation, Sales Engineering, or Technical Finance roles.

jobs.lever.co/immuta/19d612f7-5256-46e4-.description_excerpt:
Immuta is the Data Authorization Company, helping the world’s largest organizations control who, and what, can access their data.
The way enterprises access data is fundamentally changing. Organizations are racing to put data to work across analytics and AI, while AI copilots and agents are emerging as an entirely new class of data consumer. Traditional approaches built around tickets, static permissions, and manual approvals were not designed for this speed, scale, or complexity.
Immuta provides the authorization layer for modern data and AI. Our platform enables organizations to provision governed access to data by policy, by request, and dynamically for AI agents, so people and AI can access the data they need while enterprises maintain security, compliance, and control.
For Chief Data Officers, that means making enterprise data dramatically easier to access and use without giving up governance. For AI leaders, it means giving AI agents secure, governed access to enterprise data so they can move from experimentation into production.
Founded in 2015, Immuta is trusted by Fortune 500 companies and government agencies worldwide.
Our technology ecosystem includes Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Okta, ServiceNow, Teradata, Alation, Atlan, and Starburst — connecting Immuta to the data, cloud, identity, and enterprise platforms powering modern data and AI environments.
Immuta has been recognized by Forbes as a top American startup employer, by Inc. Magazine and Built In as one of the best workplaces, and by Fast Company as one of the world’s most innovative companies.
Immuta has raised $263 million from investors including NightDragon, Snowflake, Databricks, ServiceNow, Citi Ventures, Dell Technologies Capital, DFJ Growth, IAG, Intel Capital, March Capital, Okta Ventures, StepStone, Ten Eleven Ventures, and Wipro Ventures.
We operate as a hybrid workplace with offices in Boston, MA; Columbus, OH; and College Park, MD.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/fleetcraft/93b4bcd9-e02.description_excerpt:
About Fleetcraft
We’re building the critical infrastructure for the next generation of aircraft.
Aerospace demand is surging. OEMs have decade-long backlogs, new manufacturers are racing to market, and the industry is hundreds of thousands of technicians short.
The world needs more aerospace capacity, but the systems used to maintain and manufacture aircraft are slow, manual, and barely changed in decades. We’re building agents that work alongside technicians, understand the aircraft, capture the repair as it happens, and turn expertise into intelligence the whole operation can use.
Our seed was led by Susa Ventures, alongside Liquid 2 VC, early backers of Anduril and Stoke Space. You’ll work with a team that has helped launch airlines and put satellites into orbit, and with an aviation advisory board whose members have run major aircraft OEMs, led airworthiness at Gulfstream, and overseen training facilities that educate a quarter of all aircraft mechanics in the US.
The role
As a Deployment Strategist, you’ll own customer implementation end-to-end.
You’ll translate complex operational requirements into AI-solutions, work hands-on with customers to drive adoption, and turn what you learn in the field into sales and engineering priorities.
This is a highly hands-on, high-ownership role. You’ll spend time in our office with the team, but also on-site with customers in hangars, maintenance facilities, and manufacturing environments, around the world. You’ll work directly with technicians, operators, managers, and executives to understand their workflows, deploy Fleetcraft into live environments, and make sure the product becomes mission-critical.
What we're looking for
We’re looking for someone with exceptional learning velocity, commercial instinct, and technical competence. You should be pragmatic, intentional, and very structured. Aerospace experience is not required - the ability to learn quickly, adapt, and handle complex implementations with high emotional intelligence.
You should be technically fluent enough to understand AI and software systems and commercially curious enough to understand what drives customer value.
What we offer
£80k–£120k salary plus meaningful early-stage equity.
A small, high-trust team where your decisions move the whole company forward. Relocation support if needed. Modern tools, real-world impact in a regulated industry, and the chance to define how AI transforms aerospace from the ground up.
If you're energised by building production AI systems that solve hard, real-world problems - and you want the ownership and pace that only comes from being early at something important, we'd love to talk.

jobs.lever.co/valiantys/c0679bf2-88a9-43.description_excerpt:
About Valiantys
Valiantys transforms how organizations work by delivering expert solutions that increase enterprise and team agility. Valiantys unlocks the full value of Atlassian’s System of Work, helping customers revolutionize product development, streamline enterprise service management (ESM), and accelerate cloud transformation. Federal and highly regulated organizations trust Valiantys to help them maximize the potential of Atlassian solutions and reach their goals. More information about Valiantys is available at www.valiantys.com.
Job summary
Valiantys is now looking for an Enterprise Sales Lead to help us grow our services and digital transformation business in the UK.
This is a role for someone who enjoys opening important conversations, shaping complex opportunities and turning executive priorities into measurable business outcomes. You will sell high-value consulting and professional services engagements, not transactional products or standalone licenses, and work closely with consulting and delivery leaders to create solutions that matter.
Two ways to make an impact
Depending on your experience, strengths and ambitions, your role may lean towards one of two areas:
Strategic Accounts
For senior sales professionals who are comfortable engaging C-level stakeholders, navigating complex organizations and expanding strategic customer relationships over time.
You will build trusted executive relationships, identify transformation priorities, create long-term account strategies and grow the value Valiantys delivers across a customer organization.
Enterprise Growth
For high-performing enterprise sellers who thrive on creating demand, opening new logos and winning complex opportunities in competitive markets.
You will identify whitespace, build relationships from the ground up, create compelling business cases and bring new enterprise customers into the Valiantys ecosystem.
The common thread is the ability to create momentum: from the first strategic conversation to a signed engagement and a relationship that continues to grow.
What you will do
Shape transformation opportunities
Engage senior business, technology and transformation leaders to understand their priorities, challenges and desired outcomes.
Lead discovery and advisory conversations that move beyond technology features and focus on business value.
Identify, qualify and shape complex consulting, cloud and professional services opportunities.
Partner with consulting and delivery leaders to design tailored transformation programs and compelling proposals.
Build clear business cases that connect customer priorities to measurable outcomes.
Create revenue growth
Develop and execute a territory and account plan based on market insight, customer priorities and commercial objectives.
Build pipeline through a healthy mix of strategic networking, targeted prospecting, partner collaboration and account expansion.
Pursue new business within strategic enterprise accounts as well as new-logo opportunities.
Own complex sales cycles from initial hypothesis through negotiation, close and handover.
Create win-win-win outcomes for the client, Atlassian and Valiantys.
Build executive-level relationships
Establish credibility with C-level stakeholders, senior executives and transformation sponsors.
Map complex organizations and build multi-threaded relationships across business, technology, delivery and procurement teams.
Navigate stakeholders with different priorities and create alignment around a shared transformation agenda.
Work with strategic partners to create co-selling opportunities and deepen joint customer relationships.
Ensure that customer expectations, commercial commitments and delivery realities remain aligned.
Bring commercial discipline
Maintain accurate forecasting, qualification and opportunity management throughout the sales cycle.
Apply MEDDPICC or a similar methodology to create clarity, momentum and accountability.
Contribute to strategic account planning, regional strategy and commercial reporting.
Monitor portfolio performance and adjust priorities based on data, market signals and customer engagement.
Share insight, best practices and relevant market intelligence with the wider sales organization.
What you need to be successful
You may come from enterprise consulting, professional services, cloud transformation, advisory, SaaS or technology sales. You might have built your experience in an big IT services companies. What matters most is not the logo on your CV, but the complexity and value of the outcomes you have created.
You will bring most of the following:
Significant experience in enterprise IT or professional services sales, ideally with a track record of selling consulting, transformation, cloud or managed services engagements.
A proven ability to create and close complex, high-value opportunities, including multi-stakeholder and multi-year sales cycles.
Strong prospecting and business development capability. You are comfortable creating demand and opening doors, not only managing inbound opportunities or existing accounts.
Value-selling expertise. You can translate a customer challenge into a credible business case and articulate the business impact of taking action.
Executive presence. You are trusted by senior decision-makers and can communicate with clarity, confidence and commercial maturity.
A structured approach to sales. You know how to qualify, progress and forecast opportunities using MEDDPICC or a comparable methodology.
Strategic thinking combined with hands-on execution. You can build the plan and make the calls, but you are also willing to do the work required to create momentum.
Commercial curiosity. You understand how organizations make decisions, how transformation budgets are created and how partners can jointly create value.
Strong collaboration skills. You know how to bring consultants, delivery teams, partners and executives together around a shared opportunity.
Fluency in French and English. You are comfortable working with clients and colleagues in an international environment.
If you are ready to develop strategic accounts, achieve ambitious goals, and make a real impact, we would love to hear from you.
As our team operates internationally, we kindly ask that CVs be submitted in English.
Why Valiantys?
Valiantys is a fast-growing, international and entrepreneurial organization at the intersection of technology, consulting and business transformation. You will work with experienced specialists who care about the quality of the outcome—not just the signature of the contract.
What we offer
An international, multicultural team and a genuinely European scope.
A flexible telework program.
Personal dental plan and health insurance fully funded by Valiantys.
Choice of PC or Mac.
Training time and budget to support your development.
Ready to create momentum?
If you are looking for a role where you can combine enterprise selling, strategic thinking and real customer impact, we…

ABOUT DISTYL AI
Distyl is an applied AI technology company partnering with the world’s most ambitious institutions to rearchitect critical operations for the frontier of AI. Our customers include the largest companies in telecom, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing, consumer goods, and global social organizations.
We research and deploy technologies that power AI-native operations — both for our partners and for Distyl itself. Our work spans research into self-constructing systems, the development of the most reliable execution of AI systems, and products that transform mission-critical workflows. As a result, Distyl's technologies affect some of the world's largest operations — from hundreds of millions of consumer interactions to tens of millions of supply chain transactions and millions of patient journeys.
Distyl is backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Khosla Ventures, Coatue, DST Global, and the board-members of 20+ F500s.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
As an AI Strategist, you'll be the project lead on customer engagements — pairing with a technical lead to drive teams of engineers and researchers toward solving the problems that matter most to our clients. You own business outcomes. You earn trust. You see engagements through from the first discovery conversation to measurable, lasting impact.
As our first hire in London, you'll also play a meaningful role in shaping how Distyl shows up in the UK market. This role requires a curious and analytical approach, the ability to identify valuable problems to solve, strong product instincts, and a deep commitment to customer success.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
- Earn Customer Trust: You'll be Distyl's primary relationship owner — credible with end-users, compelling with C-suite stakeholders, and trusted by both
- Own Engagements End-to-End: You'll start by getting to grips with a customer's world — their workflows, their pain points, the gap between where they are and where they want to be. You'll identify where AI can make a genuine difference, scope a meaningful project, and lead your team to deliver it with precision. Delivery isn't the finish line; adoption and impact are
- Lead Cross-Functional Teams: Working alongside a technical lead, you'll direct engineers and researchers to move fast and stay focused. You'll keep the team anchored to outcomes, not just outputs
- Navigate Enterprise Data: Real enterprise data is messy. You'll know how to find the signal, understand the constraints, and design for reliability — not just accuracy in ideal conditions
- Drive User Adoption: Getting a system built is one thing. Getting people to use it, trust it, and rely on it is another. You'll own that challenge — onboarding users, gathering feedback, and iterating until the product genuinely earns its place in their workflow
- Feed the Product Roadmap: You're on the front lines. You'll surface what customers actually need, translating real-world friction into product improvements that make Distyl better for everyone
WHO YOU ARE
- Experienced in complex, client-facing work: You've led projects, managed stakeholders, and delivered results in AI, technology consulting, or a fast-moving enterprise environment.
- A strong communicator: You can hold a room with a CTO and sit down with an ops team to understand their daily frustrations. You adapt without losing your point of view.
- Genuinely curious about how things work: You embed yourself in customer workflows until you understand them better than the people doing them. You ask the second and third question, not just the first
- Comfortable with ambiguity: You can walk into a complex situation, cut through the noise, identify what actually matters, and build a path forward
- Optimistic about AI: Not naively, but with a grounded belief that applied AI can genuinely transform how organisations work, and the drive to prove it
- Technical enough to be dangerous: You're comfortable with Python, SQL, or similar tools. You don't need to be an engineer, but you need to be able to work shoulder-to-shoulder with one
- Willing to travel: Expect 25–75% travel, varying by engagement
WHAT WE OFFER
- Competitive salary, meaningful equity, and a comprehensive benefits package
- Workplace Pension Scheme with employer contributions
- Private Medical Insurance (PMI) offered
- Flexible Time Off + Holidays
- Lunch provided on office days
- Access to state-of-the-art models, generous usage of modern AI tools, and real-world business problems
- Ownership of high-impact projects across top enterprises
- A mission-driven, fast-moving culture that prizes curiosity, pragmatism, and excellence

Helping them realise value and grow their use of Vitesse calls for trusted executive relationships, a clear understanding of their priorities and close coordination across Vitesse. This is a hands-on, senior individual-contributor role for someone who enjoys solving complex customer problems and turning insight into measurable outcomes.
Your ideas will matter, and your impact will be visible.
The Role
Reporting to the Enterprise Customer Success Lead, you’ll be a senior individual contributor responsible for a small portfolio of strategic Enterprise accounts. You’ll build trusted relationships from operational teams through to executives, help customers realise measurable value and identify opportunities to grow Vitesse’s role in their treasury and payment activity.
You’ll work across Vitesse to bring the right expertise to customer priorities, manage risks and keep agreed outcomes on track.
Success will be reflected in customer health and growth in balances, payment accounts, participant connections and Vitesse’s share of customer payment activity.
Core Responsibilities
- Own strategic Enterprise customer relationships and build trusted connections with operational, technical and executive stakeholders.
- Develop and maintain Customer Success Plans tied to customer priorities, with clear measures of value, regular reviews and agreed next steps.
- Help customers realise value from Vitesse and use effective discovery to identify opportunities to grow its role across their treasury and payment activity.
- Map stakeholder groups, understand customer decision-making and maintain alignment across complex organisations.
- Identify risks and barriers early, and coordinate with customer and Vitesse teams to resolve issues and keep agreed outcomes on track.
- Partner with Sales to identify and qualify expansion opportunities, maintaining clear account plans and handovers.
- Represent customer needs in discussions with Product, Onboarding, Operations, Support, Data and Pre-Sales, and bring actionable feedback back to customers.
Why Join Us?
Vitesse is a high-growth business with a strong, open and positive culture. We combine the energy of a scale-up with a proven platform and a significant opportunity in insurance payments.
As Enterprise Customer Success Director, you’ll work with some of Vitesse’s largest and most strategically important customers. You’ll help them realise more value from Vitesse, deepen our role in their payment operations and strengthen the connections across their wider networks.
Skills and Experience
- Significant experience in Customer Success, Account Management or a related role in insurance or a complex B2B technology environment.
- A strong record of managing strategic customers and delivering measurable value, adoption and growth.
- Confidence building trusted relationships with C-suite and senior executives and acting as a strategic adviser within complex organisations.
- Experience developing Success Plans, leading business reviews and connecting customer goals to measurable outcomes.
- Strong commercial judgement and the ability to identify customer needs and credible expansion opportunities.
- Excellent discovery, communication and stakeholder-management skills.
- The ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and keep complex customer priorities moving without relying on direct authority.
- An understanding of carriers, TPAs, MGAs or the wider insurance ecosystem. or the ability to build that expertise quickly.
We understand that everyone has their own work rhythm and believe in a flexible working schedule - at Vitesse you’re expected to work 35 hours a week.
Our Values – or what we call “Vitesse at Our Best”
The Vitesse values are a true reflection of what it takes to thrive in our business, so it’s important to us that any employee who joins our business is aligned with these 3 attributes
Confident Humility
We believe the best ideas come from listening and learning. We leave ego at the door, ask for help when we need it, and celebrate collective success. When one of us wins, we all do.
Driven to Succeed
We’re ambitious about the opportunity ahead and committed to achieving it together. We hold ourselves to high standards, take pride in what we deliver, and push for meaningful outcomes for our customers, our partners, and each other.
Tenacious Responsibility
We take ownership of our work, our decisions, and our results. We face challenges with resilience, learn from setbacks, and see things through to completion. Because doing the right thing matters.
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer
We commit to creating an inclusive environment that enables everyone to perform at their best, where we recognise the rights of all individuals to mutual respect and where there is an unbiased acceptance of others. Our policies and practices aim to promote an environment that is free from all forms of unlawful or unfair discrimination and values the diversity of all people. At the heart of our policy, we seek to treat people fairly and with dignity and respect. If you require any interview adjustments please contact Clara Moretti-Parker on clara.moretti-parker@vitesse.io.

Join us in shaping the future of paid search intelligence.
Adthena is an award-winning search intelligence platform powered by patented AI technology and a team of dedicated experts. - 3+ years closing new logos as an AE, preferably in MarTech, AdTech or paid search, and you still want to carry a bag

ABOUT PAVE BANK
Welcome to Pave Bank, where we’re not just redefining banking—we’re shaping the future of global institutional finance. Inspired by leading fintech innovators and powered by a technology-first approach, we deliver smarter, faster, and more accessible banking, treasury, FX, and digital asset solutions to sophisticated institutions worldwide.
With hubs in Singapore and Tbilisi, we combine the agility of a startup with the rigor and reliability of a regulated financial institution. Our mission is to simplify complex cross-border operations, enabling exchanges, funds, fintechs, and corporates to unlock growth and seize new opportunities.
Our culture thrives on collaboration, commercial ingenuity, and a passion for solving the toughest institutional challenges. Joining Pave Bank means shaping global banking solutions, closing transformative deals, and making a tangible impact in a fast-moving, high-stakes environment. Together, we’re paving the way for the next generation of institutional finance.
ABOUT THE ROLE
The ideal candidate will be a high-calibre institutional sales professional responsible for driving Pave Bank’s institutional growth and contributing to commercial strategy. You will lead the full institutional sales lifecycle - originating and closing high-value opportunities, structuring complex multi-currency and digital asset solutions, and deepening relationships with exchanges, OTC desks, payment institutions, funds, fintechs, and corporates. Working closely with senior leadership, you will ensure institutional insights inform commercial priorities and collaborate with product, treasury, and engineering teams to deliver scalable solutions for sophisticated, high-volume clients. The role will also help lay the foundation for future team development as Pave Bank scales.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
- Drive institutional adoption of Pave Bank’s multi-currency banking, FX, settlement, digital asset, and treasury capabilities.
- Lead and close complex, high-value institutional opportunities across exchanges, OTC desks, payment institutions, funds, and fintechs.
- Structure multi-entity and cross-border solutions, including settlement, liquidity, and custody workflows.
- Develop commercial proposals, pricing structures, and revenue models that support Pave Bank’s growth strategy.
- Translate sophisticated institutional requirements into scalable banking and digital asset solutions in collaboration with product, treasury, and engineering teams.
- Shape client strategy through market mapping, institutional insights, and expansion opportunities across key verticals.
- Contribute to commercial playbooks, sales methodologies, and scalable processes as the bank grows.
- Support development of junior talent and future team scale as the organisation expands.
EXPERIENCE
- 10 to 15 years of enterprise sales or institutional coverage in banking, payments, fintech, or digital assets.
- Proven ability to originate and close complex, high-value institutional accounts.
- Strong understanding of cross-border settlement, treasury flows, liquidity structures, custody frameworks, and digital asset operations.
- Strong financial, commercial, and pricing skills.
- Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, scaling banking environment.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/pavebank/cfb56fa6-f66d-.description_excerpt:
ABOUT PAVE BANK:
Pave Bank is the world’s first programmable business bank. Built by the founders behind Monzo and BigPay, we are redefining global business banking by integrating programmable financial infrastructure with world-class client experiences.
ABOUT THE ROLE:
As a Senior Trader at Pave Bank, you'll play a key role in executing multi-asset trading strategies and managing the bank's FX and digital asset exposures, liquidity, and treasury operations across global markets. Working across G20 and emerging-market FX, fixed income, derivatives, and digital assets/stablecoins, you'll help optimise trade execution, manage risk, and strengthen the bank's network of liquidity providers and OTC counterparties.
Beyond day-to-day trading, you'll have the opportunity to build and improve trading and treasury workflows, leveraging AI tools and automation to enhance efficiency, market analysis, and decision-making. This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strong financial market expertise with a proactive, technology-driven mindset and thrives at the intersection of traditional finance and digital assets.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
HIGH-IMPACT EXECUTION
- Execute multi-asset trades across FX, digital assets, and fixed income across global corridors with high precision, speed, and strict risk discipline.
- Build and manage the firm's OTC book, actively sourcing the next high-value trading opportunities for the desk.
- Devise and implement execution strategies for the desk to maximise risk-adjusted returns.
TREASURY & RISK MANAGEMENT
- Manage real-time FX and digital asset exposures within defined limits, running smart hedging and inventory positioning across 30+ currencies.
- Own intraday and end-of-day treasury operations across banks, OTC desks, exchanges, and digital wallets — maximising capital efficiency and driving idle funds to capture yield.
PARTNER & COUNTERPARTY STRATEGY
- Help manage and expand our network of liquidity providers and OTC counterparties.
- Onboard partners, benchmark pricing performance, and eliminate single points of failure across active trading corridors.
CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION
- Collaborate directly with Operations, Compliance, Finance, and Commercial teams on settlement flows, transaction monitoring, and business development.
AI, TOOLING & PROCESS INNOVATION
- Champion the use of AI tools and automation to streamline daily desk reporting, market analysis, and treasury forecasts, cutting out manual friction wherever it lives.
WHAT YOU'LL NEED
- Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in FX, OTC execution, treasury, or liquidity management at a buy-side/sell-side institution, bank, broker, crypto firm, or fintech.
- Platform Mastery: Advanced proficiency using industry-standard trading software and financial data platforms (e.g., Bloomberg Terminal).
- Multi-Asset Knowledge: A solid grasp of global financial markets, including FX (G20 & EM), fixed income products, derivatives, and digital assets. Hands-on experience trading digital assets is a major plus.
- AI Mindset: Active familiarity with AI tools and automation methods to optimise personal workflows, solve complex operational challenges, and scale desk capacity.
- Technical & Quantitative Skills: Highly numerate with advanced Excel capabilities. Experience with SQL, Python, or building custom trading/treasury tools is a major bonus.
- Decisive & Risk-Disciplined: Strong risk fundamentals with the confidence to make quick, well-calibrated decisions in live, fast-moving markets.
- Communicator & Builder: Clear, confident communication style to lead partner discussions. A strong bias toward action, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment where execution speed is critical.
If you read through this description and don't check off every single box, but you have a strong foundation in market dynamics, a passion for digital assets, and a deep appetite to build — apply anyway. We care much more about your drive, your adaptability, and your capacity to learn than a 100% match on a checklist.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/aphex/8c0bf07c-25f0-459.description_excerpt:
About Aphex
At Aphex (https://www.aphex.co/), we believe the best way to improve construction delivery is to give people the tools and time to do their jobs. That's why we're on a mission to transform how engineers and site managers plan, communicate, and track their work every day.
Our customers are the industry's giants — building the tunnels, roads, bridges, and power stations that define our cities. Our users are the engineers and project managers who make these projects happen. Since launching in the UK in 2019, we've become the dominant platform for infrastructure and major construction projects across the UK, Australia, and New Zealand, with most of these countries' major infrastructure projects now running on Aphex.
We're now expanding into Europe and Asia. We've found strong product-market fit, proven we can scale internationally, and are building the team to do it again. Construction contributes around 10% of global GDP, yet has barely moved the needle on productivity in decades. We're changing that and the market is responding.
The Role
You've spent years on construction sites. You know what it's like when the Monday planning meeting falls apart, when the subcontractor programme is three weeks out of date, and when nobody can tell you what's actually happening next week. You've lived that frustration. We need someone who's been on the other side of the hoarding to help our biggest accounts get the most out of Aphex and grow with us as we scale internationally.
At Aphex, we believe deeply that we are in the business of successful construction project delivery. As an Account Manager, you'll embody this principle, focusing first on helping projects succeed, which naturally leads to enterprise growth and expansion opportunities.
You'll join a high-performing UK go to market team of sales and customer success professionals, stepping into a pivotal Account Manager role. We've crafted and refined our playbooks to ensure you can transition smoothly, with the support and structure needed to excel. It's perfect for someone with a deep understanding of construction, eager to leverage their experience in a fast moving and rewarding environment.
For someone ambitious and ready to make an impact, it's the perfect moment. You'll have the opportunity to influence major infrastructure delivery across the UK, working with the country's leading contractors. While initially focused on UK accounts, there's clear potential to expand your scope to our growing European customer base as we continue to scale.
What You'll Actually Do
Your core job is to make projects succeed on Aphex. When projects succeed, the account grows, new divisions, new seats, new products. You own that cycle for your accounts.
- Drive adoption on live projects — not from a distance, but by understanding how each team plans and helping them do it better with Aphex
- Build relationships with senior stakeholders — Heads of Planning, Operations Directors, Digital Leads — the people who decide whether Aphex becomes the standard
- Spot and create expansion opportunities — new divisions, new project types, new products like Aphex Diary
- Work with and lead customer success managers to deliver great onboarding and activation for customers
- Help customers build consistent operating processes across their projects so Aphex becomes how they work, not another tool to manage
- Hit your numbers — quarterly and annual expansion targets, and you'll be expected to deliver
Who This Is For
- You've been on site for 5+ years — as a Sub-Agent, Agent, or Project Manager. You know how construction projects actually run, not how textbooks say they should.
- You're ready for a change — not because you've failed in construction, but because you want to use everything you've learned differently. You want to work with technology, not against it.
- You can hold a room. You're comfortable presenting to a Site Manager, a Head of Planning, or an Operations Director — because you've worked alongside people like them your whole career.
- You take ownership. When something's yours, it's yours. You don't wait to be told what to do next.
What We Offer
- A real career change — you're not leaving construction, you're upgrading your role in it. The projects are still getting built. You're helping them get built better.
- Higher earning potential — base plus variable, structured so strong performance pays meaningfully more than traditional construction roles.
- A team that gets it — Be part of and contribute to a truly high-performing team
- Remote-first flexibility — you'll travel to sites and client offices, but you're not living in a site cabin Monday to Friday. Expectation of 2 days a week in the central London office.
- The right tools — MacBook Pro, proper setup, modern tech stack
- Genuine development — constant training, coaching, and learning to get better every day

Introduction to Role & Team
Bumble Inc. is looking for an Integrity Operations Specialist to join our Trust Operations team. Trust and safety are central to Bumble’s mission to create a world where all relationships are healthy and equitable, and in this role you’ll help bring that mission to life by supporting members through some of their most sensitive and challenging experiences.
You’ll investigate safety concerns, review accounts and content against Bumble Inc.’s Community Guidelines, and provide compassionate, trauma-informed support to members who have experienced safety incidents. You’ll work across a range of complex and sensitive issues, using established policies, operational guidance, sound judgment, and AI-supported tools to reach fair and consistent outcomes. You’ll also collaborate closely with colleagues across Trust & Safety, Customer Experience, and Legal, taking ownership of cases and demonstrating our Bumble values of Respect, Curiosity, and Excellence in how you support our community and one another.
This role will be based in the U.K. and will report to the Senior Integrity Operations Manager.
Please note that this position involves exposure to sensitive and graphic content, including but not limited to vulgar, violent, and sexual content.
What you’ll do
- Investigate and take action on member reports and proactive detections involving safety concerns, including harassment, threats, non-consensual imagery, and other potential violations of Bumble Inc.’s Community Guidelines.
- Provide thoughtful, high-touch and trauma-informed support to members who have experienced safety incidents, demonstrating Respect and care while following established safety processes.
- Review accounts and content flagged for potential safety violations, applying policies and operational guidance consistently while using sound judgment to determine appropriate next steps.
- Manage sensitive and time-critical cases with attention to detail, taking ownership of your work and seeing cases through from initial review to an appropriate outcome.
- Collaborate purposefully with Trust & Safety, Customer Experience, Legal, and other partners to escalate and help resolve cases that require additional expertise or support.
- Identify recurring issues, patterns, and opportunities to improve workflows, sharing insights that can strengthen operational consistency and member safety.
- Use AI-supported tools and internal systems to improve efficiency and support decision-making, reviewing outputs critically for accuracy, bias, privacy, and fairness and applying human judgment before taking action.
- Participate in on-call rotations, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed, adapting with an agile mindset to support our global community.
About you
- Requires 1+ years of experience, though we welcome candidates with alternative backgrounds that demonstrate equivalent skills.
- Bring experience in Trust & Safety, customer support, crisis response, content moderation, or another environment where you have handled sensitive or safety-related issues.
- Are comfortable reviewing potentially distressing content, including material relating to child exploitation, sexual or physical violence, suicide and self-harm, while approaching this work with care and professionalism.
- Communicate clearly and compassionately in writing and verbally, particularly when supporting vulnerable individuals or navigating sensitive situations.
- Apply sound judgment within established policies and processes, balancing efficiency with careful, consistent decision-making and demonstrating Bumble’s values of Respect and Excellence.
- Collaborate purposefully with colleagues, take ownership of your work, and maintain an agile mindset as priorities, cases, and operational needs evolve.
- Proficiency in Spanish, Portuguese, French, or another language in addition to English is welcomed but not required.

Founded by Whitney Wolfe Herd in 2014, Bumble was one of the first dating apps built with women at the center and connects people across dating (Bumble Date) and friendship (BFF). BFF is a friendship app where people in all stages of life can meet people nearby and create meaningful platonic connections and community based on shared interests. Badoo, which was founded in 2006, is one of the pioneers of web and mobile dating products.

About billups
We don’t trade in hype. At billups, we’re reimagining how brands show up in the real world, literally. Powered by patented technology, proprietary AI, and a global team of 400+, we’re reinventing Out-of-Home (OOH) media to help brands connect with people in physical spaces, with more precision, intelligence, and impact than ever before. We move fast, think boldly, and collaborate deeply. Fiercely independent, with a presence in 20+ countries, we back smart ideas with data, technology, and trust. Growth is on the table, professionally and personally. We invest in talent and celebrate our people, plain and simple. Curious? Let’s talk.
What You'll Do
The Client Team (comprising Client Services and Client Development functions) undertakes a wide range of responsibilities in driving Billups’ business forward, developing and nurturing client and partner relationships. As part of our Client Services function, the Account Executive role collaborates closely with peers, Account Manager(s), Senior Account Manager(s), Account Director(s) and Senior Account Director(s) in:
Core Role Duties
Media Planning & Buying
- Support the day-to-day management of your clients, effectively servicing them, and proactively contributing to growing client and agency business
- Support the Client Development function with the creation of, or access to, materials or content
- Ability to explain your media plan rationale to your line managers and work on translating that into client decks and emails, ensuring that your recommendation is delivered on the client brief
- Media plan development, RFP collation, grid development, Platform/mapping, planning tools & systems, posting instructions, creating POP reports, amongst other tasks
- Small-level plan/project development/ownership, low-level negotiations, and managing client relationships with high-level oversight from the line manager are the main tasks
Project Management
- Assist in managing shared file drive systems, ensuring all documents and content are appropriately saved and regularly updated. Compile, organize, and maintain accurate, up-to-date campaign files such as buy specs, decks, POP, etc
- With oversight, responsible for Billups’ delivery in ensuring the timely activation of media campaigns for your clients
- Track campaign start dates and ensure everything is ready to go live on time; liaise with relevant vendors to manage artwork delivery and approval processes
- With oversight, provide responsible campaign reporting for your clients - access ‘Proof of Posting (POP)’ and Campaign Attribution, ensuring this is received by clients and/or their agencies in a timely fashion
- Generate consistency and maintain high accuracy in all work through the adoption of appropriate templates and guidelines, ensuring operational excellence
- Help coordinate calendars to arrange team meetings or presentations
Who You Are
- Excellent organizational skills.
- Exceptional attention to detail with the ability to maintain high levels of accuracy in tasks.
- Must showcase strong time management skills.
- Ability to manage multiple deadlines while maintaining high-quality standards.
- Strong ability to receive and apply constructive feedback to achieve improved outcomes.
- Good relationship management skills with the ability to communicate with directors, managers, and peers - both internally and externally. Establishing and maintaining excellent rapport.
- Demonstrating tact and diplomacy in communicating with clients/agencies and media suppliers, as well as with colleagues internally.
- Bringing creativity and passion to your work, embracing change and innovation.
- Collaborating and contributing to the establishment of a positive team spirit. Being proactive and a team player, with the ability to engage others.
Qualifications
Ability to perform essential job duties with or without reasonable accommodation and without posing a direct threat to the safety or health of employees or others. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential duties.
Education & Experience
Degree from a three-year college or university course preferably in the following areas of study: advertising, media or related field; 1-2 years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/cello/0e693e6a-de29-4ec.description_excerpt:
🚀 Why join
- AI-powered infrastructure company with $10.3M in funding from top-tier investors.
- Exciting product: APIs, attribution models, MCP integration, AI-based recommendation engines, and assistants - not your typical CRUD app.
- Real traction: 30+ new customers every month, 10M+ end users monthly.
- Small team, so you'll genuinely shape how we build things.
- You'll touch everything from frontend widgets to backend infrastructure to data pipelines. The work doesn't get repetitive.
- We actively learn about new tech and AI tools and adopt where we can — we have to, because our customers do.
- Remote-first, but we get together regularly - company-wide and as an engineering team.
- The founding team consists of serial founders and experienced big-tech operators from Twilio, Wise, and Skype.
🌟 WHAT WE’RE BUILDING
We help SaaS companies turn their users and partners into a sales channel through referrals, sharing, and recommendations - 10M+ end users interact with our system every month.
Our widgets live inside customer products, which means your code runs in environments you don't control. On top of that: APIs that customer developers integrate against, and a portal where customers manage their campaigns and analytics.
Under the hood: attribution across complex user journeys, AI-based recommendation engines, multi-tenant infrastructure serving hundreds of customers, scaling millions of events. Deeper than you'd expect from a referral tool.
Our product is integrated by customer developers - and that world is changing fast. The people building against our APIs and widgets range from corporate engineering teams to solo founders using AI coding agents. Keeping up with how developers work today, and making sure our product fits into all of those workflows, is one of the more interesting challenges here.
YOUR MISSION
- Stack: AWS · Terraform · NestJS · PostgreSQL · GitLab CI/CD
- You work directly with stakeholders - no walls, no ticket factory.
- Manage AWS infrastructure - architecture, reliability, security, and cost. No infrastructure team above you.
- Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines that let engineers ship confidently and fast - from commit to production with zero manual steps.
- Sometimes we ship fast to learn, sometimes we slow down to fix the foundation - you'll help decide where to lean.
- Real influence on architecture and product direction, not just coding tickets.
- Help us adopt the latest AI improvements to speed up how we build and ship.
ABOUT YOU
Required
- Good communication skills and a collaborative attitude
- Experience building systems at real scale: high traffic, large user base, high availability
- Deep AWS expertise across compute, messaging, storage, networking, and observability - not just familiarity, but operational instinct built from running things in production
- Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar) - you version everything, you don't click around in consoles
- Solid distributed systems thinking: ordering guarantees, idempotency, retries, at-least-once delivery, partial failure recovery
- Experience running PostgreSQL in production - configuration, connection pooling, migrations, performance, backup and restore
- Enough application-layer literacy to read TypeScript/Node.js (NestJS) code and understand what a service is doing, not just that it's running
- You know when "good enough" is right - and when to invest in quality
- You are a strong problem solver - you can break down complex, ambiguous problems and ship pragmatic solutions, not just debug what's already in front of you
- You contribute ideas and challenge assumptions, not just execute
- You're genuinely curious about the product itself - you want to understand what we're building and why, not just pick up tickets and ship code.
- You live at the bleeding edge of agentic coding. Claude Code, Cursor, multi-agent setups, MCP servers, whatever ships next, you're using it and pushing it to its limits. We move fast on adopting what works
