jobs.ashbyhq.com/codat/6df71610-35aa-44b.description_excerpt:
About Codat
Codat is an advisory intelligence solution purpose-built for modern commercial banking. Through rich, specialized data, forward-looking insights, and integrated workflows, Codat empowers banking teams to deepen their relationships, grow their revenue, and simplify their day-to-day work.
Founded in 2017 and backed by JPMorgan, PayPal, Amex, Plaid, and Shopify, Codat has successfully powered over 350,000 connections to business customers’ financial systems — and is trusted by industry leaders to turn scattered information into actionable, strategic advantages in real time, every time.
WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?
We are looking for a deeply experienced commercial banking practitioner to join Codat as we build the Advisory Intelligence layer for commercial banking. You will be the voice of the banker inside our product organization — the person who knows, from years of first-hand experience, how relationship managers and treasury officers actually serve their clients, where the revenue lives in a commercial banking book, and what an insight has to look like before a banker will act on it. This is a product subject matter expert role first and foremost: you will shape the data and insights modules that Codat's Banking Context Engine generates for banker users. You will use these expertise in front of prospects and customers, working alongside our GTM team in conversations with some of the largest commercial banks in North America and the UK.
The Role
This role sits at a unique intersection between Product, GTM and strategy covering the following broad intersection.
- Design actionable insights: Work hand in hand with Product Managers to deliver the substance of the insight modules our Banking Context Engine delivers — defining what signals matter across Treasury & Payments, FX, supply chain finance, working capital and lending, what a banker needs to see to act, and what "actionable" genuinely means in the context of a client conversation. You'll separate insights that generate fee revenue and deepen relationships from noise that erodes banker trust.
- Be the voice of the banker: Bring the daily reality of commercial bankers and treasury management officers into every product decision — coverage models, portfolio reviews, pre-call preparation, annual pricing conversations, cross-sell motions — so that what we build fits how banks actually work rather than how outsiders imagine they work.
- Consult into the product build: Actively collaborate with our product and engineering teams as they build the Banking Context Engine and its MCP integration with Microsoft Copilot, translating banking domain knowledge into concrete requirements, evaluation criteria, and quality bars for generated insights.
- Support GTM as the banking SME: Join sales conversations, demos, and executive meetings with prospect and customer banks as the credible domain expert in the room. Support discovery by speaking the language of bank product heads, treasury management leaders and commercial banking executives, and help our GTM team pressure-test messaging against how banks really buy.
- Sharpen how banks measure value: Help build the ROI narratives that connect Codat's insights to outcomes banks care about — fee revenue growth from the existing book, expanded coverage without added headcount, and client retention against fintech encroachment.
- Build institutional knowledge: Codify what you know — banker workflows, product economics, org structures, buying dynamics — into reusable assets that raise the banking fluency of the whole company.
What you'll bring to the team
- Substantial first-hand experience inside commercial banking — as a treasury management officer or sales/product lead, commercial relationship manager, or commercial product manager serving mid-market and SMB clients
- A working command of how commercial banks make money from operating relationships: treasury and payments fee structures, deposit economics, FX, card, supply chain finance and working capital products, and how these are priced, bundled and cross-sold
- Deep familiarity with how banks organize coverage — RM and TMO territory models, portfolio segmentation, call planning, and the practical constraints that determine whether a client gets proactive advice or none at all
- The ability to translate domain expertise into product requirements: you can tell a product team precisely why an insight will or won't land with a banker, and articulate what would change that
- Credibility and composure in front of senior bank executives — you have sat across from (or been) the heads of treasury management, commercial banking or product at a significant institution, and can hold that room
- Genuine curiosity about AI-assisted banking workflows — familiarity with copilot-style tools (e.g. Microsoft Copilot) and an informed point of view on where AI genuinely helps bankers.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/codat/3ce952fb-f734-4d9.description_excerpt:
About Codat
Codat is an advisory intelligence solution purpose-built for modern commercial banking. Through rich, specialized data, forward-looking insights, and integrated workflows, Codat empowers banking teams to deepen their relationships, grow their revenue, and simplify their day-to-day work.
Founded in 2017 and backed by JPMorgan, PayPal, Amex, Plaid, and Shopify, Codat has successfully powered over 350,000 connections to business customers’ financial systems — and is trusted by industry leaders to turn scattered information into actionable, strategic advantages in real time, every time.
The Role
We're building the AI Assistant for commercial bankers. Relationship managers, treasury and credit teams use it to understand their business customers and act faster, and you'll be right in the middle of building it.
This is a hands-on job for people who like building and want to stay as an individual contributor. You'll design and ship the things the assistant depends on, and they'll still be yours once they're live. You'll also get a real say in where it goes next. That means making your case to engineers, product and the commercial team, and bringing them along with you.
What You'll Work On
- The pipelines the assistant draws on, from raw source data to the numbers it quotes. You'll build them and keep them running.
- The layers on top: metrics, definitions and the relationships between them, so a pile of financial data becomes something the assistant can reason over.
- Testing and observability. We want what we ship to get more reliable, and we want the people around you to get better at it too.
You'll Probably Have
- Built pipelines and production systems from scratch, writing the code yourself rather than mostly configuring managed services. If we ask about the hardest logic you've written, you'll have a story ready.
- Good Python habits. Your tests are the kind someone else would be glad to inherit.
- Real depth in a few of SQL, Spark, Databricks/Delta Lake, Dagster/Airflow/Temporal and dbt, and opinions about which ones annoyed you.
- Time with CI/CD, Docker and cloud infrastructure. Even better if you set them up for a team.
- An interest in the business behind the data. If the data says the request is wrong, you'll say so.
- AI already built into how you work. You can show us where it saved you real time, or got you up to speed on something new.
- Nice to have: some experience getting data ready for LLMs, like semantic layers, text-to-SQL or retrieval.
How We Work
We're a small team with plenty to do. Things move fast: we'd rather ship something useful and improve it than polish it in private. What you build is yours from start to finish.
There’s no return-to-office mandate, and you can work hybrid or fully remote. We trust you to be around when the team needs you and to deliver what you said you would. What we don’t want is anyone staying online late to prove a point.

Cinder gives platforms one command center to fight back: to write and enforce policy, deploy AI agents against abuse in real time, investigate threats, file NCMEC reports, and prove their safety programs are working.

We're a small, fast-moving team backed by Accel and Y Combinator. We care about being intentional, direct, and deeply focused on solving real customer problems.
WHY THIS ROLE
Cinder is hiring an Enterprise Account Executive to help scale our go-to-market motion and drive the next phase of company growth.
This role is responsible for generating pipeline, running complex enterprise sales cycles, and closing high-value deals with companies building AI systems and operating large online platforms.
You’ll work closely with Cinder’s founders, product team, Sales Engineer, and marketing team to bring our platform to organizations solving some of the most challenging safety and integrity problems on the internet.
This is a full-cycle sales role: you will generate pipeline through outbound prospecting, manage deals end-to-end, and expand relationships with existing customers.
If you enjoy selling technical products, navigating complex organizations, and helping define a new category, this role offers an opportunity to do meaningful work with ambitious customers.
WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON
GENERATE PIPELINE
- Identify high-potential target accounts across AI companies, large online platforms, and emerging markets such as fraud and risk operations.
- Run highly personalized outbound outreach to senior technical and operational leaders.
- Work with founders, investors, and partners to unlock introductions and develop strategic opportunities.
- Build and maintain a robust pipeline through disciplined outbound activity.
RUN COMPLEX ENTERPRISE SALES CYCLES
- Lead discovery conversations to understand customer challenges around AI safety, fraud, and trust & safety operations.
- Identify champions and economic buyers across multiple stakeholders such as engineering, security, operations, policy, and legal.
- Develop structured deal strategies and guide opportunities through procurement and close.
- Own the full sales cycle from first conversation through signed agreement.
DRIVE TECHNICAL SALES ENGAGEMENTS
- Partner with Cinder’s Sales Engineer to run product demonstrations and technical validation.
- Help customers understand how Cinder integrates into their workflows and infrastructure.
- Translate complex product capabilities into clear business value.
EXPAND EXISTING CUSTOMERS
- Identify opportunities to expand deployments into new teams or use cases.
- Support renewals and drive upsell opportunities as customer needs grow.
HELP SHAPE THE SALES MOTION
- Provide feedback on messaging, positioning, and pricing as we continue defining the category.
- Collaborate with product and marketing teams to refine how we communicate Cinder’s value in the market.
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
- Have 5+ years of experience selling B2B SaaS or technical infrastructure products
- Have experience closing six-figure enterprise deals
- Are comfortable managing multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles
- Have strong outbound prospecting skills and can build pipeline without SDR support
- Enjoy selling technical products to engineering, security, or operations teams
- Thrive in early-stage environments where sales motions are still evolving
- Are curious and eager to learn new domains such as AI safety, platform integrity, and online risk
- Communicate clearly with both technical and executive stakeholders
- Are comfortable operating with ambiguity and taking initiative
NICE TO HAVE
- Have sold developer tools, AI infrastructure, or security software
- Have experience selling to companies building AI systems or operating large user platforms
- Have familiarity with Trust & Safety, fraud detection, or risk operations
- Have worked at an early-stage startup where you helped build the sales motion
- Have a technical background (engineering, data science, or similar)
LOCATION & BENEFITS
We're based in NYC and would relocate the right person for this role. We believe in working together in person and hold at least two all-company events per year. We offer health, vision & dental benefits, a 401(k) plan with employer matching, fully paid commuter benefits, and a fully stocked office with paid lunch and dinner.

ABOUT CARTESIA
Our mission is to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world like humans do.
We're pioneering the model architectures that will make this possible. Our founding team met as PhDs at the Stanford AI Lab, where we invented State Space Models or SSMs, a new primitive for training efficient, large-scale foundation models. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering paired with a design-minded product engineering team to build and ship cutting edge models and experiences.
We're funded by leading investors at Index Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners, along with Factory, Conviction, A Star, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Databricks and others. We're fortunate to have the support of many amazing advisors, and 90+ angels across many industries, including the world's foremost experts in AI.
ABOUT THE ROLE
We’re opening our first ever office in Europe, and looking to hire incredible talent in London to advance our mission of building real-time multimodal intelligence.
YOUR IMPACT
- Conduct groundbreaking research in neural network architecture design to advance the state-of-the-art (SOTA) in alternative architectures (e.g., state space models, efficient Transformers, hybrid architectures).
- Design novel architectures that improve model quality, inference efficiency, and adaptability across diverse deployment environments, from cloud to on-device.
- Explore and develop capabilities such as statefulness, long-range memory, and innovative conditioning mechanisms for enhancing model expressiveness and generalization.
- Investigate how architectural decisions impact model trade-offs, including scalability, robustness, latency, and energy efficiency.
- Develop new frameworks and tools to evaluate architectural innovations, benchmarking performance across research and production settings.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate architectural research into scalable and impactful systems for real-world applications.
WHAT YOU BRING
- Deep expertise in architecture design, with experience in researching or deploying advanced architectures (e.g., state space models, transformers, RNN variants, CNN variants).
- Strong understanding of how architectures interact with system constraints, including deployment in cloud environments or on-device.
- Proficiency in designing architectures that balance quality, efficiency, and adaptability across different use cases and modalities (e.g., vision, audio, text).
- Familiarity with generative modeling paradigms like autoregressive and diffusion models, and designing capabilities such as statefulness and conditioning in deep learning models.
- A proven research track record in top-tier ML/AI venues (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR) or demonstrable contributions to state-of-the-art architectures.
- Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on experimentation and iterative refinement.
- Strong programming skills in deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, and experience with profiling tools for understanding model performance.
NICE-TO-HAVES
- Prior research or publications in state space models, efficient Transformers or other alternative architectures.
- Research or practical experience in designing architectures for multi-modal systems.
- Early-stage startup experience or a track record of rapid innovation in R&D environments.
MORE DETAILS
🏢 In-office policy: We’re an in-person team based out of offices in 🇺🇸 San Francisco, 🇬🇧 London and 🇮🇳 Bangalore. We love being in the office, hanging out together, and learning from each other every day.
🌎 Visa sponsorship: We provide visa sponsorship support and assess each circumstance on a case-by-case basis. However, visa sponsorship is dependent on many factors, including the role you are applying for, and the location you are going to be based, and so we can't always guarantee success. Your Recruiter will work with you to understand your visa sponsorship needs from the first call.
🚢 We ship fast. All of our work is novel and cutting edge, and execution speed is paramount. We have a high bar, and we don’t sacrifice quality or design along the way.
🤝 We support each other. We have an open & inclusive culture that’s focused on giving everyone the resources they need to succeed.
OUR BENEFITS (US EMPLOYEES ONLY)
💰 Compensation Competitive base salary alongside attractive equity package.
🩺 Health Insurance Fully covered medical insurance along with dental and vision for you and your family.
🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Parental Leave 9 weeks paternity & 12 weeks maternity leave
🏦 401(k)
🚆 Commuter Allowance A monthly stipend to help you get to and from the office.
🏖️ Flexible PTO Take as much time as you need to recharge your batteries.
🍲 Meals & Snacks Lunch, dinner and plenty of snacks, provided daily.
🦖 Your own personal Yoshi
OUR COMMITMENT TO EQUAL OPPORTUNITY
Cartesia is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

ABOUT DELFA
Billions of people still suffer from every-day diseases.
One key reason? Clinical trials are broken.
Despite $120 billion spent each year, most trials are delayed due to bottlenecks like patient recruitment.
Delfa is fixing this with autonomous AI agents. We're building AI agents to automate clinical trials.
In the last year from we’ve already:
- Deployed onto 500+ trials across multiple conditions
- Reached seven figures in ARR, growing 25% MoM
- Raised an oversubscribed $3.8m seed from tier-one AI investors
WHAT YOU'LL DO
You'll build and scale the core systems that enable Delfa's AI agents to deliver real-world clinical impact.
- Design, build, and scale AI agent systems end-to-end: from voice interactions to intelligent workflow orchestration across trial sites
- Own complex projects from architecture to deployment, with real autonomy over technical decisions
- Build and evolve the infrastructure, observability, and monitoring systems needed to ensure quality and reliability at scale
- Integrate leading-edge models from AI labs into production workflows, evaluating and adopting new capabilities as the frontier moves
- Design robust data pipelines for ingesting, transforming, and serving high-quality healthcare data
- Continuously improve internal AI tooling and platform to unlock new use cases and increase team velocity
Our current tech stack:
FastAPI · Pydantic · TypeScript · React · OpenAI / Anthropic · Temporal · PostgreSQL · Honeycomb · PlanetScale · Azure
YOU'LL BE A GREAT FIT IF…
- You have 3+ years of professional full-stack engineering experience: We're looking for somebody comfortable with solving hard technical problems, refactoring when needed, and knowing what's enough and what's too much to solve a problem.
- A track record of building high-quality products fast: Delfa's got big ambitions to materially accelerate getting life saving treatments to market. This is necessary and urgent work so we need individuals who can deliver.
- An ownership mindset: We position our team to understand customer problems, give you the autonomy to find the best path forward, and expect you to own the solutions.
- A growth mindset: We're looking for people who take pride in their work and are always looking to improve it. If your work doesn't matter to you, it won't end up mattering to our customers. If you're not growing, your impact won't grow either.
LIFE AT DELFA
Delfa is building a generational company to transform the way medications reach millions of patients in need.
This is your opportunity to get in on the ground floor and work alongside the highest talent density team in the space, onsite at our London office 5 days a week:
- A wine-snob who built foundation models at Roche during ETH Zurich PhD
- A former hedge fund trader with world class causal AI knowledge
- A medical doctor turned AI engineer who builds prototypes on the weekend for fun
- A ginger bloke who deployed production AI for J&J, Medtronic, and Exscientia
WHAT WE OFFER
- Competitive salary + meaningful equity
- Private health insurance and gym membership
- 25 days’ holiday + UK public holidays
- Modern office space 5 mins from Old Street station
- True 0 → 1 ownership. You’ll take full responsibility for critical product features that get new treatments to patients, faster.
OUR HIRING PROCESS
We work to get you an offer within a week with the following lean process:
1. Intro chat with https://www.linkedin.com/in/farrandtom/%5CGustav https://www.linkedin.com/in/gustavbredell/ (CTO) - 30 mins: An informal discussion about your experiences, values, and career goals, and give you an opportunity to get a sense of the role and the team. After this call we may ask you to share some work you’re proud of.
2. Coding Challenge - 90 mins: No artificial interview questions. Instead, you will work through a real-world challenge similar to problems we solve every day. You are welcome to use AI tools. We believe great engineers should know how to solve problems effectively, including with AI.
3. System Design Challenge - 90 mins: We will invite you to our office to spend time with us in person. Together, we will work through a real-world system design problem. This is the best opportunity for you to see what it would be like to work with us, and for us to understand how you think and collaborate.
4. Offer. If all the above goes well then you’ll receive an offer from us!
If helping unstick clinical trials and getting life-saving treatments to patients faster sounds like your idea of important work, let’s talk.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/fyxer/f35c58b2-7921-441.description_excerpt:
Location: Chancery Lane, London (Office-based 4 days)
THE MISSION
At Fyxer, we believe the only sustainable competitive advantage for a startup is the quality and speed of execution.
We are looking for a Product Lead who operates like a Staff PM: someone who owns our most important product bets end-to-end, from ambiguous problem space to shipped outcome. You combine sharp product judgment with hands-on discovery skills, and you measure yourself on commercial impact, not output.
We're not looking for someone to write specs and manage a backlog. We want someone who helps us think better, decide better, and ship better. The goal isn't more process, it's higher quality decisions made faster.
You will work directly with our Head of Product, CTO, founders and senior engineers to shape what we build and why.
WHAT YOU WILL OWN
You will not hand anything over. You will own the bet from first insight to shipped impact.
- Own discovery through delivery for our most important product bets, from early ambiguity to validated direction to launched product
- Work directly with engineers and founders from the start of any initiative as the accountable product owner, not a coordinator
- Frame the problem, define the hypothesis, and choose the fastest route to signal: interviews, prototypes, fake doors, experiments, or just shipping and measuring
- Translate messy qualitative and quantitative signals into clear product direction, then drive that direction through to execution
- Set success metrics, make the call on when there's enough signal to build, and own the outcome either way
- Embed structured learning loops into how we operate so insight compounds over time
- Raise the bar of product thinking across the team: coach others, introduce lightweight frameworks, and get the whole company closer to customers
WHO YOU ARE
You are a full-stack product thinker.
- Outcome owner: You connect user behaviour to funnels, retention, and revenue. You think in bets and expected value, not feature lists, and you hold yourself accountable to results.
- Discovery-strong: Genuinely fluent across qualitative research, behavioural insight, and experimentation. You generate strong signal quickly and pick the right method for the decision at hand, rather than outsourcing the thinking.
- Engineering partner: You work shoulder to shoulder with engineers, translating insight into crisp problem framing and practical tradeoffs. Engineers want to work with you because you make the work clearer, not slower.
- Decision oriented: You know when there's enough signal to move. You sharpen hypotheses, clarify thinking, and make confident calls under uncertainty. You'd rather ship and learn than perfect and wait.
- Force multiplier: Your impact shows up in how the whole team operates. You build repeatable systems for discovery and decision-making that outlast any single project.
THE ROLE
You will be the senior product voice on our most important initiatives, working directly with the Head of Product, CPGO, founders, and senior engineers. This is not a support function. You will be embedded in high impact work from day one, with real authority over what we build and why.
You will operate at speed. We care about generating signal quickly, making informed decisions, and shipping fast. You are comfortable working with imperfect information and tightening your thinking as you go.
You will move fluidly across the full product lifecycle. Some weeks you will be deep in user interviews or pressure testing a major bet, other weeks you will be in the detail with engineers getting something over the line.
You will have significant autonomy. We expect strong judgment, clear communication, and ownership of outcomes.
If there are specific tools you believe are critical to moving faster or generating better signal, we will support that. We want you to design the right setup, not work around constraints.
WHY FYXER?
We are intentional about our team. We believe a small, exceptional team working with extreme focus will always outperform a large, bloated organization.
- Autonomy: We hire people who want ownership and then we actually give it to them.
- Velocity: You will be fast-tracked into senior responsibilities far earlier than at a traditional company.
- Scale: We are on track to hit $100M in revenue by the end of 2026. This is a rare opportunity to join a high-growth rocket ship at the foundational stage.
#LI-FYX

Docebo is on a thrilling mission to actively build—not just maintain—an incredible regional marketing motion across EMEA, and we are looking for a true builder to lead the way. As the VP of Marketing, EMEA, you will masterfully own the strategy and execution that drives explosive growth, pipeline, and enterprise penetration across vital markets like the UK, SEEMA, DACH, and France. - Architect the Strategy: Develop and execute Docebo's dynamic regional marketing strategy across Europe, tying it directly to pipeline targets and revenue outcomes.
- Partner for Pipeline: Co-own the pipeline with regional Sales leadership—operating as a strategic partner fully accountable to the exact same numbers, not merely as a service function.
- Drive the Campaigns: Lead comprehensive regional campaign planning, taking charge of digital marketing, events, partner marketing, and customer marketing initiatives.
- Translate the Narrative: Take Docebo's powerful global AI product narrative and creatively craft messaging that deeply resonates with European enterprise buyers.
- Balance the Brand: Ensure that all regional programs accurately reflect local market dynamics while rigorously maintaining Docebo's global brand and positioning standards.
- Build the Team: Develop and lead a high-performing regional team, including field and regional marketing leaders, to create a culture of accountability, growth, and cross-functional trust.
- Master the Resources: Serve as the strong voice for the EMEA market in global executive discussions while managing regional marketing budgets, agency relationships, and performance reporting with rigor.
YOUR SUPERPOWERS 🦸‍♀️🦸‍♂️
- Marketing Maestro: Bring 14+ years of progressive B2B SaaS marketing experience with meaningful, high-level leadership responsibility to the table.

- ABM Authority: Possess deep fluency in Account-Based Marketing (ABM) strategy and execution, fundamentally knowing what excellent execution actually looks like.
- Strategic Peer: Demonstrate your experience in co-owning pipeline targets with revenue leadership and comfortably operating as a trusted peer to other regional leaders.
- Campaign Champion: Leverage your strong background in demand generation, digital marketing, impactful events, and holistic integrated campaigns.
- Data-Driven Decision Maker: Utilize your strong analytical capabilities to actively make strategic decisions with data, rather than just justifying them after the fact.
- Globetrotting Leader: Manage budgets and agencies across multiple markets with exceptional stakeholder skills, and travel regularly across key EMEA markets (UK, Germany, France) with quarterly trips to our headquarters.
OUR HYBRID WORK PHILOSOPHY 🤝
Great work can happen anywhere but coming together helps us go further. Our team spends three days a week in the office (Tuesday-Thursday) to collaborate, solve problems, and learn from each other. With flexibility the rest of the week, it’s a balance designed to help everyone do their best work and keep growing.
OUR TOTAL REWARDS PHILOSOPHY 🎉
Our Total Rewards Philosophy centers around three core areas to reward and care for our People:
- Rewarding Impact: We lead with competitive pay to reward the impact, skills and traits that fuel our success.
- Fostering Holistic Wellbeing: We care deeply about and invest in the whole person with programs that support our people’s physical, mental, and financial well-being.
- Empowering Our Talent Culture: We build a culture of trust and empowerment by designing our rewards and benefits with transparency, equity, and flexibility, enabling our people to do their best work and stay for the long haul.
OUR PROMISE TO YOU 😍
- Financial Wellness: Own a piece of Docebo through our Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP) at a 15% discount, plus a competitive compensation package.
- Your Well-Being, Covered: You’ll get access to health benefits, so you can get the care you need when you need it.
- Rest, Relax, Repeat: Rest and recharge with paid vacation days, two company-wide Docebo Days, floating holidays for cultural celebrations, and your birthday off!
- Family First: We provide coverage offering you time with your little one(s) so you can soak up all those precious moments. Fun fact: we had 30 Docebian babies join the family in 2025!
- Connections That Count: Connect with global communities through our Employee Resource Groups (including PRIDE, DWA, BIDOC, and Green Ambassadors) and company-wide events that keep the fun rolling all year long.
ABOUT DOCEBO 💙
At Docebo, we create seamless, AI-powered learning experiences for over 3,000 customers worldwide. We have successfully achieved two IPOs (TSX: DCBO & NASDAQ: DCBO https://www.docebo.inc/home/default.aspx), been recognized as a top SaaS e-learning solution, and are growing exponentially in the process. We're a global company, with office across North America, EMEA, APAC, and beyond. Our team is guided by five core values—Grow Together Win Together, Build with Our Customer, Clear is Kind, Own Outcomes, Progress Over Perfection—that shape everything we do. If this resonates with you, now is the perfect time to join one of the fastest-growing learning technology companies in the world.

We help enterprises turn strategy into action by combining a neuro-symbolic reasoning core, seamless data activation, and agentic workflows. Our platform reduces execution drag, accelerates growth, and delivers measurable business outcomes for some of the world’s most complex organizations.
JOB DESCRIPTION
We are looking for Forward Deployed Engineers — elite technologists who embed directly with our clients to tackle their most critical growth challenges. In this role, you’ll work side-by-side with executives, engineers, and our Tier 1 consulting partners to design, deploy, and scale AI-powered workflows that transform how enterprises operate.
In this role, you will own the solution end-to-end: uncovering opportunities, architecting integrations, orchestrating AI models, and proving measurable ROI in weeks, not months. This is a high-impact, high-visibility position at the intersection of technology, strategy, and execution.
OBJECTIVES OF THE ROLE
- Lead end-to-end technical delivery for enterprise engagements, from discovery through deployment.
- Embed with client teams to scope high-value workflows, architect integrations, and orchestrate AI models.
- Act as the technical counterpart during onboarding and proof-of-value phases — ensuring fast time-to-value and successful go-lives.
- Partner with internal Product, Data Science, and Backend teams to deliver scalable, explainable, and reliable AI integrations.
- Collaborate with strategic consulting partners to align technical efforts with client business goals and expansion opportunities.
- Capture learnings and build reusable patterns, documentation, and internal playbooks to accelerate future deployments.
- Communicate effectively with senior executives, advocating for optimal AI workflow strategies while gathering feedback for continuous improvement.
- Partner with sales and customer success to ensure smooth onboarding, adoption, and expansion of workflows.
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
- 5+ years in a hybrid technical + client-facing role (e.g., Solution Architect, Forward Deployed Engineer, AI/ML Systems Engineer, Technical Consultant).
- Experience deploying AI/ML workflows or intelligent applications (LLMs, RAG, forecasting, symbolic reasoning, etc.).
- Strong coding background in Python, plus familiarity with GCP, Docker, FastAPI, LangChain/LangGraph, Elasticsearch, Snowflake, BigQuery.
- Experience with data pipelines and distributed systems in production environments.
- Proven ability to translate complex business challenges into structured technical solutions.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience building repeatable, scalable processes.
- Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, including leading executive-level discussions and technical design sessions.
PERKS
- Competitive compensation and equity in a rapidly growing company
- Hybrid Work Schedule
- Pet-friendly office
This role is fully remote until we open our London office in Summer 2026, at which point it will transition to a hybrid schedule. Candidates must be based in the UK and within commuting distance of London.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/jigsaw/5b8c9fe4-2c15-44.description_excerpt:
About us
At Jigsaw, we’re on a mission to transform the way professional services and financial institutions work. We do this by helping our clients organise, visualise and use their data (think Figma or Canva but for the ‘City’). Our clients include the world’s biggest consultancies, leading financial institutions and top law firms.
Jigsaw was founded by two seasoned entrepreneurs, Stephen and Travis. This is their second venture together; their first was acquired by a US private equity firm and went on to become a billion-dollar company and a household name in professional service firms across the world. Jigsaw is now on a growth trajectory few Series A companies achieve - putting us in the top quartile SaaS companies globally. Today we proudly serve thousands of users from nearly two  hundred businesses worldwide, who love our products and use them everyday.
But we’re only getting started! We have ambitious goals and we’re looking for talented people to help us achieve them.
Why join us?
We're not about the corporate grind; instead, we thrive on creativity, enthusiasm, and a touch of humour to make magic happen.
We hire people with high ownership and a bias for action. Then we trust and empower them to do their best work.
ABOUT THE ROLE
As Jigsaw’s Head of Sales, you’ll level up a sales team that have been instrumental in establishing us as a market leader, whilst also preparing for a new challenge - building the go-to-market for a software category that doesn’t exist yet.
Across the corporate advisory network, lawyers, tax advisors and financial backers are all working off different versions of the same data, with no shared workspace, auditable source of truth, or easy to enact visual planning tools. This creates costly mistakes, messy handoffs and manual entry that general AI doesn't have the precision to automate. You’ll have ownership of how we launch and scale this, with no playbook to inherit.
Our existing customer base and revenue stream gives us the financial security to do this, where you’ll operate at a startup's pace with freedom to experiment. You'll shape the product roadmap with our Head of Engineering and partner directly with our CEO on strategy, whilst remaining hands-on with the sales team. With a global customer base, from the UK and Europe, through to the US, and APAC, there's genuine scope to travel and build relationships in person.
To be successful, we’d value someone bringing prior experience selling into both complex enterprise customers, whilst concurrently being comfortable building the motion for the SMB and mid-market, with industry experience across ERP, contract management, compliance, cyber security, or payments. Equally important is the mindset: this is a 0-to-1 journey, and we're looking for a genuine builder, someone energised by the process of creating something from nothing, not just by hitting a number, with the resilience to handle a go-to-market that will keep evolving as the product does.
YOU'LL GET TO...
- Own and evolve Jigsaw's sales strategy, building on our existing outbound engine whilst designing the go-to-market for sales across multiple segments, from SMB to Enterprise
- Build with a startup's freedom and a scale-up's financial backing
- Nurture, mentor, and grow our existing sales team, adding enterprise capability without resetting what already works
- Shape the product roadmap with our Head of Engineering
- Partner directly with our CEO on Sales Strategy, ensuring we’re segmenting our markets correctly and impacting our customers in the right way
- Build long-term relationships with General Counsel, Heads of Legal Operations, and senior fincorp stakeholders across a global customer base with an opportunity to travel
- Create a flywheel between early wins and reference customers on both sides of the market, advisor and fincorp, to open up adjacent opportunities
YOU'LL NEED...
- A strong track record in B2B enterprise SaaS sales, selling specifically into legal tech, legal operations, financial services or the broader professional services technology market
- Experience scaling company revenue from $15M +
- A track record building long sales cycles and long-term account relationships, not just closing transactional deals. You bring a little black book of contacts that you’d be happy contacting on day one
- Sales leadership or player-coach experience - you've hired, ramped, and coached teams of around 5+ people before. Equally strong: someone currently leading an SMB or scale-focused team who proved themselves on enterprise accounts earlier in their career
- Prior experience building a go-to-market strategy, you’re commercially focused and comfortable owning the numbers
- An analytical, data-led approach to sales efficiency - testing and experimenting rather than sticking to habit
- HubSpot experience, and you’re comfortable utilising it for workflows and reports, not just filling in fields.
- Genuine fluency with AI, and enthusiasm for pushing that further in how you sell and lead
- Gravitas and charisma, you’re credible in front of General Counsel and C-suite buyers, and clear, energising, and inspiring with your own team
- High ownership balanced with genuine collaboration
NICE-TO-HAVES
- Familiarity with Entity Management Systems, contract lifecycle management, or adjacent legal/compliance software categories
- Experience leading Marketing, specifically for taking a product to market
- Experience selling in a marketplace or platform business model with a flywheel sales motion

Today we proudly serve thousands of users from nearly two  hundred businesses worldwide, who love our products and use them everyday.
But we’re only getting started! We have ambitious goals and we’re looking for talented people to help us achieve them.
Why join us?
We're not about the corporate grind; instead, we thrive on creativity, enthusiasm, and a touch of humour to make magic happen.
We hire people with high ownership and a bias for action. Then we trust and empower them to do their best work.
ABOUT THE ROLE
You'll be Jigsaw's embedded data privacy advisor: the person product development and customer-facing teams turn to when a data or privacy question needs a real answer. This is a fractional role (starting at roughly 1-2 days a week in-office), working closely alongside our existing Legal team.
The focus for this role will be translating legal and technical complexity into commercially-focused, actionable responses to help free up teams to move quickly. In practice, this could be advising the product team on what compliance actions we need to take ahead of a new product release, making case-by-case decisions for customers with unique compliance requirements, or conducting analysis on customer DPAs ahead of a change to data processing locations, right through to how to answer a client's questions about our AI features.
This isn't a standardise-everything-and-leave role. We work with customers around the world in regulated industries (legal, financial institutions, accountancy and enterprises) with varying compliance needs, where one-size-fits-all templates aren't always an option and we need to adopt a flexible approach. The work here is genuinely ongoing, nuanced, and advisory rather than a project with an end date.
YOU'LL GET TO...
- Act as the go-to person for data and privacy questions across the business - in product meetings, customer rollout calls, and migration conversations
- Turn specific customer contract terms into practical, commercial recommendations, weighing real risk instead of defaulting to "no"
- Advise on cross-border and international data transfer questions, which come up constantly given our global customer base
- Join customer calls to speak credibly with clients' own data privacy counsel, many of whom are lawyers or privacy specialists themselves
- Translate complex legal and technical concepts clearly for non-legal, technical teams internally
- Help build a genuine "privacy by design" culture at Jigsaw - getting privacy thinking embedded at the start of projects, not bolted on at the end
- Spot opportunities to improve our templates, playbooks, and processes proactively, alongside the day-to-day reactive work
YOU'LL NEED...
- A working understanding of UK & US privacy laws, including UK & EU GDPR, the UK Data Protection Act and CCPA, ideally with experience applying them in a live commercial context, not just in theory
- Genuine on-the-ground experience inside a tech company building product - this isn't a fit for a purely private-practice legal background
- To be genuinely comfortable with cross-border and international data transfer questions
- To be a commercial, pragmatic, solution-minded operator - someone who can weigh the significance and likelihood of a risk and propose a workable path forward, not someone who leads with compliance-first blockers
- Excellent communication skills on two levels: credible and precise with legally sophisticated clients, and clear and accessible for non-legal internal teams
- High ownership balanced with genuine collaboration, and able to build consensus
- Comfort with a fractional working pattern - broadly protected days, with the pragmatic flexibility to handle something urgent (like a data incident) outside them
NICE-TO-HAVES
- Familiarity with other privacy frameworks, including AI governance or AI-related compliance questions
- CIPP/E or CIPM certification
- Experience working with clients in heavily regulated industries (law firms, accountancies, financial services)
- Prior experience at a similar-stage scale-up with a broad base of regulated, legally sophisticated customers
WHO SHOULD APPLY?
If you find the letter-of-the-law side of privacy the least interesting part of the job, and you're energised instead by being commercial, pragmatic, and embedded in a fast-moving business — this is for you. You'll get real autonomy and visibility across the company, working directly with product, engineering, and customer teams, rather than being buried in reactive, box-ticking compliance work.

ABOUT INFITERRA
Join our mission to grow and transform the subscription economy by simplifying subscription service delivery.
Infiterra enables IT distributors, Managed Service Providers (MSPs), and telcos to succeed in the subscription economy. Our subscription commerce platform automates and unifies subscription workflows - from quote to bill- driving operational efficiency, billing accuracy, and scalable growth.
Recognized as a global leader in subscription commerce, Infiterra combines innovation, performance excellence, and trusted expertise to help partners transform and grow.
ABOUT THE ROLE
As a Senior AI Engineer, you will be part of R&D and will design, build, evaluate and operate production AI systems that solve meaningful product and engineering problems.
This is an Applied AI Engineering role combining deep AI specialization, strong software engineering and business/domain understanding. You will work across LLM-based systems, retrieval, agents, tool use, predictive techniques and model adaptation/fine-tuning where appropriate - choosing the approach based on the problem and evidence rather than defaulting to one AI technique.
You will take complex AI capabilities end-to-end: from understanding an ambiguous business problem, through experimentation and solution design, to implementation, evaluation, deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement.
This is a fully remote senior individual-contributor role based in either Greece or the UK, with periodic in-person collaboration.
Our AI engineering environment includes Python, cloud-native services, containers/Kubernetes, CI/CD, model APIs, retrieval and agent/tool frameworks, and evaluation/observability tooling. We choose technologies based on the problem rather than standardizing on one AI framework.
WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON
- AI-native product engineering and knowledge systems that reconcile business knowledge from product, engineering and production evidence.
- Automated and reusable vendor-integration capabilities, including the evolution of our Integration Hub from implementation automation toward learning from real integration outcomes.
- AI-assisted software delivery: analysis, requirements, implementation, testing, knowledge reuse, code review and delivery acceleration.
- AI-enabled quality and production intelligence, such as anomaly detection, failure-pattern analysis, data-quality/error detection and intelligent monitoring.
- Predictive, analytical or model-adaptation capabilities where evidence shows they are the right solution.

In your first 90 days, you will have developed a strong understanding of our platform and domain, contributed materially to a production AI capability, established meaningful evaluation evidence around your work, and identified opportunities where AI can create measurable product or engineering leverage.

Success is not measured by the number of AI features introduced. It is measured by business correctness, AI behavioural quality, engineering quality, production reliability and demonstrated value.

You are comfortable being given a business problem rather than a detailed technical specification. - Identify and validate AI-enabled improvements to SDLC, Product and operational workflows.

- Work with Architecture, Platform, Security, Data, Quality, Product and domain specialists while retaining technical accountability for the AI capability within your scope.
- Mentor less-experienced engineers and contribute reusable patterns, knowledge and practices.

About Exa
We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion.
Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s, and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders, and dropouts alike. We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.
About the role
Forward Deployed Engineers are the technical tip of the spear at Exa. Partnered with an Account Executive, you own the technical win: you run discovery with customer engineering teams, design solutions on Exa's API, build and deliver demos and POCs that prove value, and turn technical evaluations into closed deals. You'll be one of the first GTM engineers in your region — you'll help define how Exa sells there, not just execute a playbook.
In this role, you will:
- Own the technical side of the sales cycle: discovery, solution design, demos, POCs/POVs, and technical objection handling, in partnership with your AE
- Run the technical side of expansion: spot new use cases in existing accounts and turn them into evaluations, with your AE
- Build working demos and prototypes on Exa's API tailored to each customer's use case — agents, research, search, enrichment
- Tell the story: translate Exa's capabilities into use-case narratives that land with CTOs, engineers, and PMs alike
- Be the trusted technical advisor: know Exa inside out — the product, the API, the problems it solves — answer hard questions honestly, run evaluations rigorously, and know when to pull in engineering
- Feed the field back into product: identify patterns across customer evaluations and channel them to product and engineering
- Scale yourself and the region: build reusable demos, integration patterns, and playbooks, and represent Exa at technical workshops, meetups, and conferences
- As a founding regional hire, support early customers through onboarding and initial implementation while we build out dedicated post-sales
Requirements
- 5+ years in a customer-facing technical role (flexible for exceptional candidates) — solutions/sales engineering, solutions architecture, or an engineering role with heavy customer exposure (e.g., engineering lead, developer relations, technical consulting)
- Technical depth with APIs and modern development (e.g. Python or TypeScript): you can design an integration, build a working demo, and debug it live — using AI-assisted tooling is expected, hand-crafted code is not the bar
- Strong communication and presentation skills: you can command a room, adapt to your audience, and say "I don't know — I'll find out" when you don't
- Comfort with ambiguity and early-stage intensity: you can run several evaluations in parallel, prioritize what moves deals, and your job description will change as the region grows
- Familiarity with the modern AI stack — LLMs, RAG, agents — and how customers evaluate it; you can scope a POC with clear success criteria
- Based in region with willingness to travel for customer engagements
You might excel if you…
- Have owned technical evaluations at a developer-platform / API-first company — POCs/POVs you scoped and ran that ended in a customer going live
- Have led engineers and want to move toward the customer, or are an SE who wants to be more hands-on than your last role allowed
- Are genuinely curious about AI and have built things with LLMs — side projects count
- Are energized by being the first: first hire, first deal, first playbook in a region
- Have run enterprise evaluations end-to-end — POC success criteria, security questionnaires, RFP responses
- Speak additional regional languages (a plus across APJ markets)
This is an in-person opportunity in London. In addition to premium healthcare benefits (medical, dental, vision), we also offer fertility benefits and a monthly wellness stipend to all of our employees.
Exa is an equal opportunity employer. We are looking for a Head of Marketing, EMEA based in London to lead Exa's marketing across Europe.
ABOUT THE ROLE
This is Exa's first senior marketing leader outside the United States. You will set the marketing strategy for Europe and run it as a commercial function, tied to the region's pipeline number. EMEA is many markets with different buyers, languages, and routes to market. Deciding which ones matter first, and how Exa wins in each, is the core of the job.
Sales coverage is coming online across the UK and EU. You will be the marketing counterpart: deciding where to invest, which motions to run in which markets, and how a fast-moving American AI infrastructure company earns credibility with buyers in London, Berlin, Zurich, and Amsterdam.
This is a player-coach role. You will write the regional plan and then help execute it yourself, from shaping a campaign and adapting the message to hosting an executive dinner and sitting in pipeline reviews with Sales. You start as a team of one, with meaningful budget for field events, conferences, and developer events. We expect your first hire, an early-career field events marketer, to join within months, with more headcount as growth justifies.
Exa's buyers are technical, and much of our growth starts with developers who sign up and build before anyone talks to Sales. The right person understands both product-led growth with developers and account-based programs for enterprise buyers. You will work closely with Sales, Product, and Marketing to keep all of it pointed at the same priorities.
This is an AI-first role at an AI-first company. Account research, localization, campaign analysis, and reporting should be workflows you build, since one person covering a dozen markets only works if the work is automated.
This role is based in-person in London, with regular travel across EMEA and periodic trips to our San Francisco HQ.
WHAT YOU'LL OWN
EMEA MARKETING STRATEGY
Own the regional marketing plan. Translate Exa's global priorities into a plan for EMEA, prioritize markets by opportunity and sales coverage, and decide where to invest across markets and programs. Own the EMEA marketing budget, which centers on field events, conferences, developer events, and selective local sponsorships (including developer creators and communities). Success is measured by revenue growth.
GO-TO-MARKET BY MARKET
Build a go-to-market approach for priority markets across the UK, EU, Middle East and Africa. The right motion differs by market (direct, partner-led, or channel-based), and some markets should wait until product-led signal justifies the spend.
PIPELINE AND DEMAND
Own EMEA pipeline targets. Build the programs that create qualified opportunities and move them through the cycle: account-based campaigns, executive dinners, a small number of high-value trade shows, reactivation of any stalled pipeline, and webinars or localized content. Use pipeline and conversion data to shift investment toward what works. Success is measured by pipeline and by cost per opportunity.
SALES PARTNERSHIP
Be the marketing partner to EMEA Sales, SDRs, and regional partners. Align on ICP, target accounts, campaign priorities, lead routing, and follow-up, and run a regular operating rhythm. Success is measured by lead-to-opportunity conversion and by seller satisfaction with campaigns and enablement.
PLG IN REGION
Ensure EMEA developers and AI-native companies find Exa, sign up, and build. Run developer events, hackathons, and meetups in the region with DevRel support, sponsor local developer creators and communities where they reach the right builders, and work with Digital and Growth Marketing on inbound quality and conversion. Use sign-up and usage signal to tell Sales where to engage. Success is measured by sign-ups and PQL-sourced pipeline.
EXA STORY IN EMEA
Adapt Exa's global positioning for EMEA buyers, identifying where the story needs local proof, language, or emphasis. Bring customer and market insight into messaging, launches, and the roadmap through Product Marketing. Keep brand and demand working as one program. Success is measured by regional launch success.
AGENCIES, PARTNERS, AND VENDORS
Select and manage agencies, event vendors, and marketing partners across the region, including co-marketing with channel and cloud partners. Make sure each one understands the priorities, and delivers quality work.
TEAM BUILDING

jobs.ashbyhq.com/granola/bcbf9372-124e-4.description_excerpt:
ABOUT GRANOLA
Granola is the AI notepad for people who spend their days in meetings. We build software that transforms raw conversation into clear, structured, and actionable notes combining transcription with flexible LLM workflows directly on your desktop.
We’re a small, tight-knit team moving fast in London. We care deeply about craft, speed, and autonomy. At Granola, there are no rigid silos between backend and product engineering everyone has a full-stack mindset, high ownership, and direct impact on the product.
THE ROLE
We are looking for an Engineering Manager focused on People & Delivery to help us scale our engineering team while keeping our shipping cadence extremely fast.
This is not a traditional corporate management role, nor is it a hands-on technical lead position. You are the operational engine and talent multiplier for the engineering team. Your primary focus will be supporting engineers, nurturing their career growth, creating high-trust team dynamics, and ensuring we ship exceptional product momentum week-in, week-out.
WHAT YOU’LL DO
- People & Coaching: Conduct regular 1:1s, provide direct actionable feedback, and help engineers navigate career growth, performance, and skill development in a fast-paced startup setting.
- Delivery & Execution: Own squad momentum and delivery rhythm. Work closely with product and design to break down projects, manage trade-offs, remove friction, and keep shipping cycles fast and predictable.
- Process & Pragmatism: Implement "just enough" process to keep teams aligned and unblocked, explicitly avoiding bureaucracy or rigid framework overhead.
- Team Health & Culture: Build an environment of high accountability, trust, and autonomy. Keep morale high and foster a culture of craftsmanship and ownership.
- Hiring & Scaling: Partner closely with Talent and Leadership to recruit, interview, and onboard high-bar engineering talent as we scale the team.
WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
- Track Record in Management: 2+ years of experience managing engineering teams in fast-moving, high-bar product startups or tech companies.
- Delivery Mastery: Strong instinct for execution. You know how to scope down features, spot bottlenecks before they happen, and keep delivery humming without sacrificing quality.
- People-First Mindset: Genuinely passionate about developing people, active listening, and creating conditions where engineers feel empowered to do their best work.
- Technical Context: A background as a software engineer (or strong technical foundation) so you can deeply understand architectural trade-offs, empathize with technical friction, and hold high-signal conversations with the team.
- Low-Ego & Scrappy: Comfortable navigating ambiguity, rolling up your sleeves on operational tasks, and adapting quickly as product priorities evolve.
About the opportunity
We are living in the most exciting time for tool builders since Engelbart's demo https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Mother_of_All_Demos in 1968. We want to assemble the best crew to build this future together, here in London. Our compensation philosophy is to pay slightly above market on salary and above market on equity.
We do our best work in person, and so our team spends time together five days per week in our new, bright, and spacious office at Old Street. We are happy to offer relocation assistance to candidates who'll be moving to London to join us.
Lastly, we think amazing talent comes from all kinds of life journeys and experiences. If what is written above speaks to you, whether you look like a fit on paper or not, please reach out.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/granola/7312639c-f971-4.description_excerpt:
ABOUT US
We're Team Granola 👋
Granola is an AI-powered notepad for people in back-to-back meetings. What started as a better way to take notes has become a shared workspace that helps teams capture, organize, and act on what matters.
We're building a product people genuinely love and are fortunate to work with many of the world's most ambitious companies. As we continue to grow, we're looking for a GTM Systems Lead to build the systems and data foundation that Sales, CS and leadership run on.
ABOUT THE ROLE
We’re hiring a GTM Systems Lead to own the technology behind Granola’s commercial team as we scale.
You’ll design, build and run the systems our Sales and CS teams rely on. Our current stack has served us well, but it needs to evolve as the team grows. You’ll take responsibility for how the tools fit together, what we build versus buy, and how information flows between them.
This is a hands-on role. You’ll set the direction of the stack and implement the technical changes that make it work. You’ll work closely with Sales, CS and Data, and report to the Head of RevOps. You won’t be limited to administering a CRM or building isolated automations: you’ll own how the whole system works.
WHAT YOU’LL DO
- Design and evolve the GTM stack. Decide how our Sales and CS systems should fit together, what to build versus buy, and what to prioritise as we grow.
- Own the technical architecture of our CRM, Attio. Shape its data model, objects, workflows and integrations. You’ll be hands-on with configuration, particularly early on, but routine admin won’t be the sole focus of the role.
- Build and maintain integrations. Make data flow reliably across Attio and our wider toolset, including Apollo, Cal.com http://Cal.com, Tally and Polytomic, and into the data systems used by the wider business.
- Own the wider toolset. Assess new tools and vendors, improve or replace what isn’t working, and make sure the stack is useful, reliable and cost-conscious.
- Find opportunities for automation and AI. Identify work that could be made easier for Sales and CS, and build or collaborate on solutions where they fit the priorities of the stack.
- Keep systems dependable. Troubleshoot problems, establish sensible governance and documentation, and partner with IT on access and security.
- Understand how teams work. Get close to Sales and CS workflows so the systems you build solve real problems, not just technical ones.
WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
- Experience designing, building and owning systems used by a growing commercial team. Relevant hands-on experience matters more to us than a particular number of years or experience with a specific CRM.
- Sound judgement about system architecture, priorities and build-versus-buy decisions—and the ability to explain those decisions to non-technical colleagues.
- Technical depth beyond administering tools: you’ve built integrations and are comfortable working with APIs, webhooks and code. Experience with SQL, Python or JavaScript would be useful.
- An understanding of CRM data models, routing, enrichment and the operational work needed to keep data flowing reliably.
- A willingness to get into the weeds. You’re comfortable doing the implementation yourself while also thinking about how the stack should develop over time.
- Curiosity about AI-powered GTM workflows, with experience building them a plus rather than a prerequisite.
- A collaborative, low-ego approach. You can work through messy requests with Sales, CS and Data, challenge assumptions constructively, and ship solutions people can use.
- You don’t need to have used Attio or every tool in our stack. We’re more interested in what you’ve built, how you think about systems, and how you’d apply that experience here.
ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY
We are living in the most exciting time for tool builders since Engelbart's demo in 1968 and we want to assemble the best crew to build this future together. Our compensation philosophy is to hire the best people in the market and pay them accordingly with salary, variable, and equity.
Lastly, we think amazing talent comes from all kinds of life journeys and experiences. If what is written above speaks to you, whether you look like a fit on paper or not, please reach out.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/inshur/417d121f-ce8f-49.description_excerpt:
TAKE OWNERSHIP OF A DIVERSE THIRD-PARTY MOTOR CLAIMS PORTFOLIO AND DELIVER FAST, FAIR, AND DATA-DRIVEN OUTCOMES IN A MODERN, TECH-ENABLED INSURER.
$100M+ funded. Global footprint. AI-powered. Human-driven. 🚀
INSHUR is the embedded insurance powerhouse for the on-demand world. We partner with giants like Uber and Amazon to provide fair, data-backed coverage for the modern workforce. We’re 200 people strong across the UK, US, and Netherlands, using AI as a multiplier to stay ahead of the curve. Want to work where tech actually meets the road? You’re in the right place.
Find out more about our history, values, hiring process and more here https://inshur.slab.com/public/topics/inshur-playbook-dr5k6re7.
THE ROLE
As a Claims Handler at INSHUR, you’ll take ownership of a diverse portfolio of third-party motor claims, including personal injury, playing a key role in delivering fast, fair, and data-driven outcomes. You will work in a modern, tech-enabled environment where you’re trusted to make decisions, challenge the status quo, and help shape how claims are handled from first notification through to settlement.
This role reports to the Claims Team Leader and sits within a friendly, collaborative team of claims professionals.
We're based in Brighton, with a remote working model. You'll come into the office for training, events and to see your work colleagues.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
- Manage end-to-end claims: Take full visibility and control of third-party motor claims from first notification through to settlement, covering both damage and personal injury elements.
- Drive confident claim resolutions: Make sound liability decisions and navigate claims to resolution using a strong commercial mindset.
- Negotiate optimal outcomes: Effectively negotiate with third parties, insurers, and legal representatives to achieve the right result at the right cost.
- Leverage a digital-first approach: Build strong relationships across the insurance market while influencing claim outcomes digitally.
- Collaborate across teams: Work closely with product, data, and operations teams to identify emerging trends and elevate overall claims performance.
- Optimise processes through tech: Use technology and data insights to streamline workflows, reduce friction, and enhance the overall customer experience.
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
We care more about how you think than what's on your CV. If you meet most of the essentials and are excited about the problem, apply.
ESSENTIAL
- Motor Claims Handling Experience: Proven track record handling motor claims, including exposure to personal injury, and demonstrating strong technical claims judgement.
- Decision-Making & Negotiation: Confident decision-maker and effective negotiator comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment.
- Data & Tech Orientation: Enjoys working with data and technology to innovate and challenge legacy processes.
- Solutions-Focused Ownership: Demonstrates accountability, moves quickly, and brings a problem-solving mindset to complex challenges.
- Customer & Commercial Focus: Passionate about delivering exceptional customer outcomes without losing sight of overall commercial performance.
NICE TO HAVE
- Adaptability in Evolving Environments: Thrives when collaborating with cross-functional teams in a fast-changing, scaling company setting.
- Curiosity & Continuous Improvement: Intellectually curious and eager to learn, explore new ideas, and constantly improve processes.
WHAT TO EXPECT FROM THE PROCESS
- Screen & Intro: A 30-minute video call with the Talent Team to discuss the role, your background, and your experience.
- First Interview: A 60-minute video call to dive deeper into your technical experience and get to know your motivations.
- Final Stage: An in-person interview at our Brighton office to meet the team.
We design this to be a two-way conversation. Come with questions — we want you to leave knowing whether this is the right move for you.
WHAT WE OFFER
We've also built a benefits package that invests in our people’s long-term personal and professional growth and wellbeing. Here’s a sample of what this includes:
- Competitive salary, benchmarked to market by location, plus stock options for every employee
- 30 days of holiday annually, plus bank holidays
- Private healthcare for you and your family, including pre-existing conditions
- Life insurance at 3x your salary
- 13 weeks parental leave at full pay for new parents
- Workplace nursery scheme with Gogeta, allowing you to pay fees pre-tax
- Ride to work scheme
- Workplace pension scheme to help you save for retirement
- Flexible working hours to suit your lifestyle
- £500 annual personal training allowance plus regular learning opportunities on a variety of topics
- £40 monthly wellbeing and WFH allowance to keep you healthy and productive
- 24/7 Employee Assistance Program, covering you and immediate family members—offering crisis support, counselling, legal advice, menopause CBT, and more
- Unlimited AI usage with Claude and Gemini
WORKING HERE
You'll do well here if you:
- 🚀 Move through ambiguity without waiting for a perfect brief
- 👊 Take ownership of outcomes, not just tasks
- ⚡ Adapt quickly when priorities shift, and help others do the same
- 🔧 Look for ways to improve how things work, not just how to complete them
- 🧠 Use tools, data, and colleagues to make better decisions
This probably isn't the right fit if you:
- 📋 Prefer clearly defined processes and a stable, slow-moving environment
- 🚧 Are most comfortable staying within the boundaries of your job description
- 🔄 Find frequent context-switching draining rather than energising
INCLUSION AND FLEXIBILITY
INSHUR is committed to building a team where everyone can bring their full self to work. We follow a structured hiring process and train our interview teams to support fairness and reduce bias.
We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or age.
This role is advertised as full-time. We're open to discussing part-time, job-sharing, or other flexible arrangements for the right person.
If you need any adjustments during the process, let us know and we'll do our best to accommodate.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/ledger/26c4797f-d0b7-4a.description_excerpt:
About Ledger
We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.
At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.
The team:
Ledger has secured digital assets for millions of people. Ledger Enterprise brings the same security to institutions. Banks, exchanges, custodians and stablecoin issuers use our platform to hold, move and govern digital assets on infrastructure they control: Vault for self-custody, HSM On-Premises for institutions that need keys inside their own perimeter, TradeLink for off-exchange settlement, and Multisig for on-chain governance.
You’ll work closely with Business Development, Solutions Engineering, Product, Legal and Support, covering clients across Europe, the Middle East and Africa. Join a young, international, driven team in one of Ledger’s fastest-growing areas.
What you’ll be doing:
You will own a portfolio of institutional clients from signature onward. That covers onboarding, integration, adoption, renewal and expansion. You will be their trusted advisor inside Ledger and their voice in our product roadmap.
- Own client relationships end to end. Be the primary contact for a portfolio of exchanges, banks, custodians and fintechs, and build relationships from operations teams up to C-level.
- Drive integration and adoption. Explain product features clearly, run workshops, and guide clients through technical integration together with our Solutions Engineers.
- Grow accounts. Identify and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities such as new products, additional users, assets or entities. Own your expansion and retention targets.
- Negotiate renewals and contracts. Lead commercial discussions on renewals, amendments and pricing, working with Legal on terms.
- Shape the product. Turn client feedback into clear, prioritised input for Product and influence what we build next.
- Run the account rhythm. Lead QBRs, maintain account plans, keep the CRM accurate, and flag risks early.
- Represent Ledger. Meet clients on-site and at industry events across EMEA, with occasional travel.
What we’re looking for:
- 4+ years in a similar account management or customer success role, ideally in B2B SaaS or enterprise infrastructure software.
- Proven experience managing financial institution clients such as banks, asset managers, custodians or payment providers.
- A track record of upselling and expanding accounts against targets.
- Experience negotiating contracts and renewals with enterprise clients.
- Comfort with technical conversations: you can explain APIs, integration flows and security concepts without needing an engineer in every meeting.
- Hands-on experience with digital assets, or a clear and demonstrable interest in the space.
- Excellent written and verbal communication in English. You can adapt your message for a CISO, a head of operations or a CFO.
- A structured, self-driven way of working. You manage a portfolio without being chased.
Nice to have:
- Understanding of regulatory frameworks relevant to EMEA clients, such as MiCAR, DORA, the Travel Rule, the Basel crypto-asset standards, FINMA requirements, or Middle East regimes like VARA (Dubai) and ADGM.
- Familiarity with custody and key management concepts like MPC, HSMs and cold/warm/hot wallet setups.
- Additional languages, especially German, French or Arabic.
- Experience at a crypto-native firm, a bank’s digital asset desk or a custody provider.
At Ledger, we are dedicated to continually investing in our employees which is why we offer more than just salaries; we provide comprehensive compensation packages that include a wide range of benefits. Here are some of the benefits you can look forward to:
- Flexible work options - Our hybrid policy allows employees to work from home up to 3 times per week
- Health & Wellness support - Health and Life Insurance.
- Financial growth opportunities - Employees can become shareholders in Ledger as well as other financial benefits depending on your country of work.
- Commuter allowance - Ledger offers a commuter allowance to contribute to your preferred means of transportation.
- Learning & Development - A comprehensive suite of training solutions providing a personalised learning experience for every employee.
For regionally specific benefits, your Talent Acquisition contact will be able to provide you with more information.
We’re committed to building an inclusive hiring process. If you need any adjustments or accommodations, just let us know, we’ll do our best to support you.
