Customer-Facing · Remote, Europe, Africa or Asia
About Caliza
Caliza is commercial banking infrastructure for companies that operate across borders. Most global businesses still piece together several banks, FX providers and spreadsheets to move money. Caliza replaces that with one platform and API: hold USD accounts, collect and pay in 33+ currencies, and convert between fiat and stablecoins, over local rails, SWIFT or stablecoins, in minutes instead of days. On top of that, we’re building the treasury layer: programmable accounts, approval policies, automated reconciliation and working capital, run by a customer’s finance team or their AI agents.
Our customers are importers, exporters, FX brokers, payment companies and fintechs across the Americas, Europe, Africa and Asia. We’re licensed and regulated across our core markets, and our team has built financial infrastructure at Visa, Nubank, EBANX, Flutterwave, Upstart, Intuit and Silicon Valley Bank.
Our backers
Initialized Capital, Better Tomorrow Ventures, Abstract Ventures, New Form Capital, QED Investors, Valor Capital and Quona Capital, along with the founders of Flutterwave, Chipper Cash, Rappi, Pomelo, Dock, Remesa Online and Anchorage.
About the role
Caliza moves money across fiat payment rails in the Americas, Europe and Asia, including Fedwire, ACH, SPEI, SEPA and CNAPS, as well as blockchains. Most payments flow through automatically. When one doesn't, our customers need someone who can work out exactly what happened, explain it clearly, and get it resolved.
That's this role. When a customer asks "where's my payment?", you'll own the answer. You'll follow the payment from their API call, through our internal systems and ledger, out to our partner banks, the payment rail or the blockchain, and back. Then you'll explain what you found to the customer, push the bank for answers when needed, and hand our engineers a precise problem when something is genuinely broken.
You don't need to be an expert in every system a payment touches, but you need to be able to follow one through all of them. You're comfortable reading logs, querying a database and decoding a bank message, and equally comfortable explaining what you found to a customer, a bank or an engineer. You'll build a deep understanding of how our rails really behave over time; we'll teach you the Caliza-specific parts.
Location: Europe, Africa, or Asia. You'll be based there so customers get help during their working hours, but the role covers every rail we operate, not just the ones in your region. Professional English required.
In your first six months, you'll
•
Learn how payments flow through Caliza end to end, across fiat rails and stablecoins.
•
Within three months, understand all of our rails well enough to handle most customer payment issues on your own, whichever rail they're on.
•
Own customer payment investigations during your hours, across every rail, keeping customers informed from first message to resolution.
•
Write runbooks for the issues you see most, so the rest of the team can rely on them.
•
Build at least one tool or automation that measurably reduces manual work.
What you'll be doing
•
Be the technical point of contact for customers with payment problems, especially when the answer isn't obvious.
•
Answer technical API questions from live customers, such as failed webhooks, error codes or unexpected payment statuses. Helping new customers integrate before launch is handled separately by engineering.
•
Trace payments across our API, internal systems, ledger, partner banks, rails and blockchain to find where things stand and what happens next.
•
Tell expected behavior from a real bug, and escalate to engineering with clear evidence when it's a bug.
•
Work with partner banks and providers on investigations, returns and recalls.
•
Support compliance with information requests about specific payments.
•
Tag the root cause of each issue so we can fix the most common ones for good.
•
Review new rails and corridors before launch, bringing an operational view of how they'll fail.
•
Write SQL queries and scripts to automate repetitive work.
What we're looking for
•
3+ years in a technical, customer-facing role at a fintech, payments company, bank or API-first business, such as technical support, payment operations or implementation.
•
A solid understanding of how payments work: statuses, settlement, cutoffs, finality, returns and recalls. Experience with any major rail is fine; we'll teach you ours.
•
Comfort reading JSON API requests, logs and webhooks.
•
Working SQL, and some scripting in Python or similar.
•
Hands-on experience using AI tools in your daily work, for scripting, investigation or documentation, with the judgment to check what they produce.
•
A methodical approach to investigations: you form hypotheses and check them, rather than guessing.
•
Clear, calm communication with customers, especially when the full answer isn't known yet.
•
Comfort with high autonomy and ambiguity in a fast-moving, remote startup.
Nice to have
•
Hands-on experience with any of our rails: Fedwire, ACH, SPEI, SEPA (SCT and SCT Inst) or CNAPS. Experience across more than one region is a strong plus.
•
Familiarity with ISO 20022 payment messages (e.g. pacs.002, pacs.004, camt.053, camt.056).
•
Experience with stablecoins, crypto wallets or block explorers.
•
Experience working with partner or sponsor banks on investigations.
•
Familiarity with double-entry accounting and reconciliation.
How we work
We use AI tools every day and expect you to as well, for scripting, investigation and documentation alike. You own what you produce with them: you check it, understand it, and stand behind it. Because we handle customer and payment data, we follow clear rules about which data can go into which tools.

Nium provides global infrastructure for real-time cross-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.

ABOUT THE BRAND
At Karl Lagerfeld, we are driven by Karl’s mantra: “Embrace the present and invent the future.”
Always contemporary and forward-looking, the House of KARL LAGERFELD shares the creative vision and design aesthetic of its iconic founder, Karl Lagerfeld.
We are the only fashion house that carries Karl’s name on its door and we strive to live up to this responsibility in everything we do, every day, with the utmost joy and passion.

In 2019, KARL LAGERFELD joined as a founding member of the Fashion Pact, a global sustainability initiative seeking to transform the fashion industry through objectives in three areas: climate, biodiversity and ocean protection.
POSITION
We are recruiting for a part-time (12h) Sales associate for our outlet store in Cheshire oaks. This a fantastic opportunity to join a strong and successful business with ambitious yet realistic growth plans. This position is responsible for achieving the sales and profit targets and reporting the results of your work to your Store Manager. You will work continuously on improving the service quality in the store and ensure that a store ambiance is achieved in line with the corporate identity.

Hi, we’re Amity Law, part of the PEXA Group.
Amity Law is here to our customers move home. Whether buying, selling or remortgaging, our conveyancers have the experience and the legal knowledge to assist.
We blend our legal knowledge and expertise with a real-world practical grasp of each individual client's unique circumstances and required timeframes.
We are a fully regulated and licensed law firm, acting for individuals, investors and lenders and we're really proud of our 20-year track record, built on an unwavering focus on customer service.
Why join Amity Law?
Great question! Conveyancing is all we do! 'We specialise in, what you specialise in' - perfect match! We pride ourselves on attracting, developing and retaining a diverse range of people in an equally diverse range of roles and specialisms - who together achieve outstanding results. Our transparent approach and open-door policy make Amity Law a great place to work and as our business expands, we are looking for ambitious, talented people to join us on this journey.
The Opportunity – Consultant Conveyancer (Self-Employed)
We are growing our Consultant Conveyancer network and are looking for experienced residential conveyancers who want greater control over how and when they work.
This is a self-employed opportunity designed for professionals who want to build and manage their own client base, while benefiting from the infrastructure and support of an established, regulated firm.
As a Consultant with Amity Law, you will:
Manage your own caseload and clients
Work remotely with full flexibility over your diary
Build and develop your own network
Earn up to 80% of your billings (subject to fee structure)
Operate under the umbrella of a fully regulated and insured firm
You remain in control of your practice - we provide the framework around you.
What We Provide:
We understand that successful consultants need more than just a fee share model. Our structure is built to allow you to focus on fee earning and client relationships.
You’ll benefit from:
A dedicated onboarding and post-completion administration team
Compliance and regulatory support when required
Professional indemnity insurance covered
Access to case management and onboarding technology
Business development support in the early months
A dedicated Conveyancing Manager as a key point of contact
A collaborative consultant community for knowledge sharing and support
We remove the operational burden so you can concentrate on delivering high-quality conveyancing services.
We are seeking individuals with strong residential conveyancing experience who are comfortable working independently and managing their own clients.
Ideally, you will:
Have a minimum of 4 years’ PQE (Solicitor, CILEX or CLC Licensed Conveyancer), although strong experience will be considered
Have an existing client following, or a clear plan to generate work
Be experienced across the full residential conveyancing process
Be commercially minded and self-motivated
Be set up, or willing to set up, as a self-employed consultant
This opportunity suits conveyancers who want autonomy, accountability and the ability to directly benefit from the work they generate.

Role Title: London - Assistant Manager
About Madhappy
Madhappy is a Los Angeles-based clothing brand made for a community of optimists, born in 2017. Madhappy uses apparel, events, and experimental retail spaces to explore personal expression as a means to an improved state of mind. Its own flagship stores, with locations in West Hollywood, New York, Tokyo, Malibu, and Seoul, are each designed to reflect their site, while still sharing the brand’s DNA. The brand currently produces a selection of ever-evolving, evergreen classic styles, seasonally available collections and collaborations. Madhappy supports research and awareness in mental health through The Madhappy Foundation (a 501c(3) non-profit) and writes Local Optimist, a print magazine. Each to celebrate us as works-in-progress, and the personal and collective expression that is a part of that.
The Opportunity
Madhappy is seeking a full-time Assistant Manager to help lead our first London flagship and its in-store cafe, Pantry by Madhappy. This role reports directly to our London General Manager.
Our Retail Team is at the center of the Madhappy experience. Through meaningful customer interactions, thoughtful product knowledge, and attention to the in-store environment, our associates bring the brand to life every day.
The Role
In this role, you’ll partner with the General Manager to run the London store day to day. You’ll lead the team on the floor, keep operations running smoothly, and create an exceptional customer experience across the store and Pantry. You must be based in or willing to move to London to be considered for this position.
As the Assistant Manager, you will:
Support the General Manager in hitting the store’s sales and KPI targets, and lead the store when they are away.
Help open our first London flagship with the General Manager and HQ teams, from hiring and training through launch.
Lead the store team on the floor each day, setting priorities and keeping service standards high.
Coach and develop associates on sales techniques, customer service, and product knowledge.
Help hire, onboard, and train new team members who are aligned with Madhappy’s values and mission.
Manage staff schedules and hours to match store traffic and budget.
Oversee daily store operations, including opening and closing, cash handling, and loss prevention.
Support the day-to-day running of Pantry by Madhappy alongside the Pantry Cafe Manager, keeping food and beverage, cleanliness, and service standards high.
Drive the store’s clienteling program to build strong relationships and increase repeat customer visits.
Handle customer needs quickly and professionally, leading by example on the floor.
Manage inventory processes, including deliveries, stock counts, replenishment, and transfers.
Keep merchandise displays and store presentation in line with visual and marketing guidelines.
Share what customers ask for and what sells with the General Manager and HQ teams.
The Qualifications
4+ years of retail experience, including 2+ years in a supervisory or assistant management role.
Experience in a high-volume flagship or a premium fashion, streetwear, or lifestyle store.
Experience in a Coffee or Food & Beverage environment is a plus.
Proven track record of hitting sales goals and leading a team on the floor.
Hands-on experience with scheduling, inventory, and store operations.
Strong clienteling and customer service skills.
Right to work in the UK.
Passion for Madhappy’s mission and values, with a strong alignment with mental health advocacy.
Flexible availability, including weekends and holidays.
The Compensation
Competitive salary and bonus
The Benefits
Competitive benefits package

Company Overview:
At Panopto, we are the most customer-centric learning technology company in the world. As the leader in visual and audio-based learning, we empower organizations to share knowledge effortlessly in a capture and post-capture world. We don’t just build software; we obsess over our users’ goals to deliver solutions that truly matter. Our mission is simple: to attract the brightest talent, people like you, to Elevate the Craft and do the most impactful work of your career.
To enhance our team we are seeking a motivated Sales Development professional to join our Sales Development Representative, EMEA team here at Panopto and make a visible difference for our business.
Position Summary
In this role, you will have the opportunity to do meaningful work in your career, elevating your craft while contributing to a team that values lifelong learning.
As a Sales Development Representative, you own everything to do with generating new qualified leads for our sales pipeline: strategy, planning, and execution. You will own specific activity targets for qualifying potential customers from both inbound (they contact us) and outbound (we contact them) initiatives. In addition to activity targets, you will explore and recommend creative outbound sales campaigns to drive qualified pipeline.
You'll also have opportunities to contribute to other initiatives that directly advance our core values and support you in elevating your craft.
How You’ll Contribute
In this role, you will have the opportunity to:
Build Pipeline & Outreach: Source new sales opportunities through inbound lead follow-up, outbound cold calls, emails, and LinkedIn messaging.
Prospecting & Discovery: Perform effective discovery and qualification calls with prospects. Attend in-person trade shows and exhibitions to represent Panopto.
Lead Qualification: Research target accounts, identify key decision-makers (particularly C-Level, VP, and Director personas across HR and IT departments), and generate interest to maintain and expand your database within your assigned territory.
Team Collaboration: Route qualified opportunities to the appropriate Account Executives for further development and closure, assisting and partnering with them to bring new customers on board.
Technology: Master how the Panopto platform is used by our customers to effectively qualify prospects based on their specific needs and requirements.
What Success Looks Like
Within 3 Months: Complete onboarding, gain deep fluency in the Panopto platform and value proposition, master internal sales tools (Salesforce, Outreach, Lusha/ZoomInfo), and comfortably begin executing daily inbound and outbound prospecting activities.
Within 6 Months: Consistently meet or exceed monthly and quarterly activity and qualified lead targets, effectively run discovery calls with key HR/IT stakeholders, and forge strong cross-functional partnerships with regional Account Executives.
Within 1 Year: Serve as a reliable engine for regional pipeline growth, contribute novel outbound messaging campaigns, over-achieve quota targets, and begin developing core sales leadership skills for career progression within Panopto.
Your Legacy: Establish scalable demand generation frameworks in your territory that expand Panopto's reach and set the benchmark for sales development excellence.
Values in Action
Customer First, Always: You proactively surface friction points in the customer experience before they are escalated — and propose solutions, not just reports.
Thrive Together: You share work-in-progress for early feedback, knowing that challenge improves the outcome. You separate critiques of ideas from critiques of people.
Elevate the Craft: You hold the bar high on your own work and invest in developing those around you. You treat every project as an opportunity to learn something new.
Act with Ownership: You define success by outcomes, not activity. You flag problems early and bring a proposed path forward, not just the problem.
Clarity Over Complexity: You default to the simpler solution. Your written communication — internal or external — is direct, specific, and free of filler.
How We Thrive
You’ll join a globally diverse team that thrives on clarity, ownership, and continuous improvement.
We operate with a bias toward action—balancing strategic thinking with execution—and hold ourselves accountable to outcomes that drive the business forward. The Sales Development team works in close partnership with Account Executives, Sales Engineers, and Marketing leaders in a tight-knit culture to ensure an exceptional journey for leads from initial outreach to becoming long-term customers. Collaboration is at the core of how we work, and we value diverse perspectives that strengthen our collective thinking.

Company Overview:
At Panopto, we are the most customer-centric learning technology company in the world. As the leader in visual and audio-based learning, we empower organizations to share knowledge effortlessly in a capture and post-capture world. We don’t just build software; we obsess over our users’ goals to deliver solutions that truly matter. Our mission is simple: to attract the brightest talent, people like you, to Elevate the Craft and do the most impactful work of your career.
Panopto is looking for a Senior Project Manager to own the execution behind our product initiatives — from the moment we commit to something through the day customers can use it.
Position Summary
In this role, you will have the opportunity to do the most impactful work of your career, elevating your craft while contributing to a team that values lifelong learning.
As the Senior Project Manager, you'll report to the Program Manager and sit inside the Product team on the R&D side, which means the job runs in both directions. Upstream, you're working with Product Managers, Engineering, and Design to keep committed work moving, dependencies visible, and slippage caught early. Downstream, you're making sure Marketing has positioning, Support knows what's changing, Sales can sell it, and customers hear about it the day it goes live.
Most project management roles are one or the other. This one is deliberately both, because the handoffs between them are where things fall apart.
You'll take initiatives that start as a paragraph and a target quarter, break them into a plan people can act on, and keep a distributed group of teams moving in the same direction until it's out the door. This role is for someone energized rather than frustrated by ambiguity — you'll frequently be the person who turns "we're doing this next quarter" into a sequenced plan with owners and dates, and then holds everyone to it.
You’ll also have opportunities to contribute to other initiatives that directly advance our core values and support you in elevating your craft.
How You’ll Contribute
In this role, you will have the opportunity to
Own the end-to-end plan for assigned initiatives — scope, sequence, dependencies, milestones, and readiness criteria from commitment through release.
Break large, ambiguous initiatives into discrete workstreams with clear owners, and keep the group aligned as things shift.
Work alongside Product Managers and Engineering Leads to track delivery against commitments, surface slippage early, and keep cross-team dependencies visible and resolved.
Facilitate the sessions that move work forward — dependency reviews, cross-team planning, release readiness — and make sure they end in decisions.
Translate engineering blockers and technical trade-offs into clear, honest updates for Product leadership and commercial stakeholders.
Drive go-to-market readiness with Product Marketing, Sales Enablement, Support, and Customer Success so enablement lands with the release, not after it.
Coordinate internal and customer-facing release communications, including release notes.
Build the templates, checklists, and repeatable processes that make the next release easier than the last one — using AI tooling to cut the manual overhead.
What Success Looks Like
Within 3 months: You've built working relationships across Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Support, and you own end-to-end coordination for two or more active initiatives — running the delivery cadence with the dev teams and producing status reporting people actually read.
Within 6 months: You're anticipating blockers rather than reporting them, and releases you coordinate go out with GTM readiness in place on day one.
Within 1 year: You run our most complex, multi-team initiatives with minimal oversight, and the delivery and launch process you've built is what the rest of the team uses by default.
Your legacy: Panopto ships predictably, and every team knows what's coming and what they need to do about it — because you built the system that makes that true.
Values in Action
Customer First, Always: You proactively surface friction points in the customer experience before they are escalated — and propose solutions, not just reports.
Thrive Together: You share work-in-progress for early feedback, knowing that challenge improves the outcome. You separate critiques of ideas from critiques of people.
Elevate the Craft: You hold the bar high on your own work and invest in developing those around you. You treat every project as an opportunity to learn something new.
Act with Ownership: You define success by outcomes, not activity. You flag problems early and bring a proposed path forward, not just the problem.
Clarity Over Complexity: You default to the simpler solution. Your written communication — internal or external — is direct, specific, and free of filler.
How We Thrive
You'll join a team where we challenge ideas, not people. The Product organization exists to ideate, define, and deliver best-in-class products to our customers — assessing market trends, running competitive and customer research, and ruthlessly prioritizing the opportunities with the highest return. We hold ourselves accountable to outcomes, not activity.
The Foundation for Success
6+ years of project or program management experience, with at least 4+ years specifically embedded within a B2B SaaS Product or R&D organization.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.
Demonstrated experience running delivery with software engineering teams and coordinating the go-to-market side of a product launch. This role does both.
Proven experience driving delivery for complex SaaS architectures (e.g., API integrations, multi-tenant cloud platforms, feature flags, continuous deployment release models).
Working understanding of the SaaS product lifecycle and agile delivery practices, with the judgment to adapt the process to the situation rather than apply it by the book.
Enough technical fluency to hold a credible conversation with engineers about dependencies, trade-offs, and blockers — you don't need to write code, but you can't be a passenger in the discussion.
Proficiency with Jira and Confluence for planning, tracking, and documentation.
Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to push back constructively on scope creep.
Experience working with distributed teams across multiple time zones.
Demonstrated track record of designing, implementing, or improving cross-functional delivery and GTM release frameworks, rather than just executing within existing ones.
What Sets You Apart
Experience coordinating GTM launch activities with Product Marketing, Sales Enablement, or Customer Success.
Experience presenting, reporting delivery health, and managing trade-offs directly with VP and C-level stakeholders.
Experience sitting inside a Product or R&D organization rather than a central PMO.
Active PMP, PMI-ACP, or CSM certification.
Hands-on experience leveraging modern PM stacks…

ABOUT QUANTPILOT
QuantPilot is 3Commas' AI trading copilot: agents that research markets, generate trading strategies, backtest them and iterate on them together with the trader in a chat. We are building it for serious retail traders who want institutional-grade research tools that until now were available mainly to hedge funds and prop desks.
ABOUT THE ROLE
We are hiring a Trader to join the product team full-time. This is a hands-on trading role for someone who already runs systematic, automated strategies. Your day-to-day is building and stress-testing strategies across crypto, futures, stocks, FX, working directly with the engineers and designers building the tools you use. You are not here to advise or observe. You are here because you trade systematically, you automate, and you can push this platform harder than anyone else.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Research and build automated trading strategies using QuantPilot across crypto (perps and spot), futures, stocks, FX, commodities, etc.
- Backtest strategies across multiple timeframes and market conditions using QuantPilot to find edges that hold up.
- Optimize strategy parameters, risk rules, position sizing and entry/exit logic
- Analyze live and historical performance data in QuantPilot to understand why strategies win or lose.
- Stress-test strategies against drawdowns, volatility spikes, low liquidity and black swan scenarios.
- Work with product and engineering daily to identify gaps in the QuantPilot platform, suggest improvements, and validate new features from a trader's perspective.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
You are a systematic trader with at least 2 years experience doing the following:
- You run automated strategies on either crypto (perps and spot), futures, stocks, FX, commodities, etc..
- You have built bots, scripts or systematic setups for use across many markets
- You build and iterate on strategies as a process. You can explain your edge, the market conditions it targets, and why it breaks down outside those conditions.
- You backtest rigorously before deploying. Overfitting, survivorship bias, look-ahead bias, regime change. These are problems you have dealt with, not concepts you have read about.
- Risk management is built into your systems. Position sizing, stop losses, drawdown limits, exposure caps, correlation checks.
- You have opinions about trading infrastructure. You have used multiple platforms, APIs and execution tools. You know what is slow, what breaks, what is missing.
- Bonus: you trade across multiple asset classes. Crypto, stocks, futures, commodities. Cross-market experience makes your input more valuable here.
- Bonus: you have built your own tools. Custom dashboards, alerting systems, execution scripts, data pipelines. Even rough ones count.
THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR
- DeFi yield farmers or liquidity providers.
- Long term holders.
- Discretionary traders with no system behind their trades.
- Manual traders who have never automated anything.

DAY-TO-DAY ARTIST MANAGEMENT

CREATIVE & CONTENT

- Utilise spreadsheets and financial tracking tools to maintain organised and accurate records.

- Manage logistical arrangements and respond effectively to last-minute schedule changes or unexpected challenges.
- Maintain a calm, professional and solutions-focused approach while working in fast-paced, high-pressure environments.

QUALIFICATIONS
- Approximately 4 years of experience in artist management, day-to-day management, the music or entertainment industry, or a closely related field.
- Strong understanding of the modern music industry, including artist development, touring, promotion and digital platforms.
- Excellent organisational, time management and multitasking skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.
- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build and maintain strong professional relationships.
- Strong knowledge of social media platforms, digital content strategies and emerging trends.
- Demonstrated experience developing, managing and tracking budgets, with strong financial awareness and attention to detail.
- Proficiency in spreadsheets and other project management and organisational tools.
- Excellent problem-solving skills, sound judgement and the ability to remain composed under pressure.
- Proven ability to work independently, take initiative and exercise discretion while maintaining clear communication with management.
- Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with artists, management teams and external partners while respecting established relationships.
- Flexible, hands-on and adaptable approach, with a willingness to support responsibilities at all levels.
- Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally and work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends, as required.

ABOUT CLIPBOOK
Clipbook’s mission: reinvent how leaders listen to and engage with the world of information that comes out every day.
Our platform ingests, comprehends, summarizes, and surfaces insights and actions from traditional news, TV, podcast, social media, and internet data at scale—across text, audio, and video in real time.
We launched in 2023 and have grown to 200+ clients including BCG, Weber Shandwick, and dozens of government agencies. We bootstrapped to seven-figures in ARR before raising a $3.3M seed round (co-led by Mark Cuban and a host of prominent angels and VCs).
Our founding team has backgrounds at BCG, Bain, Harvard, Stanford, Oxford, the White House, and Congress, and has previously built startups backed by Sequoia, Tiger Global, Insight Partners, Coatue, and NFX.
THE ROLE
You'd be a key contributor at Clipbook — joining a small but mighty engineering team with engineers from Meta, Stripe, and AWS. You'll have the opportunity to develop new features and capabilities, and what you build will ship to 200+ customers quickly.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
- Architect & build core systems. Drive key decisions across our stack and own feature development end-to-end.
- Integrate AI into real-world workflows. Put LLMs and ML models into production for real workflows: RAG pipelines, embeddings, prompt execution, agentic systems, fine-tuned models.
- Design systems that scale. Build systems that will hold up as we grow 10x, while being practical about what to invest in now vs. what can wait.
- Develop performant APIs and services. Create robust interfaces and internal services that power our product end-to-end, ensuring reliability, security, and a seamless experience for customers.
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
- 3+ years building and scaling production systems. Strong across backend fundamentals (services, data models, distributed systems), with deeper expertise in one or more areas — and a desire to keep expanding your breadth over time.
- Genuine excitement to build quickly & ship fast. We care about getting things into users' hands and iterating from there.
- Experience with cloud infrastructure, containerization, and CI/CD. Familiarity with AWS/GCP, containerization (Docker/K8s), and CI/CD pipelines.
- Excellent communication skills
TECHNICAL AREAS WHERE DEPTH MATTERS (ONE OR MORE)
- Data Engineering: Spark, Kafka, Flink, BigQuery, streaming pipelines, ETL at scale.
- Distributed Systems: High-volume scaling, fault tolerance, eventual consistency.
- AI/ML: LLMs in production, RAG, embeddings, fine-tuning, inference optimization.
- Backend: Python, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, high-concurrency systems.

Diagrid is founded by the creators of the Dapr https://dapr.io/ and KEDA https://keda.sh/ open-source projects, and who led the user experience, design and development of hyper-scale infrastructure cloud services, serverless platforms and open-source projects at Microsoft. Dapr has now achieved graduated status within the CNCF, joining renowned projects like Kubernetes, Prometheus, and Istio.

ABOUT FUNDAMENTAL
Fundamental is an AI research lab pioneering the future of enterprise decision-making. Our flagship model, NEXUS is the world's most powerful Large Tabular Model (LTM) - purpose-built for the structured records that contain trillions of dollars in business value. With $275m in funding from leading investors and trusted by Fortune 100 companies, Fundamental is giving businesses the Power to Predict.
At Fundamental, you'll work on unprecedented technical challenges in foundation model development and build technology that transforms how the world's largest companies make decisions. This is your opportunity to be part of a category-defining company from the ground-up. Join the team defining the future of enterprise AI.
ABOUT THE ROLE
Our People & Talent team is building from scratch to support a category shaping company that has rapidly grown and continues to hire at pace. Reporting directly to the Global Head of Talent, you will manage the full employee journey including pre-onboarding, onboarding, benefits, people development and day-to-day people operations.
At Fundamental we see people and talent operations as a core product, and you'll shape how everyone experiences it. We are energised to work alongside exceptionally talented people, so the care and support we offer should match that standard. This means creating seamless offers, smooth first-week onboardings, clear and meaningful career pathways, and proactive answers before anyone has to ask. You will have the space to rethink existing processes rather than just maintain them, and actively automate repetitive tasks. By removing manual work where possible, you will free up time to focus on the human touches that truly matter.
What makes this role so dynamic is our global context. Everything you design needs to feel personal, thoughtful, and clear, to the candidates and employees you support. While working asynchronously is necessary for us, staying connected and unified is something this role will intentionally foster.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
- Guide new team members through a seamless onboarding journey (from contract signing through their first months), ensuring everyone feels equally welcomed and supported
- Carefully support key career and life milestones, including promotions, parental leave, relocations, and transitions, by coordinating smoothly behind the scenes with local partners
- Maintain our People Ops stack so team members can rely on accurate, clear information about their roles and details, keeping key integrations aligned to remove friction across systems
- Enhance and champion our benefits offerings, making sure every option is easy to understand, access, and appreciate across all regions
- Serve as a trusted point of contact for employee questions, offering warm, prompt support while turning common inquiries into clearer documentation and simpler processes
- Streamline repetitive tasks with thoughtful automation and AI tools, freeing up more time to focus on meaningful, personal human touchpoints
- Foster an inclusive asynchronous workplace through intuitive self-serve guides and clear written communication that respects diverse time zones
- Listen to employee feedback throughout the onboarding and lifecycle journey, using insights to continually refine and elevate the team experience
- Collaborate with the Talent team to create a welcoming, cohesive transition from candidate experience to day-one onboarding
- Nurture our distributed culture through performance development, engagement initiatives, and shared moments that bring people together
- Ensure a safe, fair, and compliant environment across regions, handling sensitive matters with care and sound judgment
ABOUT YOU
- Organised. You keep track of complex projects across multiple time zones without dropping the ball, and you prefer building reliable systems over relying on memory.
- Thoughtful. You naturally put yourself in other people's shoes. Whether it is understanding a new hire's night-before nerves, giving a manager what they need to deliver feedback, or writing guidelines that are clear and accessible, you pay attention to the details that make people feel supported.
- Tech fluent. You are comfortable working with People tech, tools and data. You can look at onboarding feedback or team data, pull out meaningful insights, and back up your suggestions with consistent numbers. You naturally seek out smarter ways to work and actively use AI tools to streamline your day-to-day workflow.
- Clear communicator. Much of what you create will be read by teammates in different time zones, often working in a second language. You write plainly, warmly, and concisely, taking time to edit your work before sharing it.
- Low ego. You step in wherever help is needed to get things done. You appreciate direct communication, adapt quickly when new facts emerge, and thrive in an environment with plenty of room to build.
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
- 4+ years in People Operations, Talent, Recruiting, or Program Management, ideally in a fast-paced tech environment
- Hands-on experience configuring and managing people workflows, data, and reporting
- Experience supporting international team members or candidates, developing processes that optimise for ideal experiences
- A clear track record of simplifying or rebuilding inefficient operational processes
- Comfortable pulling and analysing team data to inform everyday decision-making
- Strong written communication skills across docs, Slack, and written guides
- High discretion and sound judgment when handling confidential information
- Ability to work independently and thrive in a distributed team environment
WHERE YOU COULD STAND OUT
- You have seen a company grow quickly, so you know firsthand how that feels for the colleagues you work with
- You enjoy setting up smart automations using AI, no-code, or scripting tools, and can walk us through something you built
- You bring personal experience from a remote-first team, along with clear ideas on what helps new joiners succeed asynchronously

This technology uses advanced 3D cameras to track surface data, providing enhanced guidance across every step of the radiotherapy workflow.
Our systems are used in over 3,000 clinics worldwide, including in 29 of the top 30 Best Hospitals for Cancer (source: US News and World Report 2026 rankings).
The company is recognized as one of Britain’s fastest-growing private tech companies, as featured in the 2025 Sunday Times 100 Tech list. Vision RT is also a recipient of the 2026 King’s Award for Enterprise, our fifth in 10 years. It is the UK’s most prestigious accolade for business excellence.
Company video (Available on application page)
With around 400+ employees globally and offices in the UK, Poland, and the USA, Vision RT operates independently as part of the Danish company William Demant Invest A/S, one of the world’s largest investors in healthcare companies. Employees benefit from the security and reach of being part of a large global enterprise, combined with the agility and innovation of a startup.
Vision RT is a company with strong values, a clear mission, and a bright future. It is an exciting and rewarding organization in which to work.

jobs.lever.co/zimperium/ff0d3ed6-7449-4c.description_excerpt:
Zimperium® is the world leader in mobile security, purpose-built to protect the modern mobile enterprise. Trusted by leading organizations and governments, our AI-driven platform delivers real-time, on-device protection for mobile applications and devices. We help organizations stay ahead with proactive defense against evolving threats—including mobile-targeted phishing (mishing), malware, app vulnerabilities, and zero-day exploits. Our mission is to empower organizations to operate securely and confidently in today’s dynamic digital environment.
We are seeking a highly skilled and inquisitive security engineer with deep technical expertise in mobile threat detection and operating system internals. This role focuses on conducting forensics analysis of potentially compromised devices to research, develop, and improve our detection capabilities against advanced mobile threats. Experience in analyzing data from iOS backups and diagnose is at the core of the role. The ideal candidate combines strong technical depth with an open and adaptive research mindset, maintaining versatility across diverse security challenges. A strong ability to code for the iOS environment, alongside conducting and reviewing high-quality technical work, is essential for success in this position.
Location: Europe
Key Responsibilities:
Design, prototype, and implement new detection techniques and algorithms for the iOS platform based on forensics data coming both from the runtime environment and the offline iOS sysdiagnose and backup files.
Lead and participate in structured brainstorming sessions to generate novel detection ideas against advanced mobile threats.
Analyze, document and make use of iOS internals features in an attempt to improve the runtime and offline detection capabilities.
Develop, maintain, and improve internal tooling and automation to accelerate analysis, triage, and detection development.
Review and interpret forensic data provided by customers, produce clear technical reports, and provide actionable guidance and remediation support.
Write and publish technical blog posts to raise awareness of emerging security risks and share insights with customers and the wider security community.
Required Skills & Experience:
Proven ability to collaborate effectively within a team environment, including forming and leading focused sub-groups to deliver specific project features or research objectives.
Strong knowledge of iOS operating system internals (e.g., diagnose, encrypted backup, daemons/services, sandboxing, code-signing), with a particular focus on the capability to use the data provided by the operating system to detect a compromised device.
Good previous experience in data analysis methods applied to forensics investigations.
Proficiency in reverse engineering using tools such as IDA Pro, Ghidra, Hopper, or equivalent, including experience writing scripts, leveraging their SDKs, and isolating and reporting technical issues.
Demonstrated ability to think both offensively and defensively, approaching analysis tasks with the mindset of both an attacker and a defender.
Solid programming experience in C, Python, Objective-C and Swift, with the ability to produce efficient, maintainable, and secure code.
Capability to reverse engineer proprietary protocols and interprocess communication mechanisms (e.g., XPC, mach messages, IOKit) is considered a plus.
Practical knowledge of jailbreak methods and iOS exploit classes (e.g., kernel exploits, sandbox escapes, code-signing bypasses), ideally experience in analyzing such exploits or exploit chains is a big plus.
